plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-flags

Colored, user-named flags for DeepSeek Harness session lists.
Mark the sessions that matter, give each color a name of your own, and find them again from a searchable sidebar panel.

English | 中文

A flag is not a pin: pins reorder the list, flags label it. Use one color for “waiting on me”, another for “refactor in progress”, a third for “read tomorrow” — and rename the colors to match your own workflow. ## Highlights - **A flag on every flagged session row.** A small flag glyph sits in the session-row leading seat, right before the title, while the row is idle; the row's own status dot takes precedence when a session needs attention. - **One click on hover.** The row's hover strip carries a flag button; its hollow state tells unflagged rows apart at a glance. - **A “Set flag” row in the session “…” menu.** It sits between “Fork” and “Archive” and previews the current color. - **Named colors.** Each of the eight palette colors can be renamed. Names show up in the hover card, the picker, and the menu, so the color system can carry your own vocabulary. - **A searchable “Flagged sessions” panel.** A sidebar panel row opens a page that groups every flagged session by color, shows each color's name, and jumps straight back to the conversation. Search matches session titles, workspaces, and color names. - **Bilingual UI** (English / Simplified Chinese) following the GUI language. - **Durable, local, private.** Flags live in one JSON document under the DSH home, owned by the plugin's Host half. No network calls, no telemetry, no changes to the sessions themselves. ## Screenshots | Flagged row + named chip | Pick a color | Rename the colors | | --- | --- | --- | | ![Flagged row with the named color chip](docs/screenshots/flagged-row.png) | ![Flag color picker](docs/screenshots/picker.png) | ![Rename each color](docs/screenshots/color-names.png) | | “Flagged sessions” panel | | --- | | ![The flagged sessions panel grouped by color name](docs/screenshots/flagged-panel.png) | ## Requirements - DeepSeek Harness Desktop (or the Web GUI) **0.2.1-rc.2**. The package declares `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.0-rc.2"`, and named installs are checked against that range before the package manager runs. - The plugin is a normal independent DSH plugin package (Host half + Client browser bundle); it installs into a profile, not into the application. ## Install ### From npm Published as the unscoped npm package [`dsh-session-flags`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-flags): ```bash # The compatibility preflight runs first (`engines.dsh`), then the package # manager adds it; reconciling the profile appends the new bundle, so the # plugin is enabled without a second step. dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-session-flags ``` In the GUI this is **Plugins → Add plugin**, typing `dsh-session-flags`. Either way, reload the profile afterwards — restart the Harness so the new Client bundle is registered. On the official DSH Desktop app prefer the app's own **Settings → Plugins** page: that profile belongs to the app's plugin manager, and the CLI cannot change it while the app is running. ### From a local checkout ```bash pnpm install pnpm build # lib/index.js (Host) + lib/client.js (Client bundle, CJS ModuleLoader) dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-flags # or, for a clean isolated profile: dsh plugin --profile flags-dev add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-session-flags ``` Restart the Harness and open the **Plugins** page — the bundle and its `dsh-session-flags` row should be enabled. The profile patch layer (`cordis.patch.yml`) is applied automatically through the package's `dsh.bundle.patch` field. ### From a tarball ```bash pnpm build pnpm pack # dsh-session-flags-0.1.0.tgz (lib/ is included via "files") dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/dsh-session-flags-0.1.0.tgz ``` ## Marketplaces Third-party listings are independent of npm. The community **dsh-market** reads the curated [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) registry; a listing is one pull request that adds `data/plugins/__.yml`, and the market app picks the entry up from that registry (usually within a day of the PR merging). The exact submission file and release checklist are in [docs/releasing.md](docs/releasing.md). The official Harness ships **no plugin market**. Its optional *custom plugin markets* bundle (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-plugin-market-bundle`) adds a **Discover** tab where the user adds market index sources; the community catalog is published as a format-1 index at `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dsh-plugin-catalog/index.json`. Turn it on from **Plugins → More → Experimental plugins → Custom plugin markets**, add that source, and search for `dsh-session-flags`. With the bundle on, the agent can browse the same indexes through the read-only `plugin_market` tool. ## Usage | Where | What it does | | --- | --- | | Session row, leading seat | Shows the flag color while the row is idle (status dots win while a session needs attention). | | Session row, hover strip | Flag button → opens the **Set session flag** dialog. | | Session “…” menu → **Set flag** | Same dialog, reachable without hovering. | | Session hover card | Colored dot plus the color's current name. | | Dialog → **Manage flag colors** | Rename each of the 8 colors; blank a name to fall back to the localized default. | | Sidebar → **Flagged sessions** | Searchable page with every flagged session, grouped by color name. Search matches the session title, its workspace, or the color name. | | Panel row hover → **×** | Clear that session's flag without opening the conversation. | | Panel header → **Manage colors** | Same color-name manager, right where the list is. | Choosing “No flag” clears the flag. Names and flags are saved as soon as you confirm; the dialog reports a failure instead of closing when the Host rejects a write. ## How it works ``` src/ shared/ palette + wire protocol shared by both halves host/ Cordis plugin: owns flags.json, registers exact Fetch routes client/ Cordis plugin: locale copy, styles, slot contributions, dialogs index.ts re-exports the Host entry client/index.ts Client bundle entry (ModuleLoader factory) ``` **Host half** (`name` / `inject` / `apply`). It needs only `ctx.connection` and registers three exact Fetch routes below `/api/dsh-session-flags` (`state`, `set-flag`, `color-names`) with `ctx.connection.fetch.register`. Each response uses the Connection convention `{ o

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness skill pack: plan-driven video editing automation for Wondershare Filmora 2026 on Windows
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-filmora-2026

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 **万兴喵影 2026 视频剪辑 skill**（Wondershare Filmora 15，Windows 中文版）。

装一次，agent 就多了一套「看屏幕 → 认界面 → 动键鼠 → 再截图核对」的剪辑能力：导入素材、在时间线上剪辑、加转场/文字/特效、导出 MP4，并在交付前核验成片。它不依赖喵影的任何 API（喵影也没有公开 API），全部走 GUI 自动化 + 视觉核对。

![编辑器实测截图](docs/screenshots/editor.png)

## 它能做什么

- **计划驱动剪辑**：先用脚本把剪辑决策算成数据（节拍/BPM、镜头时长、时间线位置、理由），再在喵影里执行；不靠"凭手感拖拽"
- **接管已打开的喵影**：自动找窗口、识别界面状态（home/editor/登录/导入/导出/保存对话框）、截图（多屏/高 DPI）
- **导入素材**：`Ctrl+I` + 剪贴板粘贴绝对路径（中文路径也稳）
- **时间线编辑**：按秒精确摆放（`place`）、拖素材、分割 `Ctrl+B`、删除、复制、撤销、逐帧、缩放
- **文字/转场/特效/音频**：切面板、拖模板，按截图核对
- **导出**：`Ctrl+E` 打开导出窗，改标题/路径/格式/分辨率；`wait-file` 等导出完成
- **成片 QC 质量门**：`qc_export.py` 机械核对时长/分辨率/帧率/音轨电平/黑场/冻帧，出 9 帧接触表；不过就修，最多 3 轮
- **工程检查（只读）**：`wfp_probe.py` 读 `.wfp/.wfpx`：版本、素材清单、缺失素材、时间线轨道/片段摘要、缩略图导出
- **自动探测安装位置**：注册表扫描万兴喵影/Filmora（不写死盘符），区分 2026 版与旧版
- **中文输入**：内置剪贴板粘贴，绕开输入法/中文输入问题

## 智能层（v0.2 新增）

借鉴了公开的 video-edit-agent、dsh-creative-studio、dsh-video-pipeline、guikit、FilmoraMCP/automate-filmora 的做法：

1. **规划 → 执行 → 验收** 三段式，每段有机器可验的完成判据（`plan.json` 校验、截图差异、QC pass）
2. **能算成数据的用脚本，只有界面状态才用 GUI**：转码/抽帧/时长核对不下放给点击
3. **看-判-动-验** 循环：单步动作、动作后截图复验、连续 3 次无变化即停、单类操作上限 12 步
4. **状态机 + 失败→修复对照表**：点击无反应、弹窗、坐标错位都有确定恢复路径
5. **质量门**：导出后机械 QC + 视觉接触表，warn 要解释、fail 必修
6. **工程格式情报**：实测记录 15.6 `.wfpx` 内部结构（`project_info.json` / `timeline.wesproj` / `medias_info.json`），为 v0.3「写工程」路线铺路

## 实测环境

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统 | Windows，双屏 1920×1080，显示缩放 100% |
| 喵影 | 万兴喵影 2026，Build `15.6.4.20300`（中文界面） |
| 截图 | 编辑器最大化 1920×1050 时的完整区域与按钮坐标（见 `skills/filmora-2026/references/ui-map.md`） |
| 已验证 | 打开首页 → 新建项目 → `Ctrl+I` 导入 PNG → 拖入视频轨 → `Ctrl+E` 打开导出窗 → 关闭；菜单/快捷键/对话框布局逐一截图核对 |

> 官方图文教程已更新到 V16（2026-09），与本机 15.6.4 有版本差；界面/键位变化时按 skill 里的「重新校准」流程更新坐标。

## 安装

> **只想让"所有项目/所有会话"都能用** → 装到用户级技能根（推荐，无需重启）：
>
> ```powershell
> powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1            # 默认 User 作用域
> # 等价于把 skills/filmora-2026 复制到 %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills\filmora-2026
> ```
>
> 装好后任意工作区的新会话都能看到 `filmora-2026`；只装到某个项目的 `.dsh/skills/` 则只有那个项目可见（见下表优先级）。

### 方式一：作为 DSH 插件（可随 profile 升级/卸载）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-skill-filmora-2026   # 从 npm
# 或从 GitHub 源码
dsh plugin --profile web add github:<your-name>/dsh-skill-filmora-2026
```

装完重启 DSH（或在设置 → 插件里确认已加载），会话技能目录里会出现 `filmora-2026`。

> 官方 Desktop 应用请在 **设置 → 插件** 里安装；CLI 命令用于 `dsh web` 等 profile。

### 方式二：只装 skill 文件夹（不装插件）

把 `skills/filmora-2026/` 整个目录复制到任一技能根：

| 作用域 | 目录 | 优先级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 当前项目 | `<项目>/.dsh/skills/filmora-2026` | 100 |
| 当前项目（agents 兼容） | `<项目>/.agents/skills/filmora-2026` | 200 |
| **当前用户（所有项目）** | `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\skills\filmora-2026` | 400 |
| 当前用户（agents 兼容） | `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\filmora-2026` | 500 |

技能目录会被监视，**新增/修改无需重启**；`SKILL.md` 的 `references/`、`scripts/` 子目录里的资源按需读取。

### 确认是否生效

1. 在**任意工作区**新开会话，问一句「列出你当前可用的 skill」——应该能看到 `filmora-2026`。
2. 看不到时依次检查：
   - `DSH_HOME`（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh`）下确实有 `skills\filmora-2026\SKILL.md`；
   - 会话的工作区没有同名项目级 skill 覆盖（同名时项目级优先，内容应当一致）；
   - 重启一次 DSH（正常热加载不需要，但可强制重扫）。
3. 触发方式：会话里直接说「用万兴喵影把 X 剪成 Y」，或显式说「加载 filmora-2026 skill」。

## 使用

在会话里说「用万兴喵影把这个素材剪成 30 秒卡点视频并导出到 D:\out」即可；或显式要求加载 skill：

```
用 filmora-2026 skill 打开喵影，把 video_project/卡点视频_30s.mp4 导入并加一个标题，导出到桌面
```

前置条件（skill 会自动检查）：

1. **用户自己先打开喵影 2026 并登录**。不要让 agent 从 DSH 沙箱里启动它：低权限进程会让 `WebBrowser.exe`（CEF）崩溃、主程序 20–40 秒后退出（已实测）。
2. 屏幕缩放 100% 最稳；其他缩放/分辨率下 skill 会先做一次坐标校准。
3. Python 3 + `pyautogui`、`Pillow`、`pywin32`、`psutil`（脚本 `doctor` 会自检并提示缺什么）。

## 已知限制

- **仅 Windows**；仅针对万兴喵影 2026 / Filmora 15 实测，其他版本需重新校准坐标。
- GUI 自动化本质脆弱：喵影更新界面、换主题、改快捷键预设都可能失效；skill 里写明了「先截图再操作、每步核对、失败回退」的流程。
- 会员/云端/AI 付费功能不代操作、不代登录、不代付款。
- 不修改用户源素材，不覆盖导出文件（导出前会核对路径）。
- 截图与坐标基于 1920×1050 最大化窗口；其他尺寸用比例坐标或重新校准。

## 目录结构


## 调研与借鉴（v0.2）

- **Agent Skill 写法**：Anthropic《Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills》、agentskills.io 的 skill 最佳实践与脚本设计、Claude Code skills 文档：description 即触发指针、`SKILL.md` 精简到 <500 行、细节按需放 `references/`、确定性逻辑固化为脚本、用评估用例对比开/关基线。

plugins.description: Lock DSH sessions so they cannot be archived | DSH 会话锁插件（由 DeepSeek Harness 维护）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-lock

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）的会话上一把锁：**锁住的会话，任何归档路径都动不了它。**

> DSH's sidebar **archive** hides a session from the list while keeping its data on disk.
> This plugin adds a lock button to every sidebar row; a locked session is refused by every
> archive path — the ⋮ menu, another plugin, or a maintenance script calling
> `workspaces.archiveSession`. The host half also exposes an `archive-inactive` route that
> bulk-archives stale sessions while **always** skipping the locked ones.

MIT · 零运行时依赖 · 需要 DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`

---

## 为什么需要它

DSH 侧栏的「归档」是一个**隐藏但不删数据**的动作：点一下，会话就从列表里消失了。

- 手滑点错菜单，正在跟的会话就不见了；
- 批量整理脚本、维护任务、别的插件走 `workspaces.archiveSession` 批量归档时，分不清哪些是你还要用的；
- 归档是**不可逆的 UI 操作**（数据还在 `$DSH_HOME/sessions/` 里，但要找回来得手动翻目录）。

`dsh-session-lock` 把这些会话挑出来锁上：锁在宿主里，和浏览器无关；锁定之后所有归档路径都会被拒绝，并且告诉你原因。

## 特性

| 特性 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧栏锁按钮 | 每个会话行一个 20×20 的锁图标：空心锁 = 未锁，琥珀色实心锁 = 已锁，同时该行左侧有一条琥珀色细边 |
| 全路径拦截 | 侧栏 ⋮ 菜单、其它插件、脚本调用的 `workspaces.archiveSession` 都会被拦下，弹提示说明原因，会话不会被隐藏 |
| 宿主持久化 | 锁清单在 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-session-lock/locks.json`，换浏览器、清缓存、重启 dsh 都在 |
| 批量归档不活跃会话 | 宿主路由 `POST /plugins/dsh-session-lock/archive-inactive`，供每日维护任务调用；**上锁的会话永远被跳过** |
| 零运行时依赖 | 浏览器半边是纯 DOM + 一个 `fetch`，不 require 任何宿主内部包，宿主内部包改名不会影响它 |
| 只读安全 | 除锁清单外不写任何东西；归档走进程内官方注册表，不直接改 `storages/workspace.json` |

## 安装

需要 DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`；`<profile>` 是你的 profile 名（多数人是 `web`）。

### 方式一：插件市场

如果你装了插件市场 `dshmarket`，直接在市场里搜 `dsh-session-lock` 安装即可（它会把包名写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`）。

### 方式二：命令行

```sh
# 1. 装依赖（dsh plugin 会把参数原样转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm）
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-lock

# 2. 把 "dsh-session-lock" 追加到 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json 的 dsh.profile.bundles 列表里
#    （bundles 决定哪些包会被挂载；只装依赖不写这一段，插件不会加载）

# 3. 重启 dsh（宿主半边不参与热加载）：托管在 systemd 上就是
#    systemctl restart dsh-web，其它部署方式重启你启动 dsh 的那个进程
systemctl restart dsh-web
```

### 方式三：本地源码

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Setsuna-Kitahara/dsh-session-lock
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-session-lock
# 同样要把 "dsh-session-lock" 加进 dsh.profile.bundles，然后重启 dsh-web
```

### 卸载

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-lock
# 从 dsh.profile.bundles 里删掉那一行，重启 dsh-web
```

锁清单文件会留下，不需要时手动删 `$DSH_HOME/plugin-data/dsh-session-lock/locks.json`。

## 使用

1. 刷新一次浏览器页面（客户端半边会随 `dsh-client-modules` 一起加载）。
2. 侧栏每个会话行最左边出现一个锁按钮，点它就是锁定／解锁，**整个按钮都能点**（图标在按钮正中间，不会把点击吃掉）。
3. 锁定后试着从 ⋮ 菜单归档它：会被拦下，并弹出一条「该会话已锁定，未被归档」。
4. 批量归档不活跃会话（可选）：

```bash
curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/plugins/dsh-session-lock/archive-inactive \
  -H 'x-dsh-session-lock: 1' -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"days":3,"dryRun":true}'
```

先 `"dryRun":true` 看候选列表，确认无误再去掉 `dryRun` 真归档。

## HTTP 接口

所有路由都在 `/plugins/dsh-session-lock/` 下，都要求 `x-dsh-session-lock: 1` 请求头
（这是一个跨站表单发不出来的非简单头），并拒绝显式的 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`。

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/locks` | GET | `{ ok, locked: string[], records }` —— 当前锁清单 |
| `/set` | POST | `{ sessionId, locked, note? }` —— 上锁／解锁一个会话 |
| `/unlock-all` | POST | 清空全部锁 |
| `/health` | GET | `{ ok, count, path }` —— 锁清单路径与条数 |
| `/archive-inactive` | POST | `{ days?: 3, dryRun?: false, sessionIds?: string[] }` —— 归档不活跃且未上锁的会话 |

`archive-inactive` 的判定与豁免：

- **口径**：会话目录里 `session.*.jsonl(.zstd)` 的**最新 mtime** 早于 `now - days*24h`，即视为不活跃。默认 3 天，上限 3650 天。
- **豁免顺序**：已上锁 → 已归档 → 未到期 → 正在运行（`ctx.sessions.get(id)` 命中）→ 不在 `sessionIds` 白名单里（给了白名单时）。
- **fail-closed**：锁清单直接读盘、不用内存缓存，**读不出来就整次拒绝**（503），一个都不归档——宁可不归档，也不归档一个用户锁住的会话。
- 走 `ctx.workspaceRegistry.archiveSession()`，即官方进程内写路径；不要绕过它去改 `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`（那是运行中进程内存状态的镜像，外部改写会被下一次写回覆盖）。
- 单次最多归档 500 个；返回 `{ ok, dryRun, days, cutoff, scanned, candidates, archived, failed, truncated, skipped{locked,live,alreadyArchived,recent} }`。
- **刻意不做回环（loopback）围栏**：本插件常见部署是 nginx 反代域名访问的，socket 对端是本地代理、`Host` 是公网域名，回环围栏会把正常用法直接挡掉。防护靠上面那个自定义请求头。

## 工作原理

| 半边 | 文件 | 职责 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 宿主 | `lib/index.js` | 锁账本（临时文件 + rename 原子整文件写）+ 五条 HTTP 路由（含 `archive-inactive`） |
| 浏览器 | `lib/client.js` | 包装 `workspaces.archiveSession`、给侧栏会话行注入锁按钮、提示条 |
| 自测 | `test/*.test.mjs` | 用假的 cordis ctx / DOM 驱动真代码，离线跑，不碰任何真实 DSH 状态 |

几个实现上的点，读代码前先知道会省事：

- **浏览器半边从会话行的 React fiber 上读会话 id**。侧栏不把会话 id 写进 DOM，fiber 上 row 组件的 props 是唯一稳定的句柄；读不到就不装饰该行——宁可少画一个按钮，也不猜错会话。
- **拦截器包裹的是 `workspaces.archiveSession` 这个方法引用，并每 3 秒重新断言一次**：同级插件（以及本插件自己的 HMR 重载）可能替换掉它。
- **按钮的重绘是幂等的**：侧栏扫描挂在 `MutationObserver(document.body)` 上，任何 DOM 变更都会触发一轮重绘。因此 `paintButton` 只在图标状态真正变化时才写 `innerHTML`（`.dsh-session-lock-btn>svg { pointer-events:none }` 是第二道保险）。**不要**把它改成无条件 `innerHTML`：那会每帧替换 `<svg>` 子节点，而浏览器在 mousedown 目标被移出 DOM 后不会再派发 `click`，结果是图标区域点不动、只有按钮边缘一圈有反应。

## 设计取舍

诚实地说清楚边界，比事后解释便宜：

- **只拦「归档」，不拦「彻底删除」。** 删除走的是另一条链路（`dsh-archived-chats` 等），本插件不接管。
- **浏览器半边是 fail-open，宿主半边是 fail-closed。** 客户端拦截器读不到锁清单时账本视为空，归档会正常执行——在「拦下一个用户没锁的会话」和「放走一个用户锁了的会话」之间，客户端侧选了后者（读失败会在控制台留 warn 并弹提示条）。而 `archive-inactive` 相反：读不出锁清单就整次拒绝。
- **多标签页不做实时同步。** 客户端在加载时读一次锁清单，之后每次切换锁都会重读；另一个标签页里的改动要等本页下一次切换或刷新才可见。宿主账本始终是唯一事实来源，所以不会写错。
- **宿主半边改动不参与 HMR**（只有客户端半边会），改完要重启 `dsh-web`。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node test/archive-inactive.test.mjs    # 宿主半边：路由、扫描口径、fail-closed
node test/client-decoration.test.mjs   # 浏览器半边：注入、重绘稳定性、点击目标
# 或者
npm test
```

两个测试都是**自足**的：宿主的用临时 `$DSH_HOME` 造假会话目录，客户端的自带一个
~120 行的 DOM stub，都不需要跑着一个 DSH，也不会写你的真实状态。

客户端那个测试专门守着本文档上面提到的那个坑：25 次重绘必须**零** `innerHTML` 写入、
`<svg>` 节点身份必须不变；把 `paintButton` 改回无条件重写，它会立刻失败。

## 常见问题

**点了锁按钮没反应？**
先刷新一次页面（客户端半边是随页面加载的）。若仍无反应，打开浏览器控制台看有没有
`session-lock` 的报错：宿主路由挂了（例如没写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，或忘了重启 `dsh-web`）时，
`/locks` 会 404。

**锁按钮为什么不是圆形的、为什么这么小？**
它按侧栏行高做的 20×20，图标 14×14，跟 DSH 自带的行动作按钮同尺寸。悬停时会出现底色。

**锁定会话会不会阻止 DSH 自己删数据？**
不会。锁只作用于「归档」这一个动作。

**能用 curl 从别的机器上锁吗？**
接口只要求 `x-dsh-session-lock: 1` 头，能访问到 DSH 的 HTTP 端口就能调用；
反代部署时请自行在反代层做访问控制。

## 更新日志

### 0.1.0

首个公开版本。

- 修复：锁按钮只有边缘一圈能点、鼠标压到锁图标上就失效。原因有两个，都是客户端半边的：
  (1) 重绘循环每帧重写 `innerHTML`，把 mousedown 落点的 `<svg>` 换掉，浏览器随即丢弃这次 `click`；
  (2) 按钮从未被加上 CSS 里定义的那个 class，尺寸/hover/锁定态样式其实一直是死的。
  现在重绘幂等、class 由代码负责、图标对指针透明，并加了回归测试。
- 新增：宿主半边的测试改为自足运行（临时 `$DSH_HOME`），不再依赖真实机器上的会话目录。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Setsuna-Kitahara

DSH 本身由 DeepSeek 维护，本插件是独立的第三方插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。

plugins.description: A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that converts documents to Markdown so an LLM can read them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-markdownize

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that converts documents to Markdown so an LLM
can read them.

Models work best with plain text. A PDF, a Word file or a spreadsheet read as
raw bytes is noise to them. Markdown keeps the structure (headings, lists,
tables, slides, pages) while staying compact and easy to read. This plugin
gives the agent a `convert_to_markdown` tool that does that conversion
locally. You can also preview a conversion yourself before anything is sent
to the model.

## What it does

- **`convert_to_markdown` tool.** The model calls it with a local file path
  and gets the document back as Markdown, truncated to `max_chars`
  (100,000 by default).
- **Two conversion engines.** You pick one on the plugin's page:
  - its **own engine**, a pure-JavaScript port of MarkItDown's offline
    converters, bundled with the plugin and always available;
  - **Microsoft MarkItDown** (Python), used when it is installed.
- **Debug mode.** Preview the Markdown a file turns into from the web
  composer (**Ctrl+Shift+M**). Nothing is sent to the model.

## Supported formats

| Format | Own engine (JS) | Microsoft MarkItDown |
|---|---|---|
| PDF | yes (text per page) | yes |
| Word `.docx` | yes | yes |
| PowerPoint `.pptx` | yes (text and notes per slide) | yes |
| Excel `.xlsx` | yes (one table per sheet) | yes |
| HTML / HTM | yes | yes |
| CSV / TSV | yes (as a table) | yes |
| JSON / XML | yes (fenced code block) | yes |
| TXT / MD | yes (as is) | yes |
| ZIP | yes (each supported file inside) | yes |
| Excel 97 `.xls`, EPUB, Jupyter `.ipynb`, Outlook `.msg` | no | yes |

## Conversion engines

### Own engine (JavaScript)

`convert.js` mirrors MarkItDown's offline converters with Node libraries:

- `mammoth` for DOCX;
- `exceljs` for XLSX;
- `unpdf` (pdf.js) for PDF;
- `turndown` with GFM tables for HTML;
- `jszip` and `fast-xml-parser` for PPTX and ZIP.

It needs no Python, no network and no child processes. The libraries ship
pre-bundled in `vendor/`, so the plugin has no runtime npm dependencies. This
matters because dsh installs local plugins as `link:` dependencies, and pnpm
never installs a linked package's dependencies.

### Microsoft MarkItDown

[MarkItDown](https://github.com/microsoft/markitdown) is Microsoft's Python
tool for the same job. It gives the reference output and reads a few more
formats. Install it with:

```bash
pip install "markitdown[all]"
```

The plugin looks for it on `PATH` as `markitdown`, `py -m markitdown`,
`python -m markitdown` or `python3 -m markitdown`. If it lives somewhere else,
such as a virtualenv's `markitdown.exe`, set its command on the plugin's page.
Use double quotes around paths with spaces.

### Choosing the engine

Open **Plugins → dsh-markdownize**. The page shows which engines were found.
When both are available, choose:

- **Automatic** (the default): MarkItDown when it is found, otherwise the
  JavaScript engine.
- **Always MarkItDown**: conversions fail if it is missing.
- **Always JavaScript**.

The choice and the custom command are saved in
`<dshHome>/storages/dsh-markdownize/settings.json`. They apply to both the
tool and debug mode. MarkItDown is detected once per Host start; press
**Search again** after installing it.

## Install

The plugin needs no build step and no Python. For a `web` profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-markdownize
```

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

The dump should show a `# == dsh-markdownize` layer. Then start the client:

```bash
dsh web
```

On the `desktop` profile, add it from the app's plugin manager as a local
folder.

## Debug mode (web client)

1. Attach a compatible file to the composer, or mention one with `@`.
2. Press **Ctrl+Shift+M**.

Each compatible attachment and `@file` reference is converted on the Host.
`@file` paths are resolved against the Session's workspace. The full output,
with no truncation, is written to `<os tmpdir>/dsh-markdownize-debug/` and
opened in the right Sidebar preview. A composer notice reports its size, path
and the engine used.

Nothing is sent to the model, and the draft is left as it was. Images and
unsupported formats are skipped.

## Limits and safety

- Only local files: URLs are rejected (use the web tools for those).
- Files are read with the privileges of the dsh process.
- Files are capped at 50 MB.
- ZIPs are capped at 200 entries and 50 MB uncompressed, and nest at most one
  level deep.
- Tool output is truncated at 100,000 characters by default.

**Not covered:** OCR of scanned documents, audio transcription, YouTube,
image captioning, Azure Document Intelligence, and the legacy `.doc` and
`.ppt` formats.

## Structure

- `index.js` — the Host half. It registers the `convert_to_markdown` tool and
  the `markdownize` service (`convert`, `convertPath`, `status`, `configure`,
  `redetect`), served through the Gateway's SRC fallback.
- `engine.js` — engine selection, MarkItDown detection and invocation, and
  the saved settings.
- `convert.js` — the JavaScript engine.
- `client.js` — the Client half: the engine page under **Plugins**, the
  debug-mode shortcut, and the `en` / `es` / `zh` UI strings.
- `locale/` — the plugin's localized title and description.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — inserts the `dsh-markdownize` plugin row.
- `vendor/` — the bundled converter libraries (generated; committed).
- `build-vendor.mjs` — rebuilds `vendor/`.

## Rebuilding vendor/

After changing a converter's version in `devDependencies`:

```bash
npm install && npm run build
```

Commit the regenerated `vendor/` files: the plugin loads them at runtime.

## License

Copyright 2026 gorkaseto. Licensed under the
[Apache License, Version 2.0](LICENSE); see [NOTICE](NOTICE) for the bundled
third-party libraries and their licenses.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a 2x2 running-session dashboard with quarter-window cards, one-click entry and return
plugins.readme_text:
# 运行总览

DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 插件。它把当前与最近需要的会话排成四宫格，每格约占面板四分之一，点卡片直接进入会话，标题栏的「总览」按钮或 `Alt+R` 可以回到这一页。

任务看板只显示它自己发起的执行，看不到已经存在的会话。这个插件直接读运行时的会话目录，所以手动开的会话、子智能体之外的其它会话都会自动出现，不需要任务看板配合。

## 功能

- 四宫格视图，每屏 4 个，超出自动分页。
- 会话按状态排序：需要你处理、运行中、已完成未查看，最后是其余会话。
- 运行中的会话实时显示状态点动画；已完成未查看和等待处理的会话保留在页面上，直到你进入看过。
- 子智能体会话不显示，避免网格被派生会话占满。
- 每张卡片显示最近一条用户输入、目标与待办进度，以及上下文占用、费用估算、累计 Token、运行时长或最近活动。
- 点击卡片进入会话；会话标题栏出现「总览」按钮，侧边栏也有「运行总览」入口，`Alt+R` 可随时返回。
- 属于任务看板执行的会话会标注「看板任务」并显示对应卡片标题。

## 数据来源

插件只读，不写会话数据。

| 数据 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话列表、运行状态、标题、工作目录 | 客户端会话目录 `sessions.list` |
| 需要你处理、已完成未查看 | `ui-session` 的 `useSessionStatus` |
| 目标、待办、上下文占用、Token、最近输入、计费 Token 桶 | 会话投影 `goal`、`todos`、`contextPressure`、`tokenUsage`、`contextTimeline` |
| 看板任务标题 | 任务看板只读接口 `/api/task-board/state` |

费用不是从事件流重新累计的：它直接使用上下文洞察插件已经折叠好的计费 Token 桶，按 models.dev 的 DeepSeek 挂牌价折算。DeepSeek 高峰时段按挂牌价的 2 倍计费，非高峰按挂牌价；人民币按 1 元等于 0.15 美元换算。费用含子智能体会话，和上下文洞察的「总预估费用」同口径。价格表写在 `client.js` 的 `MODEL_PRICES` 里，遇到未收录的模型会显示「—」而不是编造数字。

## 安装

插件通过本地目录挂进 profile。先克隆仓库，再把它加到正在使用的 profile：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/sandwich-xz/dsh-session-dashboard.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add link:$(pwd)/dsh-session-dashboard
```

Windows PowerShell 下把 `$(pwd)` 换成绝对路径。安装后如果页面没有立即出现「运行总览」，刷新一次 DSH 页面或重启 `dsh web`。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove @local/runtime-overview
```

## 兼容性

- 需要 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2 或更新版本。
- 费用与最近输入依赖已安装的 `dsh-context`；没有它时这些位置显示「—」，其余功能不受影响。
- 只用主题变量着色，跟随 DSH 的明暗主题和皮肤。

## 开发

插件是纯 JavaScript，没有构建步骤。

```sh
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

改了 `client.js` 后，DSH 的客户端热更新会重新加载插件；如果页面没有变化，刷新一次。

## 限制

- 运行时长从插件第一次观察到该会话运行时算起，页面刷新后通过 localStorage 续上，但插件安装前就已经在跑的会话只能从安装时刻算起。
- 费用是估算，只对 `MODEL_PRICES` 收录的模型生效，且不含未上报用量的请求。
- 子智能体刻意不显示。

## 隐私

没有遥测，不向任何服务上传数据。唯一的网络请求是可选的 `/api/task-board/state` 同源读取。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Notificacao nativa no Chrome/Windows quando o DeepSeek Harness espera sua aprovacao
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH — Aviso de aprovação

[![tests](https://github.com/pedromarcioap/dsh-approval-notifier/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/pedromarcioap/dsh-approval-notifier/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![licença: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/licen%C3%A7a-MIT-2ea44f.svg)](LICENSE)

Extensão do Chrome (Manifest V3) que mostra uma **notificação nativa** — no
Windows, um toast do sistema — quando o DeepSeek Harness está bloqueado
esperando uma decisão sua na conversa.

![Notificação de aprovação do DSH](docs/notification.png)

> Imagem ilustrativa (`tools/make-preview.ps1`). O visual real segue o tema do
> seu Windows.

## Quando dispara

A extensão observa os painéis que assumem o compositor do chat. Cada um publica
um atributo estável, então nada depende de classes CSS geradas:

| Painel | Marcador observado | Notificação |
|---|---|---|
| Aprovação de ferramenta / escalação de sandbox | `[data-approval-key]` | “DSH aguardando sua aprovação” |
| Pergunta do `ask_user_question` | `[data-question-key]` | “DSH aguardando sua resposta” |
| Revisão de plano (plan mode) | `[data-plan-review-key]` | “DSH aguardando revisão do plano” |

Comportamento:

- **Uma notificação por pedido.** Mutações repetidas do DOM não duplicam o aviso.
- **Fecha sozinha** quando você responde, ou quando o painel sai da tela.
- **Lembrete se ninguém responder:** o toast reaparece a cada ~90s, no máximo
  três vezes, e para quando você responde ou fecha o aviso.
- **Badge no ícone** com quantos pedidos esperam decisão — visível mesmo com o
  popup fechado.
- **Bipe curto** junto com o toast, liberado só depois de um gesto seu na página
  (exigência de autoplay do Chrome).
- **Título da aba** ganha um `⚠ ` enquanto houver algo pendente.
- Clicar na notificação **foca a aba** do DSH.
- **Horário de silêncio** opcional (ver configuração): fora da janela o aviso é
  segurado e entregue quando ela termina — ou descartado, se você responder
  antes. Aprovações podem furar a janela, porque travam o agente.
- Funciona em **qualquer porta** de `127.0.0.1` e `localhost`, inclusive o DSH
  Desktop, que escolhe uma porta livre a cada execução.

## Instalação

1. Abra `chrome://extensions`.
2. Ative o **Modo do desenvolvedor**.
3. Clique em **Carregar sem compactação** e selecione a pasta da extensão.
4. **Recarregue a aba do DSH** (`F5`) — o content script só entra em páginas
   carregadas depois da instalação.
5. Clique no ícone da extensão e use **Enviar notificação de teste**.

Há uma release com `.zip` pronto em
[Releases](https://github.com/pedromarcioap/dsh-approval-notifier/releases) —
basta descompactar e carregar a pasta.

> A extensão fica instalada enquanto a pasta existir. Se mover ou apagar a
> pasta, remova e carregue de novo.

## Configuração (popup)

- **Ativar avisos** — liga/desliga sem remover a extensão.
- **Só quando a janela não estiver em foco** — evita o aviso redundante quando
  você já está olhando o chat. Se um pedido chegar com a janela em foco, ele
  ainda avisa no momento em que você troca de janela.
- **Horário de silêncio** — janela de "não perturbe" (padrão `22:00`–`08:00`,
  desligada). Pode atravessar a meia-noite. O aviso que cair na janela fica em
  espera, aparece no badge e é entregue no fim dela; se você responder antes,
  nada é entregue.
- **Aprovações furam o silêncio** — ligado por padrão: uma aprovação bloqueia o
  agente, então vale acordar; pergunta e revisão de plano esperam a janela.

## Se a notificação não aparecer

1. `chrome://settings/content/notifications` → libere o site `127.0.0.1` (a
   porta do DSH não importa: a extensão casa com qualquer porta em
   `127.0.0.1` e `localhost`).
2. Windows → Configurações → Sistema → Notificações: permita o Chrome e
   desative o **Assistente de Foco** durante o horário de trabalho.
3. Confirme que a página do harness está mesmo em `127.0.0.1` ou `localhost`
   (o DSH Desktop, por exemplo, sobe em portas aleatórias como `58426`).
4. Se um aviso laranja aparecer no canto da página dizendo **Aviso de aprovação
   inativo**, a extensão foi recarregada depois da página: aperte `F5`.
   O popup também mostra há quanto tempo foi o último aviso e se há alguma aba
   conversando com a extensão.

## Limitações

- **Precisa da aba aberta.** A extensão observa o DOM; com o navegador fechado
  não há aviso (também não haveria onde responder).
- **Só a página do DSH.** Não interfere em outras abas nem em outros sites.
- **Não é um canal de aprovação.** Ela avisa; a decisão continua no painel do
  chat, e cada aprovação vale uma única vez.

## Plugin nativo do DSH

Existe também uma versão como **plugin de cliente**, em [`plugin/`](plugin/README.md):
em vez de observar o DOM, ela assina o snapshot de status das sessões
(`ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`). Não depende da porta 3080 nem da aba aberta e,
por seguir a convenção de bundles do ecossistema, pode ser instalada pelo
`dsh plugin add` e cadastrada nos catálogos da comunidade.

Ainda não publicado no npm — veja o estado em [`plugin/README.md`](plugin/README.md).

## Desenvolvimento

```powershell
node test/content.test.mjs          # 23 verificações, DOM + chrome simulados
pwsh -File tools/build-release.ps1  # gera dist/dsh-approval-notifier-<versão>.zip
```

O workflow [`.github/workflows/test.yml`](.github/workflows/test.yml) roda esses
testes a cada push e pull request.

## Privacidade

A extensão não coleta nem transmite dados. Detalhes em [PRIVACY.md](PRIVACY.md).

## Publicação

Materiais para a Chrome Web Store ficam em [store/](store/CHECKLIST.md) e os
textos de lançamento em [marketing/](marketing/README.md).

## Licença

MIT — veja [LICENSE](LICENSE).

---

# DSH — Approval notifier

Chrome extension (Manifest V3) that fires a **native notification** — a Windows
toast on Windows — whenever DeepSeek Harness is blocked waiting for your
decision in the conversation.

## When it fires

It watches the panels that take over the chat composer. Each one publishes a
stable attribute, so nothing depends on generated CSS classes:

| Panel | Observed marker | Notification |
|---|---|---|
| Tool approval / sandbox escalation | `[data-approval-key]` | “DSH aguardando sua aprovação” |
| `ask_user_question` prompt | `[data-question-key]` | “DSH aguardando sua resposta” |
| Plan review (plan mode) | `[data-plan-review-key]` | “DSH aguardando revisão do plano” |

- **One notification per request**, no duplicates on repeated DOM mutations.
- **Auto-clears** when you answer or the panel leaves the screen.
- **Short beep**, only after a user gesture on the page (Chrome autoplay rule).
- **Tab title** gets a `⚠ ` prefix while something is pending.
- Clicking the notification **focuses the DSH tab**.

## Install

1. Open `chrome://extensions`.
2. Enable **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the extension folder.
4. **Reload the DSH tab** (`F5`).
5. Open the popup and press **Enviar notificação de teste**.

A packaged `.zip` is available under
[Releases](https://github.com/pedromarcioap/dsh-approval-notifier/releases).

## Troubleshooting

If an orange banner shows **Aviso de aprovação inativo**, the extension was
reloaded after the page: press F5. The popup also reports how long ago the
last notification happened and whether any tab is talking to the extension.

## Settings (popup)

- **Ativar avisos** — on/off without removing the extension.
- **Só quando a janela não estiver em foco** — stay quiet while you are already
  looking at the chat; still alerts the moment you switch away.

## Known limitations

- **Needs the tab open.** It observes the DOM; with the browser closed there is
  nothing to alert (and nowhere to answer either).
- **DSH page only.** It does not touch other tabs or sites.
- **Not an approval channel.** It only notifies; the decision still happens in
  the chat panel, and every approval is one-shot.

## Native DSH plugin

A client-plugin version lives in [`plugin/`](plugin/README.md): instead of
observing the DOM, it subscribes to the session status snapshot
(`ctx.uiSession.sessionStatus`). It does not depend on port 3080 or an open tab,
and it follows the ecosystem bundle convention, so it can be install

plugins.description: Resume the conversation a DSH restart interrupted — auto-continue the unfinished turn on boot.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-boot-resume

Resume the conversation a DSH restart interrupted — so you never have to type "继续" again.

[中文说明](./README.zh.md)

## The problem

DeepSeek Harness persists every session to disk, so the conversation history survives a restart. The **turn that was running** does not: on resume, `interruptedTurnClosers()` appends a synthetic `turn/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }` that closes the open turn, and the session then waits for your next message. Restart during work and the agent simply stops mid-thought.

## What this does

One check, once per host boot (`delayMs` after activation):

1. List the stored sessions of every workspace.
2. Read the tail of each one and look for an *unfinished turn*:
   - the last event is `turn/start` with no `turn/end` — the process died mid-turn, or
   - the last `turn/end` carries `reason.kind === 'interrupted'` — the marker a later resume wrote.
3. For every session that matches, `agents.resume()` it (or reuse the already-registered agent) and `agent.followup()` a short user message — `继续` by default.

Nothing else in DSH is touched: no schema, no patch to core, no extra process.

### What it deliberately does NOT resume

| Last turn ended with | Why it is skipped |
| --- | --- |
| `reason.kind === 'user'` | you pressed Stop — resuming would fight you |
| `reason.kind === 'completed'` | the turn finished normally |
| a turn older than `maxAgeHours` | stale, likely abandoned on purpose |

An agent instance that is already `running` for that session is also skipped, so a UI that reopened the conversation first always wins.

### Guards against a crash loop

If the resumed turn crashes the host again, the next boot would resume it again — forever. Two limits stop that:

- `cooldownMinutes` — at most one automatic resume per session in that window;
- `maxPerDay` — a hard cap per session per 24 hours.

`maxResumePerBoot` and `staggerMs` keep a busy machine from starting five model turns at the same instant.

## Install

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>"
pnpm add link:/path/to/dsh-boot-resume
```

then add the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in that profile's `package.json` and restart the host.

## Configuration

All keys are optional; the defaults are shown.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: auto-continue
      name: dsh-boot-resume
      inject: [agents]
      config:
        enabled: true
        delayMs: 8000            # wait after boot before checking
        message: 继续             # the follow-up text
        maxAgeHours: 12          # ignore sessions older than this
        cooldownMinutes: 30      # per-session cooldown between resumes
        maxPerDay: 3             # per-session resumes per 24h
        maxCandidates: 8         # newest sessions to inspect
        maxResumePerBoot: 5      # how many sessions may be resumed per boot
        staggerMs: 1500          # spacing between resumes
```

## Observability

Every boot writes one block to `$DSH_HOME/auto-continue/auto-continue.log`:

```
[2026-10-21T02:50:55.275Z] 发现未完成轮次 session-9ba505ca…（turn=47, 判定=open, 最后事件 …）
[2026-10-21T02:50:55.383Z] session-9ba505ca…: 已投递「继续」
[2026-10-21T02:51:00.290Z] 启动检查完成：续跑 3 个会话
```

`state.json` in the same directory holds the per-session cooldown history (delete it to clear).

## How the tail is read

`sessionPersistence.open(id, 'read')` + a bounded `read()` starting from the last projected seq (up to 1000 events back), falling back to a full read when the projection cache is missing or the window holds no turn boundary. Sessions are resolved from the workspace registry, so subagent and archived sessions never become candidates.

## Requirements

- DSH host `>= 0.2.0-rc.2`
- Host services: `agents`, plus `sessionPersistence` and `agentDefaultModel` when present

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
> **Renamed:** the canonical package is now [`dsh-preview-stl`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-stl). This repository is kept as the legacy 0.1.x home.

# dsh-stl-preview

Preview **STL** meshes inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): the right-Sidebar document preview renders the triangles in an interactive 3D viewport and reports the numbers that matter for 3D printing — size, volume, surface area and watertightness.

![The STL preview inside the DSH right Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-stl-preview/main/docs/stl-preview.png)

## What it does

- Registers a document-preview renderer for `.stl` files, so clicking one in **Workspace files** opens it in the right Sidebar.
- Streams the file through an authenticated `/api/stl-preview` route and parses **binary and ASCII STL in the browser** — nothing is uploaded, nothing is converted on the host.
- Draws the mesh with the same dependency-free WebGL viewer used by `dsh-blend-preview`: orbit, pan, wheel zoom, double-click reset, wireframe, auto-rotate, contact shadow, axis triad. STL is Z-up, so the mesh is rotated into the Y-up viewport before drawing.
- Reports: format (binary/ASCII + header), file size, triangle count, welded vertex count, bounding box in millimetres, volume in cm³, surface area in cm², and **watertightness** (boundary edges / non-manifold edges / degenerate facets), computed by welding vertices on a grid and counting edge uses.
- Handles unitless STL with a configurable `unitScale` (1 = millimetres, 10 = centimetres, 25.4 = inches).

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (declared compatible with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- A browser/GPU with WebGL (the desktop app always has it). No Blender, no slicer, no network.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-stl-preview
```

The desktop profile is owned by the Electron app; install there through the plugin manager UI, or compose it manually and restart. The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so the plugin row is added automatically.

## Configuration

Settings → Plugins → **STL preview** (namespace `stl-preview`):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the renderer and the byte route. |
| `routePath` | `/api/stl-preview` | Authenticated mesh route. Must stay under `/api`; otherwise it falls back to the default. |
| `extensions` | `["stl"]` | Suffixes that open in the 3D preview. |
| `maxBytes` | `536870912` | Largest STL streamed (512 MiB). |
| `chunkBytes` | `1048576` | Bytes per ranged read on the host. |
| `unitScale` | `1` | Millimetres per STL unit; drives size, volume and area. |
| `color` | `#c7d2e2` | Viewport colour (STL carries no materials). |
| `analysisMaxTriangles` | `400000` | Above this, skip the watertightness pass instead of freezing the tab. |

## How it works

```
Workspace file click
        │
        ▼
document preview body (lib/client.js)
        │  GET /api/stl-preview?path=…   (raw bytes, ctx.fs chunks)
        ▼
parseStl(bytes)         binary: 80-byte header + uint32 count + 50 B/facet
                        ASCII:  facet normal / outer loop / vertex
        │
        ├── analyzeStl: bbox, area, signed volume, vertex weld + edge map
        └── setGeometry: rotate Z-up → Y-up, upload triangles
```

- The route sits under `/api`, so the connection service authenticates every request (Host/Origin fence + session cookie) before a byte is read.
- Watertightness is skipped above `analysisMaxTriangles` (the edge map is the expensive part); the panel says so.
- Volume is the signed tetrahedron sum (`|Σ v0·(v1×v2)/6|`), area the summed triangle areas.

## Development

```
dev/client-body.js   client UI, STL parser and statistics (CJS factory)
dev/viewer.js        the WebGL renderer, spliced into the bundle at build time
scripts/build-client.mjs   builds lib/client.js from the two files
scripts/live-selftest.mjs  parses a real STL with the shipped bundle
scripts/e2e-browser.mjs    Playwright end-to-end against a temporary DSH host
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`lib/client.js` is generated — edit the files under `dev/` and rebuild.

## Notes and limits

- STL is unitless; the millimetre figures assume `unitScale` (1 by default). Set 10 for a file authored in centimetres.
- Very large meshes (millions of triangles) parse on the main thread and may take a moment; the watertightness pass stops at `analysisMaxTriangles`.
- ASCII STL with vertex colours or per-facet attributes beyond the standard grammar is not interpreted beyond positions and normals.
- Nothing is uploaded: bytes go browser ← host over the authenticated route and are parsed in the page.

plugins.readme_text:
# 余额 + 延迟挂件 · `@local/deepseek-balance`

在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 侧边栏底部常驻一个小挂件，同时显示 **账户可用余额** 和
**到模型服务商的实时网络延迟**。

```
● ¥19.21 · 178ms
```

## 它做什么

**Host 半**（`index.js`），两条同源路由，Key 与探测都留在 Host 进程：

| 路由 | 内容 | 缓存 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET /deepseek-balance` | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 账户余额（`api.deepseek.com/user/balance`） | 10s |
| `GET /deepseek-balance/ping` | 对各服务商 origin 的 HEAD 往返耗时 | 2s |

两条路由都接受 `?refresh=1` 绕过缓存。延迟探测的目标自动从当前 provider 配置发现：
先读 `llm-deepseek` 的 `baseURL`，再读 `llm-pi-ai` 的 `providers.*.baseURL`，都没有就退回
`https://api.deepseek.com`。可用环境变量覆盖：

```
DSH_BALANCE_PING_URLS=https://a.example,https://b.example
```

**Client 半**（`client.js`）注册到 `sidebar.footer.action`：

- 余额每 30 秒轮询，延迟每 5 秒轮询；页面重新可见时立即刷新
- 点击挂件 = 强制刷新两者
- 延迟颜色：`≤400ms` 常规、`>400ms` 警告、`>900ms` 或不可达 报错红
- 悬停可见：总余额 / 充值 / 赠金 / 各目标 host 的延迟 / 更新时间
- 延迟路由尚未就绪时（例如 Host 还没重启），挂件自动只显示余额，不显示红杠

## 显示规则

| 情况 | 挂件 |
| --- | --- |
| 正常 | `● ¥19.21 · 178ms` |
| 余额读取中 | `● ··· · 178ms`（黄点） |
| 缺少 API Key | `● 未配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY · 178ms`（红点） |
| 余额失败 / Key 无效 | `● — · 178ms`（红点） |
| 服务商不可达 | `● ¥19.21 · —`（延迟变红） |
| 侧边栏收起 | 只显示 `¥19.21`（56px 窄栏放不下延迟） |

## 配置

无需配置项。余额读取使用的环境变量名固定为 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`
（在 `~/.ds-harness-desktop/dsh-home/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs` 下维护），
每次查询都会重新解析，换 Key 不用重启。

## 安装

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=<本目录绝对路径>
```

安装后插件行 id 为 `deepseek-balance`，可在「设置 → 插件」中启用/停用。

## 回归测试

`test-host.mjs` 用一个替身 ctx 真跑一遍 `apply()`，验证两条路由、余额、延迟探测和缓存：

```powershell
$env:TEST_KEY = "<DEEPSEEK_API_KEY>"
node test-host.mjs
```

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 缓存助手：展示缓存命中量与命中率，发送前预警大规模缓存失效风险，并提供异常记录与会话缓存分析看板。/ Cache-hit metrics, request-prefix risk confirmation, and per-step cache-miss diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cache-helper

为 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）显示实际缓存命中量，在发送前确认大规模缓存风险，并保留异常记录与会话统计看板。

**当前版本：0.1.2。** 源码位于本仓库，预构建安装包通过 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ghang/dsh-cache-helper/releases) 提供；npm 与插件榜收录分别记录。已验证的宿主环境为 DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` 的 `web` profile；其他版本仍需验证。

## 功能

| 功能 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 每轮末次缓存 | 在回答底部的“用量”后、时间前显示该轮最后一次实际模型调用的缓存读取 Token 和命中率；悬停查看步骤与精确值 |
| 发送前确认 | 上下文组装完成后比较上次实际请求的有效前缀；预计大规模损失时暂停，点击“确认并发送”才继续 |
| WARN | 在输入框上方保留异常轮次、步骤、实际指标和差异线索；后续恢复命中仍保留记录，可展开、收起 |
| 缓存看板 | 在“设置 → 缓存看板”查看会话累计指标和步骤明细，支持搜索、异常筛选和翻页；回答尾部也有快捷入口 |

默认确认阈值是预计损失 **至少 50,000 tok，且达到上次输入的 20%**。首次冷启动正常放行；正常追加输入不算旧前缀损失。支持历史工具更新的模型按实际工具投影比较，新 deferred 工具在历史末尾激活时不会仅因声明列表变化就误报。

长会话中应把插件安装、移除、启停和更新集中在任务间隙。改变模型可见的工具清单、定义或顺序可能破坏前缀缓存，使旧历史重新按未缓存输入计费。本插件不注册模型工具或注入提示词，但不能阻止其他插件改变请求前缀。

## 实际效果

下面来自作者授权公开的真实会话“DeepSeek Harness 插件依赖修复与回滚”。第 15、16 轮首步的缓存命中率分别降至约 **0.4%** 和 **1.4%**；第 16 轮末次调用已恢复至 **99.69%**，WARN 仍保留异常记录。

独立看板按会话列出异常轮次、步骤与当时观察到的工具声明变化。图中目录和会话标识已遮挡；顶部统计覆盖已扫描会话，右侧表格是所选会话。

![真实会话的独立缓存有效率看板](docs/images/real-cache-dashboard.png)

每轮末次调用的缓存量与命中率放在原生用量后、时间前；历史 WARN 保留在输入框上方。

![每轮末次缓存与历史 WARN](docs/images/real-turn-cache.jpg)

原因栏是本地上下文对比线索，不是服务端缓存失效原因的确定证明。

![真实缓存失效步骤与变化线索](docs/images/real-cache-misses.jpg)

## 指标口径

缓存量是该次 response 的 `cacheReadTokens`，表示实际读取的缓存 Token。缓存率为：

```text
cacheReadTokens / (inputTokens + cacheReadTokens + cacheWriteTokens)
```

DSH 的 `inputTokens` 是未缓存输入，输出不进分母。回答尾部只取**所属轮次末次实际调用**，不把步骤累加，也不使用其他轮次的读数。末次回执缺少缓存字段时显示“未知”，不回退到此前的已知值。看板的累计率使用各次输入量加权。

例如，某轮末次调用读取缓存 `90,000 tok`、未缓存输入 `10,000 tok`、缓存写入 `0 tok`，该轮显示 `末次缓存 90k tok · 90%`。这不是服务端当前缓存容量，也不是会话累计缓存量。

预计前缀损失使用字符位置和上次实际用量校准，属于估计。实际未命中告警会扣除可解释的新增输入影响；观察到的工具、system 或历史变化仅作为原因线索。

## 安装

需要 Node.js 22 或更新版本，以及已安装的 DSH CLI。从 [Releases](https://github.com/ghang/dsh-cache-helper/releases) 下载对应版本的 `dsh-cache-helper.tgz` 和 `SHA256SUMS`，在两者所在目录执行 `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` 核对完整性。首次试用只安装到 **web**，先结束当前任务并停止 web 服务。源码开发和候选生成见 [开发说明](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md)；用实际包路径替换下例：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-cache-helper.tgz --offline
dsh --profile web --port 3099
```

`--offline` 要求 DSH 所需依赖已在本机缓存；依赖不齐时安装会失败。记录缺失依赖，再按自己的包源策略处理。不要为安装候选包绕过版本检查或自动批准额外构建脚本。

打开 DSH 启动输出提供的本机认证地址。登录链接中的 token 只保留在本机，不放进截图、问题反馈或 Git。安装、升级后重启 web 并刷新页面，再检查插件入口和读数。当前文档不提供桌面 profile 的安装步骤。

## 配置

通过 DSH 的 web profile 配置覆盖插件 ID `cache-helper`，保存后重启 web：

```yaml
- id: cache-helper
  config:
    minLostTokens: 50000
    minLossRatio: 0.2
    dashboardLimit: 50
    maxEvents: 200000
    maxCachedSessions: 64
```

| 配置 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---:|---|
| `minLostTokens` | 50000 | 旧前缀损失估计的 Token 下限 |
| `minLossRatio` | 0.2 | 损失占上次输入的比例下限 |
| `dashboardLimit` | 50 | 按创建时间从新到旧最多扫描的主会话数，最大 200 |
| `maxEvents` | 200000 | 单会话分析事件数上限；超限且存在历史基线时等待未知检查确认 |
| `maxCachedSessions` | 64 | 内存中保留派生指标的会话数，最大 200 |

看板显示扫描范围、失败数和未知用量。达到扫描上限不表示所有历史会话都已分析。

## 确认与数据保存

- 确认绑定会话、冻结请求指纹和历史版本，只消费一次；其他会话和后续不同请求不能复用。
- 取消、关闭确认框、Escape、停止任务或卸载都会取消等待。断连不会自动放行，重连后可继续处理。
- 等待期间历史、请求头或消息投影发生变化，旧确认失效，需要重新发送并检查。
- 已确认的风险若实际发生 miss，仍会生成 WARN；恢复命中只标记恢复，不删除该次异常。
- 大上下文的输入投影未知，或无法可靠判断比较规模时，要求人工确认；有可信规模且低于阈值的请求可放行，不把未知指标补成正常命中。

Session 是上下文与用量的事实源。插件不另存完整请求、响应或提示词，不改写模型请求，不读取模型凭据，也不新增外部服务。

服务端仅在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/cache-helper/web-state.json` 保存状态版本和用户收起的告警 ID；WARN 和指标从 Session 重建，一次性确认不落盘。浏览器在 `localStorage` 的 `dsh-cache-helper.only-warnings.v1` 保存异常筛选布尔值，设置页与快捷看板共用，并在同源标签页间同步。存储受限时使用当前页面的内存状态。

## 停用、卸载与回滚

先停止当前任务或取消待确认请求，再在 **web 的设置 → 插件管理** 中停用本插件；重启 web，确认入口已消失。停用期间后续模型请求不再受本插件的确认门禁保护。

完整卸载时先关闭 web，再执行：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-cache-helper --config.offline=true
```

随后重启 web 并刷新页面。卸载撤销插件拦截和界面节点，不删除 Session。插件的告警收起状态可保留在本机；若手工删除该状态文件，历史告警仍可从 Session 重建。

升级前保存上一份已验证的 `.tgz` 和配置差异。需要回滚时，停止 web、卸载当前候选，再从本机安装已保存的旧包：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-cache-helper-PREVIOUS.tgz --offline
dsh --profile web --port 3099
```

`PREVIOUS` 是所保存包的版本占位符；只有实际保留并验证过的旧包才能据此回滚。回滚后核对配置兼容性、末次缓存读数和确认流程。版本切换放在任务间隙进行。

## 验证与限制

已有本地测试通过真实 Cordis、AgentLoop、LlmRuntime 和 DeepSeekAdapter 向假上游发送 HTTP，覆盖显式确认、取消、停止、卸载、确认过期和会话隔离；输入重建与生产适配器序列化结果进行过逐字段比较。浏览器回归覆盖每轮末次值、页脚顺序、WARN、设置页看板、异常筛选、窄窗和暗色布局。每个候选的实际测试结果仍需按 [发布准备流程](docs/RELEASING.md) 重新记录。

当前门禁覆盖原生 AgentLoop 主会话各步骤和正常用户 fork；排除辅助 `purpose` 调用、`origin=subagent` 或有 `delegationDepth` 的子会话。外部代理和网关内部追加的请求不在该门禁内。

已验证默认 DeepSeek Messages 的文本路径。图片、文件和其他适配器尚未完成等价证明，按未知检查处理。旧 Session 没有完整记录所有适配器配置，默认 Flash 历史按已核查的标准 `addition-only` 行为投影；定制同名模型的历史策略可能无法确认。

服务端 TTL、淘汰和缓存域实现不可由客户端精确观测；上下文不变也可能发生 miss。插件提供确认与原因线索，不自动修复服务端缓存。测试使用假上游，不要求发送真实付费模型请求。极大会话在新增回执后重分析仍可能产生可感知开销。

[变更记录](CHANGELOG.md) · [开发说明](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) · [发布准备](docs/RELEASING.md) · [MIT 许可证](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Mobile adaptation for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — phone layout, overlay sidebar drawer, bottom navigation and a manual Desktop/Mobile switch. Standard DSH client plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-client-ui-mobile

[中文](README.zh.md) · [![test](https://github.com/MARYCOMPLEX/dsh-client-ui-mobile/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/MARYCOMPLEX/dsh-client-ui-mobile/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Mobile adaptation for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **Web GUI**, packaged as a standard DSH client plugin.

The Web shell is desktop-first: a three-column frame with drag handles, hover affordances and 8px resize targets. On a phone it technically renders, but the conversation is squeezed next to a 56px rail and the composer fights the on-screen keyboard. This plugin turns the same URL into a usable phone interface — no fork, no patch to the shell, no build step.

> Community plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek. Built and tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.2.1-rc.2`.

## What it does

Everything below applies at **≤ 768px viewport width**; wider viewports are left untouched.

| Area | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| Frame | Three columns collapse to one; the centre gets the full width |
| Sidebar | Becomes an overlay drawer (`min(86vw, 300px)`) with a dimmed backdrop; tapping a session, a panel or the backdrop closes it |
| Bottom bar | 56px navigation: **Chat / Sessions / Plugins** (hidden when the Plugins panel is not registered) **/ Desktop** |
| Desktop handles | The 8px `col-resize` handles are hidden — they are not touch targets |
| Right panel | Forced full-screen instead of a docked column |
| Composer | 16px inputs so iOS does not zoom on focus; the frame shrinks by the on-screen keyboard height via `visualViewport` |
| Layout | `100dvh` heights, `env(safe-area-inset-*)` padding for notches and gesture bars |
| Wide content | `pre` and `table` scroll inside their own box instead of widening the page |
| Settings | The settings modal becomes a full-screen sheet; its 188px side nav turns into a horizontal, scrollable tab strip |

## Install

### As a bundle (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MARYCOMPLEX/dsh-client-ui-mobile
```

Then open **Settings → Plugins** and enable the `mobile-ui` bundle. Enabling a bundle appends its patch layer, which inserts the loader row for you.

Pin a release for reproducibility:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:MARYCOMPLEX/dsh-client-ui-mobile#v0.1.0"
```

If your profile runs with configuration HMR disabled, restart `dsh web` afterwards.

### As a plain row

If you would rather not adopt the bundle, install the package and add the row yourself:

```yaml
# <profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: mobile-ui
      name: "dsh-client-ui-mobile"
```

Either way the package must be installed in the profile (`dsh plugin --profile <name> add …`) so the loader can resolve `dsh-client-ui-mobile` from the profile's `node_modules`.

## The switch

The adaptive layout is **on by default** and can be turned off without uninstalling anything:

- **Desktop** button at the right end of the bar — turns the phone layout off for this browser; the bar disappears and a small **Mobile** pill stays in the bottom-right corner to turn it back on.
- The choice is stored in `localStorage` under `dsh-client-ui-mobile.enabled` (`"1"` / `"0"`).
- URL escape hatch: `?dshm=off` and `?dshm=on` force the state and remember it. Use this if the adaptive layout itself ever makes a page hard to operate.
- Disabling the whole plugin — **Settings → Plugins**, or remove the loader row — leaves the GUI exactly as shipped.

## How it works

A DSH client plugin runs in the same browser runtime as the shell, so it can extend the interface through documented seams only:

1. **Global stylesheet** — `ctx.effect` appends a `<style>` element to `document.head` and removes it on unload, the same mechanism `dsh-client-ui-theme` uses. Every rule is inside a media query and scoped to the frame the plugin tags, so the desktop layout is never affected by a partial mount.
2. **`shell.bottom` slot** — the bar and the pill are ordinary React components registered into the frame's bottom row, so the bar participates in the frame's own grid instead of overlaying content.
3. **`ctx.layout`** — the bar reads `panelInfo` to highlight the active panel and calls `toggleSidebar()` / `selectPanel()` for navigation.
4. **DOM tagging, not class names** — the plugin marks the frame and its three columns with `data-dshm-*` attributes, because the shell's CSS-module class names are hashed per build (`pI_x6G_frame`).

### Maintainer note: the grid trap

The drawer leaves normal flow (`position: fixed`). A CSS grid skips out-of-flow items during auto-placement, so without explicit pins the centre column slides into the first track — which is `0px` wide — and the whole conversation disappears. The plugin pins all three columns:

```css
[data-dshm-frame] > [data-dshm-col="sidebar"]  { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1 }
[data-dshm-frame] > [data-dshm-col="center"]   { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; min-width: 0 }
[data-dshm-frame] > [data-dshm-col="rightbar"] { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; min-width: 0 }
```

The smoke test asserts this, so a future refactor cannot silently reintroduce a black screen.

## Compatibility and limitations

- Targets DSH `0.2.x`. The shell's breakpoints, slot names and `ctx.layout` surface are stable within a minor line, but a new release can still move things underneath.
- No hashed class names are used; hooks are `data-shell-bottom`, `data-sidebar-collapsed`, `data-rightbar-col`, `data-sidebar-right-open`, plus the `_handle` class suffix.
- 768px is the plugin's own breakpoint. The shell's right-panel auto-fullscreen switches at `< 768`, so the plugin adds a CSS full-screen fallback for the exact boundary.
- A plugin can change styles, slots and layout state — it cannot change component internals. Composer behaviour (Enter to send, native gestures) stays whatever the shell ships.
- Tested on Android Chrome. iOS Safari support (safe areas, visual-viewport keyboard inset) is implemented but not verified on a physical device; reports welcome.

## Development

No build step and no dependencies — `lib/client.js` is the shipped browser bundle, written against the `window.__ModuleLoader__` contract.

```bash
node test/smoke.mjs
```

The smoke test stubs React, the DOM and the cordis context, then asserts: module registration, stylesheet injection, `shell.bottom` registration, button set and copy, and the column pinning described above.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Alice Nation theme skin for DeepSeek Harness: repaints the whole Web GUI from public design tokens and switches characters by clicking an avatar.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-client-ui-alice-skin
#最近新出的游戏爱丽丝与彼岸，画风不错也挺好玩的就做了个界面插件，大家对画风感兴趣可以去steam下一个玩

Alice Nation 主题皮肤 —— 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 界面换上一层「爱丽丝」风格的配色与装饰,
并带一个右下角的角色面板:点一下头像,整个界面就跟着换成那位角色的配色和立绘。

![浅色主题](docs/light.png)

![深色主题](docs/dark.png)

拖到任意位置:

![拖动](docs/dragged.png)

换一位角色:

![换角色](docs/character-xiaoli.png)

## 它做了什么

**整站配色重绘** —— 不去改 DSH 的组件,而是重写它本来就读取的那层设计令牌
（`--dsw-alias-bg-*`、`--dsw-alias-label-*`、`--dsw-alias-border-*`、`--dsw-alias-brand-*`、
`--dsw-specific-*` 等 60 多个变量）。所以侧栏、输入框、气泡、按钮、代码块、滚动条、
设置卡片会一起变色,深浅两种主题都适配。

**角色氛围图** —— 右侧一层低透明度的角色立绘,用径向遮罩融进背景,不影响阅读。

**角色面板** —— 右下角常驻卡片:立绘 + 名字 + 一句台词。上面是 12 个圆形头像的
选择器,点谁换谁:

| 角色 | 来源 | 主题色 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 爱丽丝 / 爱丽丝·蓝 / 爱丽丝·夜 / 爱丽丝·礼 | `Player`, `Player2..4` | 玫瑰 / 天蓝 / 紫罗兰 / 鎏金 |
| 梅莉 | `RMeili` | 蜜桃 |
| 女王 | `Rqueen` | 淡紫 |
| 兔执事 / 雪兔 | `Rrabbit`, `Rrabbit2` | 薄荷 / 冰蓝 |
| 小璃 | `XiaoLi` | 樱粉 |
| 主管 / 熊掌柜 / 猫女仆 | `Supervisor`, `RKuma`, `Cat` | 蜜色 / 钢灰 / 藕荷 |

**交互**

- 点头像 → 换角色:主题色、氛围立绘、卡片立绘一起以 0.4 秒交叉淡入切换
- **拖动卡片或头像栏的空白处 → 整个面板跟着走**(鼠标/触屏都行),松手即记住位置,刷新不丢;
  不会被拖出窗口(贴边自动夹住),窗口变小时也会自动收回可见区域
- 点卡片 → 收起 / 展开头像选择器(拖动过的那一下不会被误判成点击)
- 卡片右上角 ✦ → **开关背景氛围图**:就是右侧那张大立绘淡出/淡入(见下方说明)
- 选择、位置、开关状态都记在 `localStorage`,刷新后还在

### ✦ 氛围图开关到底是什么效果

它只控制**右侧那张大面积的角色立绘**(默认约 12% 不透明度、径向遮罩融进背景)。
关掉之后右侧恢复成纯渐变底色,其余东西一个都不变 —— 主题色、头像栏、卡片、文字都不受影响。
觉得大图干扰阅读就关掉,想要氛围就打开。开着时 ✦ 是实心、关掉是空心 ✧,鼠标悬停会浮出「氛围图」标签。

| 开着(默认) | 关掉 |
| --- | --- |
| ![](docs/light.png) | ![](docs/aura-off.png) |

## 安装

插件已作为 bundle 装进 desktop profile。重新安装:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:E:/chajian/alice-skin
```

它在 profile 里注册为一个 bundle(`dsh.bundle.patch`),加载器条目 id 是
`ui-alice-skin`;要临时关掉,在 `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml` 里加:

```yaml
- id: ui-alice-skin
  disabled: true
```

装好后刷新一次页面即可看到（DSH 的 client HMR 一般会自己推送,没动静就 F5）。

## 结构

```
alice-skin/
├─ package.json        # dsh.bundle(profile 层) + dsh.client(浏览器半边)
├─ cordis.patch.yml    # 唯一的 insert 行:id: ui-alice-skin
├─ lib/index.js        # 宿主半边:注册 /dsh-alice-skin 静态资源路由
├─ lib/client.js       # 浏览器半边:注入 CSS + 角色面板(手写 __ModuleLoader__ bundle)
├─ assets/
│  ├─ manifest.json    # 角色名 / 台词 / 主题色
│  ├─ portraits/*.webp # 560px 立绘卡(12 张,约 440 KiB)
│  └─ avatars/*.webp   # 128px 圆形头像(12 张,约 75 KiB)
├─ tools/
│  ├─ extract_unity.py # 用 UnityPy 从 AssetBundle 里导出 Sprite/Texture2D
│  └─ build_assets.py  # 按角色表裁立绘 + 圆头像,输出 webp 和 manifest
└─ docs/               # README 用的截图
```

`tools/` 里两个脚本顶部的路径常量指向本机位置,换机器时改那两行即可
(依赖 `UnityPy` + `Pillow`:`pip install UnityPy Pillow`)。

宿主半边只做一件事:把 `assets/` 通过 `/dsh-alice-skin/…` 发出去（带目录穿越防护、
只发 GET/HEAD、10 分钟缓存）。浏览器半边是手写的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`
工厂模块,不复用任何 DSH 内部组件,所以 DSH 升级时不会因为组件改名而崩掉 ——
它只依赖公开的设计令牌和 `document.body[data-ds-dark-theme]`。

拖拽用 Pointer Events 实现:按下后移动超过 4px 才算拖,否则仍按点击处理;位置以
**左下角**为锚点(`left` + `bottom`),这样上方头像栏展开/收起时卡片本身不会跳。
`localStorage` 键:`dsh-alice-skin:character` / `:dock` / `:aura` / `:position`。

## 换成你自己的图

1. 把新立绘放进 `assets/portraits/<id>.webp`(竖版,建议 372×512 或等比),
   头像放 `assets/avatars/<id>.webp`(正方形)。
2. 在 `lib/client.js` 顶部的 `CHARACTERS` 里加一行:`{ id, name, tagline, accent }`,
   `accent` 就是整站主题色。
3. 同步一下 `assets/manifest.json`(可选,仅供查阅),刷新页面。

要重新从游戏里抽图:`tools/extract_unity.py` 先把 AssetBundle 里的图导出成 PNG,
再用 `tools/build_assets.py` 按角色表裁立绘和头像(两者都依赖 `UnityPy` + `Pillow`)。

## 说明

- 立绘、头像来自本地游戏 **Alice Nation** 的 AssetBundle,仅供本机个人界面美化使用;
  角色名与台词是本插件为界面配的,与游戏原剧情无关。
- 只读取了角色卡与小图标,没有导出任何剧情 CG。

plugins.description: 把 api3d 中转站接入 DSH 的插件：站点/模型目录/API Key 配置 + 对话与其客户端 UI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-api3d

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-api3d?label=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-api3d)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d)](https://github.com/ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d/blob/main/LICENSE)

**中文** · [English](README.en.md)

> 📦 开源仓库：[ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d](https://github.com/ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d) ｜ npm：[dsh-api3d@0.2.8](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-api3d) ｜ [Release v0.2.8](https://github.com/ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d/releases/tag/v0.2.8) ｜ MIT（衍生说明见 [NOTICE](NOTICE)）

把 **API3D（[api3d.cn](https://api3d.cn)）** 这条中转站接成 DeepSeek Harness 里的
一条 pi-ai 路由，基础地址、API Key、出站兼容开关都在「插件」设置页里填，不用改文件、
不用重装。站点地址已经写在 `lib/site.js` 里，装上就是零配置可用。

**升级不用卸载重装**（0.2.8 起）：插件页 → 本组合包详情页里，「卸载」左边会多一个
**「升级到 x.y.z」** 按钮（有新版本时才可点）：点它 → 二次确认 → 进度 → 「已升级到 x.y.z
· 重启 DSH 之后生效」。宿主半用包管理器把 npm 上更新的版本装进当前 profile；开发目录 /
`link:` 安装会显示为不可点（附原因）。
（0.2.7 发布了这条路，但客户端半区漏了槽位注册，真机上没有按钮；0.2.8 补上注册，并加了一条
断言把「注册项必须存在」钉在测试里。）

这是一个**骨架**：核心链路（路由存活 + 出站围栏 + 凭据写入 + 设置卡 + 密钥/模型向导）
已经完整可跑，余额 / 用量 / 计费 / 健康探测四项留了明确的接缝，等着填。

装好后侧边栏「插件」下面会多一行 **API3D**：点进去填一次密钥、勾选站点上的模型，
就能直接用。详见「密钥与模型向导」。

## 设计取舍

一句话：**协议、模型目录、思考档位都是配置，不是代码；插件只负责「让请求真的被中转站接受」。**

- **不自研 `LlmAdapter`。** 自研一个 provider 适配器意味着复刻 harness ↔ pi-ai 的整个
  转换层（官方那个约 1000 行：Context 组装、StreamChunk 翻译、replay 状态、
  上下文溢出判定）。单站场景不值这个价。所以路由仍然**由官方适配器执行**，只是不写死在
  补丁层里：宿主半在解析期把一条 `llm-pi-ai.providers.api3d` 装进正在运行的配置。
- **不声明「空路由」。** pi-ai 拒绝一条解析不出任何模型的自定义路由（配置校验会报
  *resolves no models; the installed catalog does not describe this route*）。
  所以**没导入任何模型时，本插件一条 provider 都不声明**：设置里不会多出 API3D 条目，
  模型选择器里也没有 API3D 分组。向导导入之后路由才出现，选择器立刻跟上，不用重启。
- **运行时装配有两个坑，插件就是为它们存在的**（见下）。

### 坑一：profile 补丁层会把整条路由挤掉

profile 自己的 `llm-pi-ai.providers` 补丁在**每个 bundle 层之后**应用，而 loader 的
合并是「一层深」的：补丁里的 `config` 是**赋值**而不是深合并，所以整个 `providers`
字典会被替换。任何自带 provider 的 profile（随包发行的 `desktop` profile 就是）
都会丢掉本插件声明的路由。

装路由的时机就挂在解析期：`ctx.on('internal/config', …, { global: true })` 里把带着
**导入目录**的路由补回去，再通过 `ctx.get('loader')` 找到 `llm-pi-ai` 条目、
`entry.update({ config })` 写回（启动时也会试写一次）。没有导入目录时这一步整个跳过 ——
既不装路由，也不去动别人同名的那条。

> 为什么不能只写一次：宿主 profile 的 watcher 会在启动后几秒重读补丁文件，
> 把一次性写入回滚。必须每次解析都补。

补回去的时候用的是**「本插件自己那条说了算」**的写法（`replace`）：解析出的 `providers`
里已经有 `api3d` 时，只要它与要写的路由完全一致就跳过（值没变就不写，免得自己触发自己
的解析风暴），否则整条替换。这里有个很容易踩的坑：`internal/config` 监听器的**第一个参数
是宿主解析出来的 `llm-pi-ai` 配置，不是本插件的设置** —— 两者曾经同名，结果每次解析都拿
模板里的默认目录把导入的那份盖回去，表现就是「模型导入了，但选择器里永远只有一条」。
现在两个参数名分开写，要装的路由一律由插件设置算出（`routeValue`），不再因为
「同名路由已存在」而提前返回。

### 坑二：baseURL 由适配器逐请求解析，但它读不到本插件的设置

两个命名空间。所以路由的 `baseURL` 指向一台**刻意不存在**的主机
（`upstream.api3d.invalid`，RFC 2606 保留顶级域），围栏在出站时把它改写为设置里的
真实地址。

这么绕的好处是「换机房」变成设置页里的一次写入；坏处是**围栏必须在请求路径上**，
包括每一台真实端点 —— 否则 DNS 直接失败（这是刻意的大声失败，比静默打到某台真实
服务器好）。

顺带，围栏还承担了中转站常见的出站兼容：

| 出站兼容 | 为什么需要 |
| --- | --- |
| 改写 baseURL | 见上 |
| 可选替换 `User-Agent` | 有些站点按 UA 认证，而适配器会剥掉与它归属头冲突的 profile header |
| 可选直连（绕过进程代理） | 站点 WAF 常把数据中心出口 IP 判成挑战，回 200 HTML 而不是 SSE |
| 可选补 `required: []` | 站点转发到严格上游时，缺 `required` 的工具 schema 会被拒 |
| 可选静默重试 | 站点多通道转发，个别通道把本可重试的请求判成 400 |
| 402 额度错误加提示 | 站点用 402 + 被错标成 `text/event-stream` 的 JSON 报额度耗尽 |

## 目录

| 路径 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `lib/site.js` | **身份常量唯一来源**：包名、行 id、provider 名、哨兵主机、默认凭据引用名。换站点先改这里 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 组合包补丁层：**只插入插件行**（`- insert:`）。路由不在这里声明，见「设计取舍」 |
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半：围栏、路由存活、配额注解、设置命名空间 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半：设置卡（基础地址、API Key、兼容开关、预留的运维行）、侧边栏入口、密钥/模型向导 |
| `lib/route.js` | **手写**：`ROUTE`（路由骨架，**不含 `models`**）与 `MODEL_TEMPLATE`（向导每行的能力初值） |
| `lib/direct-fetch.js` | 直连传输（`node:http`/`node:https`，绕开进程代理） |
| `scripts/probe-models.mjs` | 用真实 key 打一次 `GET {baseURL}/models`，与**设置里已导入的目录**做 diff |
| `test/` | 135 项断言，见下 |

## 安装与分发

装进某个 profile。[English](README.en.md)

| 方式 | 命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **npm** | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-api3d` | 已发布 **`dsh-api3d@0.2.8`**；查询顺序：profile 配置的 registry → `registry.npmmirror.com` |
| **GitHub 直装** | `dsh plugin --profile web add github:ptb-xiaou/dsh-api3d` | 仓库里 `lib/` 就是成品，没有构建步骤，装完即用 |
| **tarball** | `dsh plugin --profile web add https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-api3d/-/dsh-api3d-0.2.8.tgz` | 也接受本地绝对路径的 `.tgz`；GitHub Releases 可以放同一份 tgz |
| **本地路径** | `dsh plugin --profile web add E:\path\to\dsh-api3d` | 开发用；建议装进隔离实例，别装进正在用的主实例 |

装完**重启 DSH**：插件行是 boot graph 的一部分，热载不生效。

三个实测事实（在干净隔离实例上走真实安装路径验过两遍：一次是 `npm pack` 产出的
tarball，一次是 npm 渠道的 `add dsh-api3d`；两次的启动日志都打出
`api3d: 路由 api3d → …`）：

1. `add` 会自动把 `dsh-api3d` 追加进该 profile `package.json` 的
   `dsh.profile.bundles`，不用手工编辑；`dependencies` 一并写入。
2. 装好的包是 `profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-api3d` 下的**真实目录**，而且
   **它自己不需要 `node_modules`**：宿主半的 `import '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'`
   由 profile 内的解析层路由到应用自带的那一份。只有本地开发（插件在 profiles 目录
   之外）才需要自己软链宿主依赖，见「开发」。
3. 浏览器半同样被认出来：实例返回的 HTML 里模块清单含 `dsh-api3d`
   （`url: plugins/??dsh-api3d/client.js&rev=…`，带 `inject` 列表）。刚装好、还没导入
   模型时启动日志打出的是 `api3d: 尚未导入模型 → 暂不声明 api3d 路由`，导入之后变成
   `api3d: 路由 api3d → https://api3d.cn/v1，模型目录 N 个（从站点导入）：…`。

关于**版本兼容闸门**：插件管理器会检查 `peerDependencies` 里以 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`
开头的条目是否满足当前 DSH 版本，不满足就拒绝安装（除非在 profile 的
`compatibility.json` 里按精确版本开豁免）。本包只声明
`@deepseek-ai/cordis` / `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`，不在闸门范围内，所以不会卡住安装；
代价是本包**不做运行时版本自检** —— DSH 大版本升级后如果插件报错，请开 issue。

> **安全提醒**：本包的宿主半在 DSH 进程内运行，**不受工作区沙箱限制**，并且会拿到
> API Key。装之前请读 `lib/index.js`。

### 发布（维护者）

`lib/`（含手写的 `lib/client.js` 与 `lib/route.js`）是**提交进版本库的成品**，
所以 `github:` 直装不需要任何构建步骤。

- **npm**：已发布 **`dsh-api3d@0.2.8`**（官方 registry 的 `latest`）；`npm pack` 核对打包 16 个文件
  —— `lib/` 6 个（0.2.7 新增 `lib/self-update.js`）+ `cordis.patch.yml` +
  `README.md` + `README.en.md` + `LICENSE` + `NOTICE` + `package.json` + `docs/` 4 张向导截图；
  `test/`、`scripts/` 由 `files` 白名单挡在外面
  （`docs/` 从 0.2.1 起进白名单 —— 否则 npm 页面上的 README 截图是断图）。
  实测（0.2.8）：`dist.shasum` = `ab6fff74bed147ab01ca0b251f2c4a10a924e008`，registry 记录
  `fileCount` 16 / `unpackedSize` 541794；tarball 346608 字节（346.6 kB 打包 / 541.8 kB 解开），
  与本地 `npm pack` 的 SHA-1 完全一致。
  发版用能直接发布的 token；若账号被要求走暂存发布，`npm publish` 会报
  `E_STAGE_REQUIRED`，此时改用 `npx npm@11 stage publish` + `stage approve`（后者需要 2FA）。
  若 npm 上名字被占用，改成带 scope 的名字，并把本文档里的命令同步改掉。
- **发完必须核对**，而且要绕过两层缓存：本机全局 npmrc 把 registry 指到了
  `registry.npmmirror.com`（镜像同步慢且不全，曾经在 0.2.1 早已上线时 `npm view` 还报
  `latest: 0.1.1`），而即使加了 `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`，npm 自己也会缓存
  响应（0.2.3 发布 5 分钟后 `npm view` 仍报 0.2.2）。可靠做法是直接抓 packument JSON：
  `Invoke-RestMethod https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-api3d`，看 `versions`、`dist-tags` 与每条
  `dist.shasum`；再用 `https://registry.npmjs.org/dsh-api3d/-/dsh-api3d-<版本>.tgz` 下载并核对
  SHA-1。另外 `npm publish` 打印 `+ dsh-api3d@x.y.z` 只代表**已受理**（同一句还有
  `being processed`）：packument 会先出现，tarball 在 CDN 上要再过几分钟才 200。
- **GitHub Releases**：把 `npm pack` 的 tgz 传上去，使用者可用上面的 tarball 直装。
- 打标签前跑一遍 `npm test`（135 项）。

## 密钥与模型向导

装好后**不用先记字段**：侧边栏「插件」下面会多一行 **API3D**，点进去就是向导
（面板第一次打开、且还没导入模型时会自动弹出）：

1. 填站点密钥（基础地址已预填 `https://api3d.cn/v1`），点「确认并查询模型」。
   还没有密钥的话，输入框下方有一条「还没有 API Key？前往 api3d.cn 获取」，
   点它在系统浏览器里打开站点注册页（宿主按外链处理，不会在应用内嵌窗口里跑）。
2. 宿主半拿这把 key 去 `GET {baseURL}/models`，把站点实际在售的模型列出来。
3. 勾选要用的模型，点「导入所选模型」。

密钥框不会把整串藏起来：失焦时显示成 `api3d-…cdef`（首尾可见、中段打码），点进输入框
才显示完整值。填过一次之后，框右侧的下拉按钮会列出**最近用过的 5 把密钥**（最新的在最前，
列表里同样只显示打码形式），选一条就能直接用它去查询，不用重新粘贴；旁边的「清空历史」
把它删掉。历史记在 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `<apiKeyEnv>_HISTORY`
（默认 `API3D_API_KEY_HISTORY`）里，与密钥本身同处一个文件。

**下拉里的密钥是宿主代取的。** DSH 的凭据服务是单向的：`describe` 只回答「某个引用名配没配」，
没有任何读路径会把值交给页面（这也是 DSH 的既定设计）。所以这条列表由宿主半从凭据库读出、
只把 `api3d-…cdef` 这样的**打码标签**发给浏览器；选中时浏览器只回一个序号
（`POST /api/api3d.keys` 拿清单、`keyIndex` 随查询/导入请求回传），真实值全程不出宿主进程。
「清除历史」也只是让宿主 `unset` 那条派生引用。

**第 2 步列出的不只是名字。** 每行都带一条能力摘要（形如
`输入 文本 · 上下文 1,000,000 · 最大输出 384,000 · 5 档推理`），行尾的「调整能力」可以
逐条展开修改：

| 控件 | 落到路由描述符的字段 | 初值 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 输入：文本 / 图像 | `input` | 只勾「文本」 |
| 上下文 | `contextWindow` | 能力模板的初值（1,000,000） |
| 最大输出 | `maxTokens` | 同上（384,000） |
| 推理档位：关闭 / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max | `reasoningEfforts` | 能力模板那 6 档（`off` = 提供 Off 但不发该字段） |

每行的能力**互相独立**：改一行不影响其它行，也不改能力模板（`lib/route.js` 的
`MODEL_TEMPLATE`）。数字留空表示「用模板里的值」。

要注意的是：`api3d.cn` 的 `/v1/models` 只回 `id` 与 `display_name`，不报输入模态、上下文
窗口或推理档位，所以这里的初值是本插件的内置默认，**不是站点声明的值**。勾「图像」或加档位
之前先确认站点真的支持，否则请求会被上游拒绝。合法词汇表由 DSH 的 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器
定义：模

plugins.description: An AI agent that drives Cadence Virtuoso to draw layout: 12 DeepSeek Harness tools, with DRC and LVS verified on a real 0.18 um process
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout

**An AI agent that drives Cadence Virtuoso to draw layout — packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin.**

12 host-side tools, zero runtime dependencies, driving **Virtuoso 6.1.7-64b** inside a
RHEL 6.5 VMware guest. Verified end to end on a real SMIC 0.18 µm process: the layout it
produced passes Calibre **DRC** with zero geometry violations and passes **LVS** as a
recognised `N18E2R` device.

![The layout it drew](artifacts/nmos15-final.png)

---

## What this actually is

Not a script that clicks menus. Commands are **SKILL expressions evaluated inside the
running Virtuoso CIW**:

```
host (this plugin, Node.js)
  │  SSH / SCP
  ▼
guest (RHEL 6.5)
  │  virtoso-bridge daemon on :65452  ◄── SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:65453
  ▼
ramic_bridge.il inside the CIW
  │  evalstring("(progn …)")
  ▼
Cadence database API  →  dbCreateRect / dbSave / cv~>shapes
```

Because it goes through the database API rather than the GUI, the agent can state facts
about the layout — *"18 rectangles, bbox ((0.2 −1.0) (2.2 1.68)), gate length 0.18 µm"* —
instead of opinions about a picture.

XTEST key/mouse injection exists, but only to unwedge a modal dialog. It is never the
primary channel.

---

## The 12 tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `virtuoso_status` | four-layer readiness: VM → sshd → tunnel → **CIW answers `1+1`** |
| `virtuoso_vm` | VM + tunnel lifecycle; `up` is the one-call repair |
| `virtuoso_config` | persisted settings, applied on the next call |
| `virtuoso_recover` | repair the guest GUI, then prove it with a real eval |
| `virtuoso_windows` | SKILL window list + X11 window ids |
| `virtuoso_screenshot` | capture one Virtuoso window to a PNG the model can look at |
| `host_window` | enumerate / raise / capture **Windows host** windows (the VMware console) |
| `virtuoso_eval` | arbitrary SKILL over stdin |
| `virtuoso_run` | a long guest command as a background job |
| `virtuoso_drc` | parse Calibre DRC output into structured JSON |
| `workspace_create` | register a workspace |
| `context_usage` | this session's token budget (read-only) |

Full parameter/output schemas: [`TOOLS.md`](TOOLS.md) — **generated from the live tool
definitions**, so it cannot drift from the code.

---

## The write gate

`lib/guard.js` installs a single global tool guard that denies mutating
`virtuoso_eval` / `virtuoso_run` calls unless they carry a stateless, sha256-derived
`confirm` token.

The contract was read out of the harness, and it shaped the whole design: a guard is
**synchronous** (it cannot wait for a human), it runs **after** the pre-execute
waterfall, it **can only deny** — it can never force a call through. So the design is:

- **Read-only calls are never gated.** `dbOpenCellViewByType(… "r")`, `cv~>shapes`,
  `sleep; echo` pass untouched — otherwise the gate trains you to paste tokens without
  looking.
- **Fail-closed.** If the sandbox policy cannot be read, the guard denies.
- **`confirm: true` is deliberately rejected.** That is a rubber stamp, not consent.
- **`danger-full-access` abstains**, because the user already granted full write
  authority — and `virtuoso_status` reports `enforcedNow` so the gate is observable.

Verified live in four cases: deny → token → allow, wrong token, read-only exempt, and
abstain under full access.

---

## Verified results

The `DSH_NMOS/dsh_nmos15` cell, on the real `smic18ee` SMIC 0.18 µm technology:

| | Result |
|---|---|
| **DRC** | 393 checks, **6 violations — all density rules**, zero geometry violations |
| **LVS** | **CORRECT** — `N=4 EP=4`, `M0 S G D B N18E2R L=0.18um W=1.2um` |
| Guard ring | four-sided P+ frame, closed loop proven by rasterising and counting holes |
| Iterations | 22 → 24 → 35 → 36 → 18 → 16 → 13 → 7 → **6** |

The 6 remaining are density rules (`PD.*`, `MIM_8a`): an isolated 3.7 × 4.5 µm device
cannot fill a 30 % metal-density target. They are full-die constraints, not defects.

**Not achieved, and documented as such:**

- **PEX / parasitic extraction.** The xRC rules are complete, but the shipped deck was
  written for Calibre xRC v2009.3 and the installed v2015.2 rejects it with Tcl parse
  errors. See [`PEX-STATUS.md`](PEX-STATUS.md). A control experiment with the unmodified
  deck rules out editor error.
- Multi-finger / common-centroid matching, place & route, clock tree, power grid.

---

## Documentation map

This project is as much a record of what went wrong as of what works. The failures are
the interesting part.

| Document | Contents |
|---|---|
| [`HISTORY.md`](HISTORY.md) | timeline, bug ledger, and the judgements that were **retracted** |
| [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | project memory: paths, environment facts, troubleshooting order |
| [`LAYOUT-AUDIT.md`](LAYOUT-AUDIT.md) | hand-written geometry audit → discovering DRC is the authority |
| [`DRC-RESULTS.md`](DRC-RESULTS.md) | first real Calibre run: 393 checks, 22 violations |
| [`SKILL-FIXES-AND-LVS.md`](SKILL-FIXES-AND-LVS.md) | three SKILL method errors, first LVS pass |
| [`NMOS-FINAL.md`](NMOS-FINAL.md) | converging the device to density-only violations |
| [`WELLS.md`](WELLS.md) | well experiments: P-well is *derived*, N-well needs a pickup |
| [`RING-AND-CONNECTIVITY.md`](RING-AND-CONNECTIVITY.md) | measuring connectivity: 8 islands, a ring fixes 1 of 3 |
| [`RING-CLOSED.md`](RING-CLOSED.md) | closing the ring; why only a screenshot revealed it was a solid bar |
| [`PEX-STATUS.md`](PEX-STATUS.md) | why parasitic extraction does not run here |

### Three findings worth the read

1. **A guard ring that was a solid bar.** Four rectangles overlapped in y and filled in.
   No DRC rule says *"a ring must have a hole"*, and connectivity analysis counted one
   component and passed it. **A screenshot showed it immediately.** The fix was to
   rasterise the shapes at 10 nm and count enclosed holes — a check the eye can make,
   now automated.

2. **Prefix arithmetic is unavailable in Virtuoso 6.1.7.** `(- x d)` fails with a load
   error that reports the *end* of the wrapper, pointing nowhere near the fault. Infix
   (`x - d`) works. Six diagnostic rounds were spent on this.

3. **`procedurep` cannot probe built-in functions here.** It returns `nil` for `geOpen`,
   which demonstrably works, and `errset` collapses *"no such function"* and *"refused"*
   into the same `nil`. Every conclusion drawn from those probes had to be re-derived.

---

## Requirements

- **Cadence Virtuoso** with a licensed install (this was developed against 6.1.7-64b)
- A Linux guest reachable over passwordless SSH, in VMware or similar
- A technology library to bind to
- **Calibre** for DRC/LVS (optional; the plugin can drive Virtuoso without it)
- Node.js (the plugin uses **only Node builtins** — no `npm install`)
- DeepSeek Harness

Without Virtuoso and a PDK this plugin has nothing to drive. It is published because the
**technique** — turning an opaque EDA tool into a programmable, verifiable, documented
interface — transfers to any tool with a scripting layer.

---

## Installing the plugin

```bash
# from the DSH checkout
node tools/virtuoso.mjs config-set vmrun="C:\path\to\vmrun.exe"
node tools/virtuoso.mjs config-set vmx="D:\path\to\guest.vmx"
node tools/virtuoso.mjs config-set guestIp=192.168.1.50
node tools/virtuoso.mjs config-set sshUser=youruser
node tools/virtuoso.mjs health      # proves the CIW answers
```

Then copy `dsh-plugin-virtuoso-layout/` into your DSH profile's `node_modules/` and
restart DSH. `lib/*.js` changes require a restart (HMR only watches patch files).

## Validating without a VM

```bash
node .validate/plugin-test.mjs     # registers all 12 tools against a mock ctx
node .validate/guard-test.mjs      # the write gate: classification / policy / registration
node .validate/context-test.mjs    # token-meter contract, 50 checks
node .validate/job-test.mjs        # background-job payload, 8 checks
node .validate/hint-test.mjs       # error-message mapping
node .validate/paren-check.mjs f.il  # SKILL paren balance
```

---

## Credits and acknowledgements

### Tsinghua University

This project would not exist without the **RAMIC Bridge** SKILL layer, and that comes
from **Tsinghua University**.

*

plugins.description: 我们自己维护、适配 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 的 Codex↔DSH 双向同步插件（派生自 Walvez/dsh-codex-sync，MIT，鸣谢上游）
plugins.readme_text:
# ⚡ dsh-codex-sync **Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from `~/.codex/skills`, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of `mcp_servers`, and a Codex-side reverse MCP installer.**
*2-way project chat sync · Live Skills mount · Auto MCP mirroring · Native modern UI*

English • 简体中文

[![CI](https://github.com/AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/AI8888-SHOP/dsh-codex-sync/actions) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.1--rc.2%20%7C%200.2.0--rc.2-4B32C3?style=flat-square)](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) [![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-%3E%3D20.0-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](package.json) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](LICENSE) > **This repository is our own build of the plugin, adapted to our DSH runtime.** > It is based on / forked from **[Walvez/dsh-codex-sync](https://github.com/Walvez/dsh-codex-sync)** > (MIT © 2026 Walvez) — see [Credits & upstream attribution](#-credits--upstream-attribution). > What we changed and why: [docs/LOCAL-ADAPTATION.md](docs/LOCAL-ADAPTATION.md). > Upstream npm package `dsh-codex-sync` belongs to the original author and is **not** this build.
🎛️ Native Sync Settings Modal
 📍 Sidebar Workspace Trigger
📥 Import from Codex by Project
 📤 Export DSH Chats to Codex
--- ## 🤔 Why dsh-codex-sync? When using OpenAI Codex, developers build up significant workflow assets: 1. **Rich project chat histories** with complete code contexts, architecture decisions, and debugging steps; 2. **Custom Skills libraries** under `~/.codex/skills` with tailored instructions and scripts; 3. **Configured MCP toolchains** for databases, web searches, and browser automation. When adopting or exploring **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**, developers typically face major friction: - **Lost conversation history**: Incompatible session formats prevent resuming past Codex tasks in DSH; - **Configuration duplication and drift**: Skills and MCP servers must be manually recreated and maintained in two separate tools; - **One-way dead ends**: Most migration scripts are one-time destructive copies that offer no clean way to safely bring DSH continuations back to Codex. **`dsh-codex-sync` eliminates this friction completely.** It is not a throwaway migrator, but a production-grade, continuous two-way bridge between Codex and DSH. --- ## ✨ Key Highlights ### 1. 💬 Two-Way Safe Project Chat Portability (Codex ⇄ DSH) - **Import from Codex**: - Browse conversations grouped by workspace folder in an intuitive project tree; - Preserves user prompts, assistant outputs, reasoning traces, and tool-call trajectories; - Automatically attaches imported sessions to matching workspaces for **seamless continuation**; - Incremental re-import: Codex conversations continued after the initial import are marked as `updated` and append only new turns without creating duplicate sessions. - **Export to Codex**: - Export DSH native conversations or continuations back into Codex; - Automatically matches Codex's workspace catalog, gracefully locking unknown directories to prevent orphan threads; - Creates clean, standalone Codex rollouts (`history_mode: legacy`) and SQLite index entries **without modifying or overwriting original Codex histories**; - View and continue chats in Codex immediately after restarting the Codex app. - **Sub-Agent Thread Filtering**: - Hides internal sub-agent threads by default to keep the conversation list focused; - Easily expand and nest sub-agents under parent threads for selective, independent export. ### 2. ⚡ Live First-Class Skills Mounting - Mounts `~/.codex/skills/*/SKILL.md` directly into DSH's native skill catalog; - Full support for nested directory resources and multi-file skill bundles; - **Zero-restart updates**: Edit a skill file on disk, and DSH recognizes the change on the next turn. ### 3. 🔌 Automated Bidirectional MCP Mirroring - **Codex → DSH**: Watches `~/.codex/config.toml` live, dynamically mirroring `[mcp_servers.*]` to DSH with conflict avoidance and stderr silencing; - **DSH → Codex (Reverse Bridge)**: Single-command setup (`npx dsh-codex-sync codex-install`) equips your Codex agent with tools to search, inspect, and install DSH plugins. ### 4. 🎨 Native Modern UI Experience - **Adaptive Sidebar Trigger**: Sits right beside the workspace header when expanded, and aligns below the search button when collapsed;
