plugins.description: Tide & Timber (潮汐木色) — a coastal light/dark theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, built on the official ThemeRuntime alias-token layer.
plugins.readme_text:
# Tide & Timber · 潮汐木色

一套给 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的**海岸线配色主题**：白天的「海盐晨雾」与夜里的「潮汐夜航」，都只通过官方 `ThemeRuntime` 的 `--dsw-alias-*` token 层叠加，不注入壁纸、不改布局、不劫持 DOM。

| Light — Salt & Timber | Dark — Twilight Cove |
| --- | --- |
| ![light](previews/light.png) | ![dark](previews/dark.png) |

> 2026-10-20 已在本机 `~/.dsh/profiles/web` 通过 profile patch + 符号链接热挂载，并用 headless Chromium 做了 light/dark 双模式计算样式与截图验证（详见 `dsh-daily-learning/2026-10-20.md` §4）。

- **Light — Salt & Timber**：暖象牙沙、海玻璃青、浮木墨色。主按钮是深海青，选中/链接是潮水绿。
- **Dark — Twilight Cove**：落潮后的深蓝绿、月光海玻璃、暖铜色状态点。整体低饱和、长时间阅读不刺眼。
- **自适应**：跟随 DSH 自带的 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统 设置，不需要另设开关。
- **可热插拔**：主题注册在 `ctx.effect` 内，禁用插件或热重载会精确撤回这一层 token。

## 安装

需要 DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** 及以上（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 的第三方主题入口在该版本提供）。

```sh
# 直接从仓库安装（当前可用）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zys2026/dsh-theme-tide
```

装完重启 dsh（或在插件管理器里重载），主题会跟随 DSH 自带的「浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统」设置自动切换，不需要额外开关。

**卸载 / 临时停用**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-tide   # 卸载
```

或在插件管理器里把 `dsh-theme-tide` 设为禁用——主题注册在 `ctx.effect` 内，禁用会精确撤回这一层 token，不会残留。

**要求**：主题只通过官方 `--dsw-alias-*` token 覆盖上色，不改布局、不注入壁纸、不劫持 DOM；因此 DSH 升级若增删 token，未覆盖的新 token 会回落到内置默认色，不会破坏界面。

## 设计要点

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 扩展点 | `ctx.theme.overrideTokens(source, tokens)`（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 官方第三方主题入口） |
| 覆盖范围 | 0.2.1-rc.2 声明的全部 **107 个 `--dsw-alias-*`** token，每个都提供 light/dark 一对值 |
| 运行时依赖 | 无；`client.js` 是零依赖 IIFE，不需要 React、three.js 或打包器 |
| 持久化 | 不写设置、不写 localStorage；主题随插件的启用/禁用生效 |
| Host 半侧 | 空（只用于让 Loader 发现 `./client`） |

## 可验证质量（2026-10-20 审计）

`tools/audit.mjs` 会对照官方 token 契约做覆盖率检查，并对 21 组关键「文字/背景」和「图标/背景」组合计算 WCAG 2.x 对比度：

```sh
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs                 # 控制台表格
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --json          # 机器可读
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --write-preview # 写入 previews/audit.md
```

当前结果（light 与 dark 两套）：

- **覆盖率 107/107**：与 `dsh-client-ui-theme@0.2.1-rc.2` 的 alias 清单完全一致（含 `onboarding-checkbox-border`、`settings-card-stroke` 两个边角 token）。
- **必需的 21 组配对全部达到 WCAG AA**（正文/次级/三级/说明文字、链接、代码块、Toast、主按钮、状态色、菜单图标等）。
- 审计还发现并修掉了 3 个真实问题：light 的 `label-tertiary`（4.31→4.78）、`label-caption`（3.06→4.56）、dark 的 `state-warn-label` 与 `state-warn-tertiary` 配色错位（1.36→9.35）。
- `border-l3` / `scrollbar-bg-l1` 与背景的对比度低于 3:1 属**刻意的低对比装饰**（与官方内置主题同量级），审计标记为 advisory，不阻断。

完整报告：[previews/audit.md](previews/audit.md)。

## 安装

### 方式 A：作为 bundle 安装（推荐，持久）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/Users/ys/Documents/deepseek/dsh-theme-tide
```

然后重启 DSH（或让插件管理器在 HMR 开启时热挂载）。插件的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 会插入 `dsh-theme-tide` 行，`dsh.client.immediately` 让它在页面启动时立即应用。

### 方式 B：运行中热挂载（本次会话采用）

1. 把包链接进 profile：
   `ln -s "$(pwd)" ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-theme-tide`
2. 在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 追加：

   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-theme-tide
         name: 'dsh-theme-tide'
         config: {}
   ```

3. `dsh-hmr` 监听 profile patch 变化，会重组合成并热挂载；页面无需重启 Host。
4. 若页面没有自动应用，刷新一次页面即可；Host 重启后该行依然存在。

## 开发

```sh
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/build.mjs             # 生成 client.js
node --check dsh-theme-tide/client.js           # 语法检查
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs             # token 覆盖 + WCAG AA
node dsh-theme-tide/tools/audit.mjs --write-preview  # 更新 previews/audit.md
```

- `src/palette.mjs`：两份完整调色板（唯一需要改的颜色文件）
- `src/official-tokens.json`：0.2.1-rc.2 官方 alias token 契约快照（107 个）
- `src/client.template.js`：浏览器半侧 IIFE 模板
- `tools/build.mjs`：校验两份调色板 key 一致、全部为 `--dsw-alias-*`，注入模板生成 `client.js`
- `tools/audit.mjs`：覆盖率 + WCAG 2.x 对比度审计（零依赖，可复用为通用主题检查器）

## 卸载

删除 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `dsh-theme-tide` insert 行，再删除 profile 的 `node_modules/dsh-theme-tide` 链接即可；页面刷新后恢复默认配色。

## 兼容性

- 构建/验证环境：DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`（`dsh-client-ui-theme` 0.2.1-rc.2，`overrideTokens` 与 `ThemeTokenModes` 契约）。
- 第三方主题 id 属于进程内扩展；本主题刻意**不注册新 theme id**，而是叠加 token 层，因此与官方 Appearance 的 light/dark/system 完全兼容。
- 若未来 DSH 新增 alias token，未覆盖的 token 会回退到内置调色板；在 `src/palette.mjs` 补齐即可。

---

English: **Tide & Timber** is a dependency-free coastal light/dark theme for the DSH Web GUI. It registers a `ThemeRuntime.overrideTokens` layer covering every `--dsw-alias-*` token in 0.2.1-rc.2 (107 tokens, light+dark pairs), follows the built-in Appearance preference, and retracts cleanly when the plugin is disabled or hot-reloaded. No wallpaper, no DOM overrides, no settings writes.

plugins.description: Git status bar for DeepSeek Harness: repo, branch, changes and SHA above the composer, with branch switching and a diff pane.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-git-bar

A DeepSeek Harness bundle that adds one ambient row above the composer showing
the Session's git context:

```
⎇ main · dsh-git-bar · 3 处改动 · ↑2 ↓1 · a1b2c3d
```

![the row, on the same line as the workspace and mode selectors](docs/preview.png)

- repository name and root
- the branch the Session runs on, or `游离 HEAD` / `detached HEAD` when the HEAD
  is not on a branch
- working-tree change totals (staged / unstaged / untracked in the tooltip)
- ahead/behind counts against the upstream branch
- short commit id — clickable, opening that commit on the origin remote
  (GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket commit routes are all handled) — and a
  `链接工作树` / `linked worktree` marker when the directory is a linked
  `git worktree`, or a `N 个工作树` marker when the repository has more than one
- every label is plain text: select it and copy it

The row refreshes every 8 seconds, on window focus, and when the Session
changes. Reading it never touches the repository; two interactions deliberately
do:

- **click the branch** — a searchable popover lists every local branch with its
  upstream, ahead/behind and dirty state, marks the current one, and can check one
  out or create a new branch from the current HEAD;
- **click the change count** — opens the working tree in the right-hand Sidebar
  as a `工作区改动` tab: the changed files, and the unified diff of the file you
  pick, untracked files included (diffed against `/dev/null`);
- **click the worktree marker** — lists every worktree of the repository with its
  branch and change count. `在此新建会话` opens a new Session in that worktree's
  directory (a worktree is a directory, so a Session is never moved between
  them), and `复制路径` copies it. A branch already checked out in another
  worktree is greyed out in the branch popover with the worktree that holds it,
  instead of failing with git's `already checked out` after the click.
- nothing here silently scrolls away: a drag that selects text does not also open
  a popover.

![branch popover](docs/preview-branches.png)

![working tree in the sidebar](docs/preview-changes.png)

## Install

From a Git checkout (pin the commit; add `&path:/plugins/dsh-git-bar` when the
package is not at the repository root):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "git+https://github.com/mjnhmd/dsh-git-bar.git#2d3e0408376127196a4c18e8b1e1c79389a166f5"
```

From npm, or from a local checkout during development:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-git-bar@0.1.0
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/to/plugins/dsh-git-bar
```

The Host half loads at startup, so restart the app after the first install; the
Client half is served on the next page load.

## Publish

Market index (add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**):
<https://mjnhmd.github.io/dsh-git-bar/market/index.json>

DSH ships no index of its own: a plugin market is a JSON file (format 1) you host
yourself and add under **插件 → 发现 → 添加索引源**. `docs/market-index.example.json`
is a ready template, `scripts/validate-index.mjs` checks it against DSH's own
validator, and [docs/PUBLISH.zh.md](docs/PUBLISH.zh.md) walks through pushing the
repository, publishing to npm, and publishing the index.

## Host API

`GET /dsh-git-bar/info?sessionId=<id>[&dir=<absolute path>]`

- admitted through the harness browser session (`ctx.connection.requestRejection`),
  so it is unreachable without the GUI's own credentials;
- the directory comes from the Session store first; `dir` is only a fallback for
  a Session the store does not know, and must be absolute;
- replies with `{ dir, repository: null | { root, name, branch, detached, sha,
  commitUrl, remote, dirty: { changed, staged, unstaged, untracked }, upstream,
  ahead, behind, worktree: { linked, mainRoot, count } } }`;
- `commitUrl` is derived from the `origin` remote: the scp, `ssh://`, `git://`
  and http(s) forms all normalize to `https://host/owner/repo`, and the commit
  route follows the host (GitHub `/commit/`, GitLab `/-/commit/`, Bitbucket
  `/commits/`). A local-path remote yields `null` and the id stays plain text.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/branches?sessionId=<id>` — `{ branches: [{ name, current,
upstream, ahead, behind, subject, checkedOutIn }], dirty }`, where
`checkedOutIn` is the worktree path holding that branch (a branch can only be
checked out in one worktree at a time).

`GET /dsh-git-bar/worktrees?sessionId=<id>` — `{ root, worktrees: [{ path, name,
branch, detached, sha, bare, locked, prunable, main, current, dirty }] }`, each
worktree costing one `status` call for its own change count.

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/checkout` `{ sessionId, branch }` — `{ branch,
created: false }`; 409 when git refuses (local changes, unknown branch).

`POST /dsh-git-bar/branches/create` `{ sessionId, name, from? }` — `{ branch,
created: true }`; the name is validated with `git check-ref-format --branch`.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/changes?sessionId=<id>` — `{ files: [{ path, status, staged,
additions, deletions }], dirty, truncated }`, capped at 500 files.

`GET /dsh-git-bar/diff?sessionId=<id>&path=<repo-relative>&staged=0|1` — `{ path,
staged, diff, truncated }`, capped at 200 000 characters.

Every git call uses an argument array (no shell), a 4 s timeout, and a 256 KiB
buffer cap. Nothing is watched and nothing is cached.

## Layout

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: the read-only JSON route over the `git` executable |
| `client.js` | Client half: the `conversation.input.dock` row, the branch popover, and the Sidebar tab body |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Bundle patch that inserts the `git-bar` row |
| `locale/*.json` | Display metadata for Plugin Manager / Settings |
| `icon.svg` | Plugin icon |
| `docs/PUBLISH.zh.md` | How to distribute the plugin (Git / npm / a market index) |
| `docs/market-index.example.json` | Format-1 market index template |
| `scripts/validate-index.mjs` | Rejects an index the way DSH's reader would |

plugins.description: 任务提示音：DSH 需要确认或一轮结束时播放 Windows 提示音，音效可在设置页挑选并试听
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify — 任务提示音

DSH 需要你、或者一轮活干完的时候，用 **Windows 自己的声音**提醒你一声。
声音由 DSH 的本机进程播放，所以页面在后台、你切到了别的窗口、甚至标签被静音，都还听得见。
音效在**设置 → 任务提示音**里挑，点一下就能试听。

## 它什么时候响

| 时机 | 事件 | 声音 |
|---|---|---|
| 有东西等你点确认（工具授权、权限提升…） | `approval/request` | 「需要你确认时」选的那个 |
| 智能体问了你一个问题 / 等你审计划 | `user-questions/request` | 同上 |
| 主会话一轮跑完 | `agent/status` 由 `running` 变 `idle` | 「任务完成时」选的那个 |

**不会响的情况**：

- 子代理、Agent Teams 成员的会话结束（设置页里可以打开，默认关）；
- 会话只是被创建、或本来就没在跑时收到 `idle` —— 只有「先 running 再 idle」才算一轮结束；
- 两声之间小于「最小间隔」（默认 1200 毫秒）；
- 刚响过「需要确认」后的「静默窗口」内（默认 5000 毫秒），那是同一次卡住，不是两次事件；
- 总开关关掉时。

## 设置页

**设置 → 任务提示音**（在「模型」和「插件」之间）。

- 两块音效，各有一份 Windows 自带音效列表（实时读 `C:\Windows\Media\*.wav`，你机器上现在 63 个）。
  **点名字＝选中并试听，点 ▶＝只试听**。
- 「自定义 wav」一行：填绝对路径（比如 `D:\Sounds\ping.wav`），▶ 试听，`使用` 选中。
  文件不存在会直接告诉你是哪个路径找不到。
- 进阶：子代理是否也响、最小间隔、静默窗口。

配置存在 `C:\Users\Acer\.dsh\storages\dsh-notify.json`，可以直接手改，插件会在 0.5 秒内读到新值。

## 那两声到底是谁在放

一次性的隐藏 `powershell.exe`，脚本用 `-EncodedCommand`（Base64 UTF-16LE）传：
路径里有空格、引号、中文都不会被 shell 重新解释，`windowsHide` 保证不闪黑窗。
找不到 `.wav` 时退回 `[System.Media.SystemSounds]`，跟随你的 Windows 声音方案。

实测：事件发生到出声约 **0.7 秒**（PowerShell 启动开销）。

一个副作用值得知道：**音量合成器里这一项显示为 "Windows PowerShell"**，不是 DSH。
如果你哪天单独静音了某个应用，注意别把它也静了。

## 装 / 卸 / 改

- 安装：`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 指向本目录（首次）或包名 `dsh-notify`（已装过时）。
- 停用：设置 → 插件 里关掉这一行，或 `remove_bundle`。

### 改完必须「完全退出进程」，不是关窗口、也不是刷新页面

这一条值得单独写，因为它白白吃掉了三轮调试：

| 你做的动作 | 浏览器半边 | Host 半边 |
|---|---|---|
| 按 F5 / 重开窗口 | ✅ 会更新 | ❌ 还是旧的 |
| 插件里「禁用 → 启用」 | ✅ | ❌ **还是旧的**（Loader 复用启动时 import 的那一代模块，实测确认） |
| 完全退出 DSH 进程后重开 | ✅ | ✅ |

所以改完 `index.js`（或任何 Host 代码）之后，请**托盘图标右键 → 退出**，确认没有残留进程再打开：

```powershell
Get-Process 'DeepSeek Harness' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```

验证方法：看 `storages\dsh-notify.log` 有没有多出新的一行，比对比进程启动时间和源文件修改时间。
`install_bundle` 对已安装包的改动会明确回 `restart-required` —— 那就是"必须要真重启"的意思。

## 自检（不需要 DSH）

```powershell
node _diag\notify-host-test.mjs      # Host 半边：事件判定 / 节流 / 配置读写 / 试听接口（34 项）
node _diag\notify-client-test.mjs    # 浏览器半边：注册 / 三个渲染分支（23 项）
node _diag\notify-sound-test.mjs     # 直接听某个音效，例如 chimes.wav
```

Host 测试用临时 `DSH_HOME` 和一个静音 wav，所以不会动你的真配置、也不会出声。

## 踩过的坑：一个"注册不上但没人告诉你"的通道

第一版设置页能显示，但一读配置就报 `transport failure for /notify/get: HTTP 405`。
我最初把通道注册写成了这样：

```js
ctx.inject(['connection'], (c) => c.connection.rpc.handle('/notify', handler))   // ✗
```

第一次尝试的修法是补上 `webServer` 注入 —— **没用**，而且暴露了真正的原因。
幸好当时加了一行诊断日志，它把异常原文写了下来：

```
channel /notify registration failed: Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject
    at Fiber.<anonymous> (…dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:656:35)
    at Object.handle (…/lib/index.js:576:39)
```

`rpc.handle()` 里是 `owner.effect(() => owner.webServer.register(route), …)`，而 `owner` 来自
`get rpc() { const owner = this.ctx; … }` —— **`this.ctx` 是这个 service 自己的上下文**（connection 插件那个），
不是"读它的插件"。那个插件的 inject 列表是 `['credentials']`，没有 `webServer`，所以这行**必然抛错**。
换句话说：**在这个版本里 `rpc.handle()` 对插件是不可用的**（DSH 自己也从不调用它，只用不碰 `webServer` 的
`rpc.intercept('/api', …)`；而 `/api` 的拦截器已被 typertGateway 独占，`registerInterceptor` 明确禁止重复注册）。

失败之所以无声，是因为 Cordis 只丢掉抛错的子 fiber，**插件行仍然是 `active`**，页面那一侧只看到一个 405。

**最终用的是插件真能用的那个扩展点** —— `connection.fetch.register()`，它只往 Connection 的精确路由表里加一条，
全程不碰 `owner` 的任何 service：

```js
ctx.inject(['connection'], (c) => c.connection.fetch.register({
  path: '/api/notify.config',          // 必须在 /api 下
  methods: ['POST'],
  requestBody: 'buffered',
  fetch: async (request) => Response.json(await handleEndpoint(…)),
}))
```

路径**必须落在 `/api` 下**：Connection 自己为 `/api` 注册了 prefix 路由，那里做 Host/Origin 校验和
浏览器 Cookie 认证，然后把请求交给 `createSharedFetchHandler('/api')` —— 先查精确路由表，再查拦截器。
所以页面里一句普通的同源 `fetch('/api/notify.config')` 就自带认证，和整个 UI 走的是同一条路
（认证是签名 Cookie，`isAuthenticated()` 读 `cookie` 头，客户端默认就是 `globalThis.fetch`，不额外加头）。

教训：**这类失败不留任何痕迹**，所以 Host 半边每次启动都会往
`C:\Users\Acer\.dsh\storages\dsh-notify.log` 写一行"注册成功/失败 + 堆栈"，设置页遇到 404/405 也会直接点名这个文件。
回归测试里有三项盯着它：路由路径必须在 `/api` 下、声明必须是 POST+buffered、源码里**不得出现 `rpc.handle(`**。

## 实现要点

- `approval/request` 与 `user-questions/request` 是 waterfall 事件：本插件只观察，`next()` 在 try/catch
  **之外**调用且只调用一次 —— 提示音坏掉、甚至事件载荷一读就抛错，也不会让授权流程卡住（测试里专门有这一项）。
- 设置页数据走 `connection.fetch.register()` 的 `/api/notify.config`，浏览器半边用同源 `fetch`
  （不再需要 `connection` 客户端 service，所以 `inject` 只有 `slots` 和 `locale`）。
- 浏览器半边只用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，不 import 任何 DSH 客户端包，不碰 app root，不往 `document.body` 追加东西。

plugins.description: Turn-finished desktop notifications for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x · DSH 完成提醒（宿主投影 + WinRT toast）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notification-desktop

给 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** 用的「一轮跑完就弹系统通知」插件。上游 [`omdsh-dev/dsh-notification`](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-notification) 只覆盖 0.1.1 / 0.1.2 的客户端布局，这个包是它的 0.2.x 移植版。

## 它做什么

- Host 半边注册一个 `notification` 会话投影：折叠每个会话的最后一次 `turn/end`，得到 `{ turn, reason, body, tools }`；再提供一个 `POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify` 路由，用 WinRT 真正把 toast 弹出来。
- Client 半边盯住 `ctx.sessions.list` 里这个投影的 `turn` 单调上升，决定这一轮要不要提醒（原因过滤、后台限制、总开关）；**桌面壳里把内容 POST 给宿主去弹，浏览器里才用页面自己的 `Notification`**。正文是该轮最后一段助手回复（Host 侧截到 400 字符，Client 侧再按设置截一次）。
- 设置页在 **设置 → 完成提醒**：总开关、按结束原因过滤、仅后台提醒、通知常驻、正文长度、权限状态、发测试通知。

投影是纯函数，Host 侧只注册、不碰会话日志以外的任何东西；Client 侧只用公开的 `sessions.list` 快照和 `settings.section` 槽位。

## 相对上游 0.1.4 改了什么

| 上游 | 0.2.x 适配 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.client.inject` 列 `dsh-client-runtime` / `dsh-client-store` / `dsh-client-ui-slots` / `dsh-client-ui-settings` / `dsh-client-locale` | 改成 `inject: []`：`dsh-client-runtime` 在 0.2.x 里根本不存在，而顺序已经由服务 `inject: ['slots','locale']` 和 `ctx.slots.inject()` 表达；少列一个不存在的 id 就少一个模块永远等不到依赖的风险 |
| `ctx.get('sessions').list.getSnapshot()` 取 `{ ids, byId, current }` | 0.2.x 快照是 `{ ids, byId, phase, projectionsBySession }`，行内是 `projectionValues` / `displayTitle` / `retainedBy` |
| 用 `state.current` 判断「正在看的会话」 | 改读 `row.retainedBy.mainView > 0`（0.2.x 的 retention 才是权威） |
| `uiSession.pendingInteractions` 做「等你审批/回答」提醒 | **未移植**：0.2.x 的 `pendingInteraction` 只在 `ui-session` 的 Slot hook 里（`sessionStatus`），不是可订阅的根服务；只做完成边。 |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store` 存设置 | 依赖不可解析，改成 localStorage + 一个自带的极简 observable |
| 设置页用自家 styles/组件 | 只用 React + 宿主主题 CSS 变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），不引外部组件包 |

Host 半边的投影契约（`key` / `stateSchema` / `init` / `apply` / `wire` / `stateVersion`）在 0.2.1-rc.2 里没变，所以 `index.js` 基本是原逻辑。

## 安装

**桌面端（DSH Desktop）**：`desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，CLI 会拒绝写入（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。走应用自己的入口：

- 侧栏 **插件 → 添加插件**，粘贴仓库地址 `https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop`；
- 或让 agent 用宿主内置的 plugin manager 装同一个地址（`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`link:` 本地目录也行）。

**Web / CLI profile**（`dsh web`、headless 等）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop/archive/refs/heads/main.tar.gz
```

装完刷新页面（桌面端要重启应用）：设置里应出现 **完成提醒** 一页。

> Windows 上还要跑一次 `scripts/fix-toast-aumid.ps1`，否则 toast 会被系统静默丢弃 —— 见下面「权限 ≠ 能够显示」。

## 插件市场（Discover）

`market/index.json` 是这个包的 **format 1 插件市场索引**，可以直接在 **插件 → Discover → 添加索引源** 里加：

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop/main/market/index.json
```

条目是 **commit 固定的 git 源**（`git+https://github.com/Adingo001/dsh-notification-desktop.git#<40 位 commit>`），不是移动分支——`marketInstallTarget()` 就是这么拼装的，版本号与 commit 一一对应。

发新版本时重新生成：

```powershell
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = 1
& "D:\ai\DeepSeek Harness.exe" scripts\build-market-index.mjs
```

生成器保留索引里已有的历史版本，只把当前 `package.json` 的版本追加/替换进来，并把 `icon.svg` 复制到 `market/`（索引里的图标是相对引用，按索引 URL 解析）。

索引用 DSH 自带的校验器验过：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index` 的 `parseMarketIndex()`，`format: 1`、`engines.dsh = >=0.2.0 <0.3.0`（`0.2.1-rc.2` 落在范围内）。要让别的市场收录，把这份 `index.json` 的条目提给对应索引维护者即可——格式统一，条目可原样搬运。

## 社区收录状态

DSH 的「市场」不是一个中心，而是几套索引 + 一个 GitHub topic 的生态。当前状态：

| 渠道 | 机制 | 状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bradeGithub/DSH-Plugins-Marketplace`（9500+ 插件，每 2 小时增量扫描） | 抓 GitHub topic `dsh-plugin` | ✅ 已打 topic，最迟 2 小时自动进索引，无需申请 |
| `awesome-dsh-plugin`（社区精选，也是下面几个索引的数据源） | PR 一个 `data/plugins/<owner>__<repo>.yml` | ⏳ 条目已备好（`market/awesome-dsh-plugin.yml`），等仓库创建满 1 天：本仓库 `2026-10-21 09:16 UTC` 建，**`2026-10-22 17:16` 之后**可提 |
| `dsh-market` / `dshmarket`（直接读 awesome 的 `plugins.json`） | 自动跟随 awesome | ⏳ 随上一条 |
| `dsh-plugin-catalog`（jsDelivr 上的 format 1 索引，DSH Discover 官方入口） | 由 awesome 生成 | ⏳ 随上一条 |
| 本仓库 `market/index.json` | 用户自己加索引源 | ✅ 已上线 |

`awesome-dsh-plugin` 的硬门槛（照它的 `contributing.md`）：仓库要有真实代码、`package.json` 必须声明 `dsh.bundle`（只写 `dsh.client` 不算，会被打回）、仓库创建满 1 天。前两条本仓库满足。

> 同分类里已有 `ztl0001/dsh-notify`（也是收尾提醒）。我们这条描述的差异化点写的是**实现事实**：0.2.x 的宿主投影 + 桌面端走宿主 WinRT 发（因为页面里的 `Notification` 在这套壳上会被系统静默丢弃），带按结束原因过滤的设置页。描述与代码对得上，这是那个列表审的核心。

## 桌面端：权限 ≠ 能够显示

两件事必须分开看，实测都踩过：

**1. 权限。** 桌面壳（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop` 0.2.1-rc.2）给主窗口装的权限处理器，对**非 media** 权限是 `callback(true)` / `check → true`（见 `installMicrophonePermissions`）；被一律拒掉的是第三方登录窗口和 browser-use 的独立 partition。所以主窗口里 `Notification.permission` 实测就是 `granted`，不需要主进程加 IPC。

**2. Windows 的 toast 呈现。** 权限给了、`new Notification()` 也返回成功，**照样可能一个都不显示**，而且是两层原因叠在一起：

- **AUMID 没人注册。** Electron 在 Windows 上把 renderer 的通知按 AppUserModelID 归属；桌面壳的 `main.js` 里 `setAppUserModelId` 出现次数是 **0**，Chromium 退回默认值 `electron.app.DeepSeek Harness`，而开始菜单快捷方式的 `System.AppUserModelID` 是空串 —— 这个 AUMID 指向不到任何已注册应用。Windows 照样记账（`HKCU\...\Notifications\Settings\electron.app.DeepSeek Harness` 的 `LastNotificationAddedTime` 会更新）但**静默丢弃 toast**，通知中心里连留底都没有。
- **即使 AUMID 补齐了，Chromium 这条 presenter 仍然不放行。** 同一个 AUMID 下用 WinRT 直接发就能显示，页面里 `new Notification()` 发就还是不显示。所以桌面端不让页面发，改成页面 POST 给宿主、宿主用 WinRT 发（`POST /dsh-notification-desktop/notify`）。

两步都做上才算通：

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\fix-toast-aumid.ps1
# 撤销：加 -Remove
```

它写两个键，都不碰壳、不碰 asar、不碰快捷方式：

- `HKCU\Software\Classes\AppUserModelId\<AUMID>`（DisplayName + IconUri）—— 让 Windows 认这个 AUMID。
- `HKCU\Software\Classes\dshnotify`（URL Protocol + handler）—— **点通知能把窗口拉回前台**。

### 点通知回到前台

toast 带 `activationType="protocol" launch="dshnotify:focus"`，点它时 Windows 跑上面注册的 handler，把 `DeepSeek Harness` 的主窗口提到前台。抢前台要绕开 Windows 的前台锁，所以是三级降级、每级都校验：

1. `AttachThreadInput` 借前台线程的输入队列 → `BringWindowToTop` → `SetForegroundWindow`
2. `SwitchToThisWindow`
3. `SW_MINIMIZE` → `SW_RESTORE`（还原的窗口会拿到激活权）→ 再 `SetForegroundWindow`

**handler 不能闪黑框。** 控制台程序（`powershell.exe`）在能隐藏自己之前就已经被加载器创建了控制台窗口，所以 `-WindowStyle Hidden` 也挡不住闪一下。因此：

- 有 C# 编译器时，`fix-toast-aumid.ps1` 把 `scripts/focus-dsh.cs` 编成 **`scripts/focus-dsh.exe`**（`/target:winexe` = GUI 子系统，压根没有控制台），协议直接指向它；
- 没有编译器时退到 **`wscript.exe`**（GUI 宿主）跑 `scripts/focus.ps1` 的隐藏 PowerShell —— 同样不闪。

两个产物都在 `.gitignore` 里（构建物不入库），换机器装的时候由注册脚本现编。

为什么不用 `activationType="foreground"`：那需要给 AUMID 注册一个 `ToastActivatorCLSID` COM 服务器（还要处理 `-ToastActivated` 命令行），而桌面壳不提供；协议激活只需要一个 HKCU 注册表项。

handler 里写的是**本 checkout 的绝对路径**，所以挪动插件目录后要重跑一次 `fix-toast-aumid.ps1`。

> **两个 PowerShell 坑（都实测踩过，都会静默失败）**
>
> 1. `[Type]::Static($x).Method()` 这种**在静态方法结果上继续调方法**的写法，Windows PowerShell 5.1 直接解析失败；配上 `stdio: 'ignore'` 就是"退出码 0、什么也没发生"。必须拆成 `$notifier = [Type]::Static($x)` 然后 `$notifier.Method()`。宿主侧现在会收集子进程 stdout/stderr 并写进 trace（`host-notify-result`），失败不再无声。
> 2. `powershell -File` 执行**无 BOM 的 UTF-8** 脚本会按 GBK 解析，中文字面量变成"锟斤拷"。所以 `scripts/toast.ps1` 是纯 ASCII，用户可见文本一律通过 UTF-8 JSON 文件传进去。

## 已知边界

- 不提醒「等你审批 / 等你回答」这类挂起交互（原因见上）。
- 页面必须在跑：判定发生在页面里，页面关了就没有；桌面端只是把"弹"这一步交给宿主。
- `turn/end` 的 `forked` / `interrupted` 也会推进投影的 `turn`（这样客户端去重不会漏轮），但默认只在 `completed` / `error` 上弹。
- 诊断用：Host 半边注册了 `GET/POST/DELETE /dsh-notification-desktop/trace`，客户端把每次闸门判断 POST 进去。排查"为什么不弹"直接 `Invoke-WebRequest http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-notification-desktop/trace` 就能看到 `apply` / `seed` / `tick` / `skip` / `fire` / `deliver` / `host-notify` / `host-notify-result` 记录 —— 一次真实排查就是靠这条链定位到上面两个坑的。

## 验证

`tests/client-harness.mjs` 用一个假模块加载器 + 假 React + 假 cordis ctx + 假 `Notification` 跑完整个客户端半边：模块 id、导出、locale 字典、`settings.section` 注册、设置页渲染（并检查没有漏翻的 key），以及通知闸门（首帧播种、后台限制、原因过滤、`forked` 跳过、总开关、权限拒绝）。

```powershell
# 没有 node 在 PATH 上时，用 Harness 自己的 Electron 当 node
$env:ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE = 1
& "D:\ai\DeepSeek Harness.exe" .\tests\client-harness.mjs
```

Host 侧的投影折叠（累积文本、工具去重、正文截断、turn 单调推进）另有同款 node 直跑测试覆盖。

## 许可

MIT。上游 0.1.4 也是 MIT，本包为其 0.2.x 移植。

plugins.description: Multi-model task dispatch and Web task board for DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# Conductor for DeepSeek Harness

Multi-model task dispatch for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): keep the
flagship model on decomposition, review, and integration, and route implementation work to
user-configured executor roles. Each task runs as a real DSH child agent with the full toolset,
so it can read code, edit files, run tests, and report back.

The project ships two DSH bundles:

- **`dsh-conductor`** — Host plugin: `dispatch_tasks`, `wait_tasks`, `task_result`, `task_followup`,
  `cancel_task`, `list_executors`; role persistence; same-origin HTTP bridge for the UI.
- **`dsh-conductor-ui`** — Web UI: a composer-toolbar launcher, a right-sidebar task-board tab, a
  full native task-board page, and an **Executors & publisher** editor.

## Why

Manually copying work between a strong planning model and cheaper execution models is slow and
error-prone. Conductor keeps the lead in the conversation while executors do the work, and it lets
the **user** — not the model — decide which model each role uses.

- Roles-only routing by default: the flagship may only dispatch to configured roles; it cannot
  invent provider/model routes.
- The publisher (flagship) is chosen explicitly and can be applied as DSH's default model for new
  sessions.
- Results are collected by the lead (`wait_tasks`), reviewed against acceptance criteria, and
  corrected through `task_followup` — the executor keeps its prior conversation.
- The full task board lives in the DSH Web UI as a native panel (no iframe, no separate server).

## Features

- Dispatch one or many tasks, with role, context, constraints, acceptance criteria, and a required
  return format.
- Fixed executor roles: `id + name + provider + model + description`, editable in the Web UI.
- Persistent roles at `$DSH_HOME/conductor/roles.json` (no API keys in this file).
- Strict roles-only routing: `inherit: true` and ad-hoc provider/model routes are rejected unless the
  user explicitly enables ad-hoc routes. Role changes are audited to
  `$DSH_HOME/conductor/role-audit.jsonl` and exposed by `GET /conductor/roles/audit`.
- A global cap of 5 live subagent activations, covering Conductor tasks and native subagents.
- A per-session right-sidebar board opened from the composer toolbar, plus a global full-page board
  with active/done/failed columns.
- Per-executor context accounting: usage percentage, turns since the last compaction, and automatic
  compaction at 40% of the model context window after a task settles. New tasks still start fresh,
  so task isolation is preserved. Each role can override the threshold.
- Green unread badges on the Tasks icon and the Executors tab after a compaction.
- Follow-ups are shown as **reworking/running** in the board and return to completed when the child
  is inactive.
- Executor completions are delivered to the publisher as background subagent notices, even if the
  publisher has already replied to the user.
- Board snapshot/restore: `GET /conductor/export` and `POST /conductor/import` preserve terminal
  tasks and reports across a plugin reload.
- Executor failures such as `max-tokens` or an empty closing report are surfaced as task errors.
- Executor reports are fact-only: no whole files, full diffs, or generated artifacts; no
  recommendations or next-step suggestions. The lead makes decisions; reports keep the key facts
  and may close with a concise conclusion.
- Publisher task guidance prefers file paths and a short `context`; long documents and code belong
  in files the executor can read.
- Native `subagent` / `subagent_fork` spawn tools are disabled in the `ptc` preset; the publisher
  delegates only through `dispatch_tasks`. `list_agents` remains available for diagnostics, and the
  `maxActiveSubagents: 5` safety cap is unchanged.
- Cancel, follow up, and inspect full reports from the UI or from the model's tools.
- No build step, no npm runtime dependencies; the UI uses only the browser React module table.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness (tested with `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- At least one model provider configured in **Settings → Models**, with credentials stored by DSH.
- A DSH profile that can install local bundles (the default Desktop profile can).

## Install

Install both bundles from npm, using DSH's Plugin Manager
(**Settings → Plugins → install bundle**) or the CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin install @dippingorange/dsh-conductor
dsh plugin install @dippingorange/dsh-conductor-ui
```

For local development, install the checkout instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/dippingOrange/dsh-conductor.git
dsh plugin install /path/to/dsh-conductor/dsh-conductor
dsh plugin install /path/to/dsh-conductor/dsh-conductor-ui
```

Refresh the Web UI once after installing. Both plugins can be enabled or disabled independently.

## Context budget and compaction

Executor tasks remain isolated: every `dispatch_tasks` call starts a new child, so a new task never
inherits another task's context. The only reused context is `task_followup`.

After a task settles (including a follow-up), Conductor reads the child's last request usage and
model context window. If usage is at least **40%** (the default tuned for DeepSeek's observed
quality drop), it resumes the child session, calls the Host
compaction service (the same backend as `/compact`), records the post-compaction usage, and
releases the session. The next follow-up cold-resumes the compacted history. A new task starts from
a fresh child and therefore has no context to compact.

Each executor's latest task reports its context percentage and turns since the last compaction in
**Executors & publisher** and on the task card. A successful compaction sets a green unread dot on
the left **Tasks** icon and on the **Executors & publisher** tab; opening those views clears it.

Config keys:

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `contextCompactionPercent` | `40` | Compact when the last request used this percentage of the window; a role can override it |
| `contextWindowTokens` | `128000` | Fallback when the provider reports no context window |
| `contextWindowMax` | `0` | Optional cap for percentage calculations; `0` uses the reported window |
| `compactionTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Abort a compaction attempt after this long |

The bundle re-enables the host compaction backend (`compaction-basic` / `command-compact`), because
the Web app leaves it to presets by default. That also makes `/compact` available for normal chat.

## Configure

1. **Settings → Models** — add the providers you want to use (OpenAI-compatible relay,
   Anthropic-compatible relay, OpenCode Zen, Command Code, or a self-hosted vLLM/Ollama endpoint).
2. Open the **Tasks** panel from the left sidebar, or click the `▦` button at the left of the
   composer toolbar.
3. Switch to **Executors & publisher**:
   - choose the publisher (flagship) model;
   - add executor roles and fix each role's provider/model;
   - leave **Allow ad-hoc provider/model** off to keep routing roles-only;
   - save.
4. Ask the flagship to dispatch work by role, for example:

   > Split this feature by module. Implement with `coder`, review with `reviewer`, and give every
   > task acceptance criteria and a return format. Collect the reports and check them.

## How it works

```
user ──chat──▶ flagship (publisher)
                 │ dispatch_tasks(role + task + acceptance + return format)
                 ▼
        ┌────────┴────────┐
        │ executor role A │  real DSH child agent (tools, cwd, permissions)
        │ executor role B │  fixed provider/model chosen by the user
        └────────┬────────┘
                 │ report
                 ▼
            flagship reviews and may task_followup
```

- Children are started with `delivery: 'caller'`, so the lead owns result aggregation instead of
  receiving one chat notice per child.
- Completed children free their activation slot; `task_followup` cold-resumes the same session.
- The Web UI talks to the Host over same-origin `/conductor/*` endpoints.

## Security

- The `/conductor/*` endpoints are same-origin and unauthenticated, like the rest of the local DSH
  Web UI. **Do not expose the DSH W

plugins.description: Conversation turn rail for the DSH Web UI: one tick per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, plus a scroll-position indicator. 会话左侧刻度滑轨：悬停预览、点击跳转。
plugins.readme_text:
对话长了以后，回到「某一个问题的位置」不该靠运气。
一列刻度，悬停看当时问了什么，点一下跳过去。

English · 中文

## 先看效果

悬停任意刻度 → 变长、上下相邻两根略长；卡片显示轮次与提问原文。

最左侧细进度条：拖拽或点击按比例跳转。

## 它解决什么 长会话里，`Ctrl+F` 是找词，不是找位置。想回到三步之前那个问题，只能一路往上滚，或者反复点「加载更早」翻到眼熟为止。 **dsh-turn-rail** 在对话区左缘放一列短横线：**一条线 = 你发出的一个问题**。悬停看到当时问了什么，点击直接过去。它只做这一件事——不加设置项，不加面板，不加后台任务。 ### 四个细节 | | | |---|---| | **目标不在当前页也能跳** | 历史是虚拟列表，翻走了的节点不在 DOM 里。点击时它会驱动宿主自己的「加载更早」把那一页翻回来，再定位过去（预算 6 秒，按钮消失即认定历史到头） | | **同一句话发两次也不会跳错** | 定位用的是消息锚点 `data-chat-anchor-key`，不是文本匹配 | | **知道你在哪** | 你正在看的那一轮始终是蓝色长刻度，随滚动实时移动 | | **不挡字** | 刻度压到正文时自动向左让位（最多 14px），退无可退才隐藏 | ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail ``` 装完 **硬刷新浏览器**（Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R）。 > `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名，桌面版通常是 `desktop`。 ## 为什么它这么轻 这个插件的核心约束是**不被宿主替掉**。 DSH 里做同类功能的插件大多走「客户端 `inject: [..., 'remote']` → RPC 读会话日志」这条路。0.2.x 的客户端 API 换过一轮，那条路整体失效——表现是插件装好了、页面上什么都没有。 `dsh-turn-rail` 只依赖两样在 UI 层长期稳定的东西： ```text [data-conversation-scroll] 对话滚动视口 [data-chat-flow-kind="user"|"steering"] 你发出的提问节点 ``` 分页复用宿主自己的「加载更早」按钮，不自己读日志、不自己发请求。没有宿主服务依赖、没有后台进程、没有设置面板、没有任何存储。 ## 边界 - 只在 Web GUI 的「对话」视图渲染，切到轨迹 / 子代理视图自动隐藏。 - 被宿主压缩（compaction）掉的历史不在 DOM 里，刻度也不会包含——不伪造历史。 - 若宿主未来改动上面两个 DOM 契约，刻度会整体不显示（安静失败，不影响对话）。修复点集中在 [`lib/client.js`](./lib/client.js) 顶部的 `SEL` 常量。 ## 项目结构 ```text dsh-turn-rail/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 清单 ├── cordis.patch.yml # 挂载到 profile 的一行 ├── index.js # 宿主端：空实现（滑轨完全在浏览器侧） ├── lib/client.js # 全部逻辑：样式、布局、悬停、跳转、进度 └── assets/readme/ # 封面与截图 ``` 没有构建步骤：`lib/client.js` 就是最终产物（`__ModuleLoader__.load` bundle 格式）。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail dsh plugin --profile web add link:./dsh-turn-rail # 改 lib/client.js，重启 DSH 即生效 ``` ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 shrek wu · English version: [`README.en.md`](./README.en.md)

plugins.description: Screenshot capture for the DSH composer: region capture and hide-window capture from the + menu, landing in the chat input as an image attachment.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-screenshot-chat

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Screenshot** entry to the chat composer's **`+` menu**, so a region captured on your Mac lands in the input box as an image attachment.

## Features

- **One-click region capture** — opens the native macOS selection overlay (the same one as `⇧⌘4`), and the selected region arrives in the current conversation's composer as an **image attachment**, ready to send with your next message. Pressing `Esc` or right-clicking cancels silently.
- **Hide-window capture** — hover the *Screenshot* row and a small toggle appears on the right (`○ Hide window`). Turn it on and the window that is frontmost when you click is hidden first, then the selection overlay appears; when the capture finishes or is cancelled, the window is restored and brought back to the front.
- **Mode is remembered** — the toggle state is stored in `localStorage` and survives page reloads. While it is on, the menu item's description also shows the active mode, so you can see it without hovering.
- **Platform-aware** — the menu entry is hidden automatically on platforms without `screencapture` (anything other than macOS).

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-screenshot-chat
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness (or reload the web client) so the bundle is composed.

### Local development

Point a profile at a checkout instead of the published package:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-screenshot-chat": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-screenshot"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-screenshot-chat"] } }
}
```

Run `pnpm install` in the profile. With HMR enabled, config changes apply immediately; otherwise restart DSH. Host-side edits (`index.js`) take effect after touching the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (any change re-composes the tree without a restart); client-side edits (`client.js`) are hot-replaced by the client HMR poll.

## Usage

1. Click **`+` → Screenshot** in the composer.
2. Drag to select a region on screen.
3. The capture appears in the composer as an image attachment — send it as usual.

To capture without the DSH window in the shot, hover the menu entry, switch on **Hide window**, then click *Screenshot*. The window disappears during selection and comes back afterwards.

## Configuration

Override the defaults from your profile patch, keyed by the plugin id:

```yaml
- id: dsh-screenshot-chat
  name: 'dsh-screenshot-chat'
  config:
    timeoutMs: 180000   # how long the region selection may stay open
```

## How it works

### Host side (`index.js`)

Registers same-origin routes under `/.dsh-screenshot` on the host web server:

- `POST /capture` with body `{ "hide": true | false }`
  - Runs `screencapture -i -x -o <tempfile>`, waits for the selection, then returns the PNG as base64 and deletes the temp file immediately. A cancelled selection returns `{ cancelled: true }`.
  - With `hide: true` it first resolves the **frontmost process name** through AppleScript (System Events) and hides it (the equivalent of `⌘H`, with a system-level denylist — Finder, Dock, System Settings and friends are never hidden), waits for the hide animation to settle (350 ms), then captures. A `finally` block restores and re-focuses the window whether the capture succeeded, was cancelled, or timed out.
- `GET /health` lets the browser half probe platform support (the entry is hidden off macOS).

Only one capture may run at a time. A capture that stays open longer than `timeoutMs` (default 180 s) is terminated, and `osascript` calls time out after 60 s.

### Browser side (`client.js`)

Contributes a `screenshot` command to the `+` menu through `commandUi.register` (`kind: 'action'`, so a click runs the current mode). A document-level `mouseover` delegate spots the menu row carrying the `data-dsc-icon` marker and mounts the hover toggle inside it, using native listeners and inline styles so it does not depend on the menu component's internal class names. `mousedown` and `click` on the toggle stop propagation so the row is not selected.

The returned image is wrapped in a `File` and handed to `conversation.createDrafts` plus the composer's `addFiles` — the exact same attachment path as pasting an image, so previews, size limits, and upload encoding all run through the host's existing logic.

## Permissions (macOS)

1. **Screen Recording** — the first capture may prompt for authorization, or grant it under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording** for the app running the DSH host. Without it, captures can come out as wallpaper only.
2. **Automation** (hide-window capture only) — hiding and restoring the window uses System Events, so macOS asks to allow controlling System Events on first use; the same switch lives under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation**. Denying it leaves plain region capture working; hide-window capture shows an authorization hint instead.

## Limitations

- Interactive region selection relies on macOS `screencapture -i`, so the plugin works on macOS only; the menu entry hides itself elsewhere.
- Capture runs on the Mac hosting the DSH process, not on the machine running the browser. For a local deployment these are the same machine.
- *Hide window* hides whichever app is frontmost at the moment you click. If you switch to another app immediately after clicking, that app is the one hidden.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Legacy name; moved to dsh-preview-blender
plugins.readme_text:
> **Renamed:** the canonical package is now [`dsh-preview-blender`](https://github.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-preview-blender). This repository is kept as the legacy 0.1.x home.

﻿# dsh-blend-preview

Preview Blender **`.blend`** files inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): the right-Sidebar document preview turns the scene into an interactive 3D viewport (orbit / zoom / wireframe) with a scene-information panel, instead of the built-in “binary file, no preview” empty state.

![The preview inside the DSH right Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview/main/docs/blender-preview.png)

## What it does

- Registers a document-preview renderer for `.blend` files, so clicking one in **Workspace files** opens it in the right Sidebar.
- Runs `blender --background` once per file version to export a **GLB** plus a scene JSON (objects, triangles, materials, real-world size in mm, units, cameras, lights, collections).
- Draws the GLB with a small **dependency-free WebGL viewer** written for this plugin: orbit, pan, wheel zoom, double-click reset, wireframe mode, auto-rotate, a soft contact shadow and an axis triad. No CDN, no three.js.
- Caches conversions under `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview`; the second open is instant (a few milliseconds).
- Shows the scene facts that matter for CAD/3D-printing work: per-object triangle counts and bounding-box sizes in millimetres, material swatches, scene units.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (declared compatible with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- **Blender 3.6 / 4.x / 5.x** installed. The plugin auto-detects `DSH_BLENDER`, `BLENDER_PATH`, `blender` on `PATH`, the Steam library, and `C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender*`. Set `blenderPath` if your install lives elsewhere.
- A browser/GPU with WebGL (the DSH desktop app always has it).

## Install

```sh
# into a normal (non-desktop) profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blend-preview

# the desktop profile is owned by the Electron app; add it there through the
# plugin manager UI, or compose it manually and restart the app
```

The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so installation adds the plugin row automatically. Restart DSH after installing.

## Configuration

Settings → Plugins → **Blender preview** (namespace `blend-preview`):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the renderer and the conversion route. |
| `routePath` | `/api/blend-preview` | Authenticated conversion route. Must stay under `/api`; otherwise the authenticated fence is bypassed, so it falls back to the default. |
| `extensions` | `["blend"]` | Suffixes that open in the 3D preview. |
| `blenderPath` | `""` (auto) | Absolute path of `blender.exe` / `blender`. |
| `cacheDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview` | Where exported GLB files and scene JSON live. |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | Wall-clock ceiling for one cold conversion. |
| `maxBytes` | `1073741824` | Largest `.blend` converted (1 GiB). |
| `applyModifiers` | `true` | Apply modifiers during export, so the preview matches what Blender renders. |
| `cacheEntries` | `24` | Cached conversions kept on disk before the oldest are pruned. |

## How it works

```
Workspace file click
        │
        ▼
document preview body (lib/client.js)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=info   (scene JSON)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=glb    (model bytes)
        ▼
Host half (lib/index.js, lib/route.js)
        │  cache key = sha1(realpath, size, mtime, recipe, modifiers)
        ▼
lib/blender.js ── spawn blender --background --python lib/scene.py
        │            → model.glb + scene.json (+ meta.json)
        ▼
~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview/<key>/
```

- `lib/scene.py` exports with `export_apply`, `use_visible`, **Y-up**, no cameras/lights, and writes the scene description (world-space AABBs through the evaluated depsgraph, Principled base colours converted to sRGB swatches).
- The route lives under `/api`, so the connection service authenticates every request (Host/Origin fence + session cookie). Arbitrary local files are not exposed.
- The viewer is a hand-written glTF 2.0 subset renderer (POSITION + NORMAL, indexed triangles, PBR factors, node TRS/matrix). Textures, skinning and animation are out of scope; the Host only exports still scenes.

## Development

```
dev/client-body.js   client UI (single CJS factory for the DSH module loader)
dev/viewer.js        the WebGL renderer, spliced into the bundle at build time
scripts/build-client.mjs   builds lib/client.js from the two files
scripts/e2e-browser.mjs    Playwright end-to-end against a temporary DSH host
scripts/live-selftest.mjs  cold/warm/concurrent conversion against a real .blend
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`lib/client.js` is generated — edit the files under `dev/` and rebuild. The DSH client loader hands the bundle a `require` limited to the platform seed modules, so the package cannot pull a renderer dependency at runtime; the single generated file is the intended shape.

## Notes and limits

- A cold conversion takes roughly 2–10 s for a small scene (Blender startup dominates); it is cached per file version, so rotating/zooming never re-runs Blender.
- Very large scenes (millions of triangles) export slowly and may exceed `timeoutMs`.
- Textures are not shown in the viewport (base colours only); the Blender renders next to the file are still the reference.
- Nothing is uploaded: Blender runs locally and the GLB stays in the local cache.

plugins.description: 深鲸记忆：跨会话热记忆 + 记忆体检/瘦身/记忆包。本地明文、零依赖、不上传数据。
plugins.readme_text:
# 深鲸记忆体检 · dsh-memory-doctor

![面板](./docs/panel.png)


> 跨会话记忆的**体检 / 瘦身 / 记忆包**。本地明文、零依赖、不上传任何数据。

## 它解决什么

现在大多数记忆插件都在解决「**记住**」。但用久了真正的问题变成：

- 记忆越写越满（运行时记忆有硬上限），到点就被动归档
- 同一条记了两遍、内容差不多但措辞不同
- 「临时/进度」类内容混进长期记忆，占着预算
- 换电脑、团队协作时，记忆带不走

本插件补的就是这三件事，**不改你现有的记忆文件格式**（`~/.mnemon/runtime/` 下的 MEMORY.md / USER.md），
所以它可以和现有记忆插件共存。

## 它自己就是热记忆（不是配件）

每轮对话都会把 `MEMORY.md`（项目/环境记忆）和 `USER.md`（用户画像）**注入 system prompt**，
并附带「记忆维护协议」——所以 Agent 真的会记住，而且知道什么时候该写、写去哪、别重复写。

- 注入预算默认 6000 字符，超了截断并提示归档（不会把上下文吃光）
- 记忆是**明文 Markdown**（`~/.mnemon/runtime/`），你自己随时能看、能改、能带走
- Agent 用自带的写文件工具维护记忆，不需要额外工具调用

> ⚠️ 与 `dsh-mnemon` 等记忆插件**二选一**：都用会重复注入。只想用本插件的体检/记忆包时，
> 可以保留 mnemon 但把本插件注入关掉（后续版本会加开关）。

## 功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **体检** | 用量百分比、条目数、重复/近重复、低信息量、临时进度类，一次说清 |
| **瘦身** | 按勾选归档到 `archived/`（**先备份、只移动、不删除**，可回滚） |
| **记忆包** | 一键导出 `~/.mnemon/记忆包-日期-xxxx/`（含 manifest.json、文档、git 版本），可换机/团队共享/留档 |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-memory-doctor
```

- 面板安装需要本机有 `pnpm`（DSH 的安装器依赖它）
- 没有 pnpm 也行：下载仓库 → 把整个文件夹放进 `dsh-home/plugins/` → 重启 DeepWhale Desktop
- 装好后侧栏出现「记忆体检」图标；命令 `/记忆` 可用

## 使用

- 面板：侧栏「记忆体检」图标 → 看用量、勾选、归档、导出
- 命令：`/记忆` → 一句话看健康度

## 安全

- 只读写 `~/.mnemon/`；**不做删除**（归档 + 备份）
- 不联网、不上传；无遥测

## 未知边界

- 目前瘦身只处理 `MEMORY.md`（`USER.md` 是人格画像，建议人工编辑）
- 记忆包导入为**追加合并**，不与现有条目冲突时才加

---

plugins.description: 繁體中文（台灣）language pack for DeepSeek Harness — generated from shipped dictionaries with OpenCC (s2twp) + TW usage polish; 63 namespaces / 2,676 strings.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lang-zhtw

繁體中文（台灣）language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).
简体中文版本见 [README.zh-TW.md](README.zh-TW.md)（繁中）。

It registers **繁體中文（台灣）** in the client language selector by converting the Simplified Chinese UI dictionaries that ship with DSH, using [OpenCC](https://github.com/BYVoid/OpenCC) (`s2twp`, characters plus Taiwan phrasing) and a small TW-usage polish table. Anything not covered automatically falls back to the built-in Simplified dictionary — installing this pack never breaks anything.

- Current coverage: **63 namespaces / 2,676 strings** extracted from the shipped UI dictionaries of DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
- Pure language pack: one client module, no Host services, no build step required at runtime.

## Install

### Desktop app

1. `git clone https://github.com/Grasseed/dsh-lang-zhtw`
2. In DSH Desktop: sidebar **Plugins** → **Add plugin** → point at the cloned folder.
3. Open **Settings → General → Language** and choose **繁體中文（台灣）**.

### Open-source CLI (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Grasseed/dsh-lang-zhtw
```

(The desktop profile is managed by the Electron app itself; use the in-app Plugins panel there.)

### Manual profile patch (advanced)

Add one line to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: lang-zhtw
      name: '/absolute/path/to/dsh-lang-zhtw/index.js'
```

Absolute-path rows are imported directly as ES modules, and Node cannot import a bare directory — point at `index.js`, not the folder. Removing the block uninstalls the pack.

## How it works

The pack only uses the official language-pack API ([`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)):

```js
ctx.locale.addLanguage({ id: 'zh-TW', label: '繁體中文（台灣）', fallback: 'zh' })
ctx.locale.register(ns, 'zh-TW', dict) // for each namespace
```

Lookups follow `zh-TW → zh → en`, so untranslated keys fall back safely.

## Known limits

- A few strings live in component-inline text maps that don't go through the locale registry (e.g. the long "mode explanation" guide text); those fall back to Simplified Chinese and can only be fixed upstream.
- Terminology comes from OpenCC's Taiwan phrasing plus a maintained polish table (e.g. `权限 → 權限`, `计划 → 計畫`, `扩展 → 擴展`). Tune the table in `tools/build-plugin.mjs` to taste.
- Dictionaries are version-specific; regenerate after a DSH upgrade (see below).

## Regenerating for a new DSH version

```sh
# 1. unpack the installed app (macOS example)
npx -y @electron/asar extract "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/app.asar" /tmp/dsh-asar-x
# 2. harvest every locale dictionary via its register() call sites
node tools/extract-dicts4.mjs /tmp/dsh-asar-x/dsh
# 3. convert with OpenCC and re-emit client.js (run `npm install` once first)
node tools/build-plugin.mjs
```

## License

MIT © 2026 Grasseed

plugins.description: Windows 11 toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness: approvals, questions, errors, finished turns, and work that stopped making progress
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

Windows 11 native toast notifications for DeepSeek Harness.

Work keeps running while you are looking at something else. A turn that is
blocked on an approval, has died on an error, or has quietly stopped making
progress looks exactly like a turn that is still thinking. This plugin turns each
of those transitions into a Windows toast, and clicking a toast brings the DSH
window back to the front.

| Situation | Toast |
|---|---|
| A tool call waits for your approval | **DSH 需要你的授权** — the tool and its reason, with *打开 DSH* / *知道了* buttons |
| DSH asks you a structured question | **DSH 需要你的选择** — the question header and the question itself |
| A turn or a session fails | **DSH 出错了** — the error text |
| The account needs a sign-in | **DSH 账号需要处理** |
| A turn that ran longer than `minRunSeconds` finishes | **DSH 已完成** — how long it took |
| A running turn shows no progress for `stallSeconds` | **DSH 可能卡住了** — how long it has been silent |

Approvals and questions use a long-lived toast that stays in Action Center, so a
request you missed is still there when you come back.

The copy above is the shipped default (`locale: zh`). Set `locale: en` for English
toast text; the table is only illustrating which events raise a toast, not a required
language.

## Shipped policy: only what needs you

The defaults interrupt you for exactly one class of event — **work that is
blocked on you**: an approval, a question, an account that needs a sign-in, or a
failure. The last two rows of the table above are implemented and tested but
**off by default**:

```yaml
notifyOnIdle: false    # a long turn finished
notifyOnStall: false   # a running turn stopped showing progress
```

Turn both on if you would rather hear that a long turn *completed*, or that it
went quiet:

```yaml
notifyOnIdle: true
notifyOnStall: true
minRunSeconds: 20      # shorter turns stay silent
stallSeconds: 240      # silence before the "may be stuck" hint
```

A blocking toast can also be nudged once if nobody answers it:

```yaml
escalateAfterSeconds: 90   # 0 disables it, which is the default
```

The nudge re-draws the same toast with a `reminder` sound and a "仍未处理" title,
so Action Center still holds exactly one entry for that request rather than
accumulating reminders.

## Commands

```
/notify mute [分钟]   # 静音；不带分钟数则直到 unmute
/notify unmute
/notify status        # 静音状态 + 传输统计
/notify test          # 立刻发一条自检通知
```

A mute is a moment rather than a setting, which is why it is a command instead of
a config key: it has to start the instant a meeting does and end when it ends. A
mute stops new interruptions; it never blocks the redraw that retires a toast you
already answered, because leaving a stale one on screen is worse than the
interruption it would have caused.

`/notify test` and `/notify status` are also how you check the transport without
waiting for a real event to occur.

## Batching and progress

Two opt-in behaviours change *when* you are told things, so both are off by
default — the shipped policy is to tell you the moment something needs you.

```yaml
aggregateWindowSeconds: 20   # a burst becomes one toast naming the count
progressAfterSeconds: 120    # a long turn announces that it is still running
progressRefreshSeconds: 60   # ... and keeps the elapsed time current
```

A burst summarises into the category's tag, so successive bursts replace one
another instead of stacking, and the summary carries the freshest detail plus the
count. **Blocking requests never enter the window**: something that needs an
answer appears immediately, however many arrive at once.

The progress toast carries an indeterminate bar, because an agent turn has no
known completion fraction — the honest signal is "still going", plus how long.
It is silent, refreshes under its own tag, and is rewritten as *finished* when the
turn ends rather than being left claiming work is ongoing. Because the focus gate
applies to it too, a refresh suppressed while you were watching is retried on the
next tick, so the toast appears by the time you look away.

## Staying quiet while you are watching

A toast is suppressed while the DSH window owns the foreground, because a
notification about the thing already on your screen is noise. The check is asked
of Win32 directly (`GetForegroundWindow` + `GetWindowThreadProcessId`) by the same
PowerShell process that would draw the toast, so it costs no extra spawn.

It is built to fail **open**. A probe that answered "focused" to everything would
silently swallow every notification, which is the one failure this plugin must
never have, so the capability is proved once at activation: if the probe cannot
name a foreground pid, the gate is switched off and every toast is drawn
unconditionally. The plugin logs `focus gate on` or `focus gate off` with the
reason, and the probe is testable in both directions without drawing anything:

```powershell
# reports the foreground pid and whether each given pid matches it
$payload = @{ focusCheck = @{ pids = @(1234, 999999) } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
```

Set `quietWhenFocused: false` to be notified regardless of focus, or `focusPid` to
compare against something other than the Host's parent process.

## Action Center behaviour

An approval or question toast is re-drawn as **已处理 / Answered** once it has
been answered. An entry that keeps asking for a decision you already made is worse
than no entry at all.

The redraw is the only mechanism available. `ToastNotificationManager.History` is
scoped to the calling process's package identity, and the Host has none: from here
`GetHistory` reports an empty history and every `Remove` fails with
`0x80070490 Element not found`. That was established by probe rather than inferred
from the API surface — post a tagged toast, wait, then query the matching group.
What an unpackaged process *can* do is post a toast whose tag and group Action Center
already holds, which replaces it. So a settled request is retired by being re-drawn,
silent and brief, rather than by being deleted.

Two consequences worth knowing: the settled toast briefly re-appears as a banner,
and an **unanswered** toast is never removed — it stays until you act on it or
dismiss it. Set `settleResolvedToasts: false` to leave the original in place.

There is deliberately **no notification-history feature**. Reading or clearing
Action Center needs `ToastNotificationManager.History`, which is scoped to the
calling process's package identity; from an unpackaged Host `GetHistory` reports
nothing and `Remove` fails with `0x80070490`. Action Center itself is the history,
and a blocking toast uses `duration: long` precisely so it is still there when you
come back.

A tag is derived rather than embedded, because Windows caps both `Tag` and `Group`
at 64 characters and setting a longer one throws *before* the toast is shown — an
over-long tag loses the notification, not merely its identity. A session id is 44
characters on its own, so a tag is an 11-character `<category>-<hash>` pair: stable
per notification, distinct across sessions, and unable to outgrow the ceiling.

## What clicking a toast does

The toast body opens `openUri`, and the Desktop shell resolves that to exactly
one thing: **raising the primary window** — restored if minimized, recreated if it
was destroyed. It does **not** navigate to the session that raised the toast. The
shell wires `second-instance` to a zero-argument callback, so the command line
carrying the URI is discarded, and the only URI it recognises anywhere is
`dsh://open`. A toast raised by a background or subagent session therefore brings
you back to DSH, not to that session.

Landing on the exact session would need the Desktop shell to accept a
session-bearing deep link. No Host plugin can do it: the click arrives from
Windows, not from the renderer, so there is nothing for a plugin to intercept.

### Which session is asking

Because a click cannot navigate, every toast names its session in the footer:
`<project directory> · <first 8 characters of the session id>` — for example
`default-workspace · 97217b96`. A session whose project directory is not yet
known is named `

plugins.description: Prompt enhancement for DeepSeek Harness: composer button + enhance_prompt tool
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-enhance · 提示词增强插件

把用户写下的**原始提示词**改写成**更清晰、更具体的提示词**，只返回改写结果本身；增强规则与输出契约对齐 WorkBuddy（CodeBuddy 桌面端）内置的「增强提示词」——**规则等价、措辞原创**（指令文本为本项目自行撰写，不含任何第三方文本），可脱离 WorkBuddy 独立运行。

- 能力入口：输入框右侧「✦ 增强」按钮；Host 工具 `enhance_prompt`
- 运行依赖：DSH 的 `llm` 服务（有可用模型路由即可）
- 不依赖：WorkBuddy 安装目录、其 sidecar、任何网络私有接口、任何 npm 依赖

## 安装

```powershell
# 从 GitHub 安装（当前会话所在的 profile）
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sun04222/dsh-prompt-enhance

# 装了 dsh-market / dsh-m 的话，也可以直接在市场里搜「提示词增强」一键安装
```

安装后在设置 → 插件里能看到「提示词增强」；前端按钮需要刷新一次页面。

---

## 1. 与 WorkBuddy 的对应关系

| 能力点 | WorkBuddy 5.8.3 | 本插件 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 提示词入口 | 输入框工具栏「增强提示词」按钮 | 输入框右侧「增强」按钮 **+** 工具 `enhance_prompt` |
| 主进程实现 | `main/server.js` · `handleEnhancePrompt()` / `registerEnhancePromptHandlers()` | `index.js` · `enhance()` |
| IPC 通道 | `llm:enhancePrompt` | 无（同进程 Host 工具） |
| 模型调用 | sidecar `POST /api/v1/llm/completions`，`agentName: enhance-prompt` | `ctx.llm.stream()`，单次补全 |
| 系统提示词 | 变量 `zn` | `prompt.js` · `SYSTEM_PROMPT`（同一套规则，原创措辞） |
| 用户提示词 | 模板变量 `Bn`，`renderUserPrompt()` 填 `{input}` | `prompt.js` · `USER_TEMPLATE` + `buildUserPrompt()`（同一套规则，原创措辞） |
| 参数 | `temperature` / `maxTokens` 均未传 | 同样不传（沿用 provider 默认） |
| 后处理 | `stripWrappingQuotes$1()` → 空则 `llm_error` | `stripWrappingQuotes()` / `finalizeEnhanced()`（行为一致） |
| 成功返回 | `{ success: true, text }` | 同 |
| 失败返回 | `{ success: false, text: '', code, error }` | 同（见 §3.2 失败码映射） |
| UI 文案 | 增强提示词 / 增强中… / 恢复原文 / 增强失败 | 工具卡片标题「增强提示词 · 已改写 / 失败」 |

WorkBuddy 侧证据（仅用于确认契约，未复制其文本或代码；安装包 `resources/app.asar` 内）：
`main/server.js` 中 `Ln = 'llm:enhancePrompt'`、`Rn = 'enhance-prompt'`、`handleEnhancePrompt`、`stripWrappingQuotes$1`、`renderUserPrompt`；渲染层 `runtime-*.js` 的 `enhancePrompt = invoke(..., 'llm:enhancePrompt')`、`workbuddy-provider-*.js` 的 `createEnhanceService()`，以及 i18n 键 `chatInput.enhance.tooltip / enhancing / revert / failed`。

---

## 2. 核心行为

两个入口（输入框「增强」按钮、工具 `enhance_prompt`）共用同一条管线：

1. **空输入短路**：`text.trim() === ''` 直接返回 `empty_input`，**不发起模型调用**。
2. **解析模型路由**：参数 `model` > 插件配置 `provider`/`model` > 当前默认模型（`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()`）。
3. **单次、非 agent 式补全**：一条 system 消息（`SYSTEM_PROMPT`）+ 一条 user 消息（`USER_TEMPLATE` 用原文替换 `{input}`）。不带工具、不带会话历史、不做多轮。
4. **收集文本**：累加流式 `text-delta`；`finish.reason.kind === 'error' | 'aborted'` 记为失败。
5. **后处理**：`trim` → 各剥掉首尾一个包裹引号字符 → 若 `trim` 后为空则失败；否则原样返回。

整个过程不执行用户提示词里的任何请求（不写代码、不回答问题），只产出「改写后的提示词」。

### 2.1 输入框按钮（对齐 WorkBuddy 的点击式交互）

| 状态 | 按钮 | 点击后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 空闲（草稿非空） | `✦ 增强` | 把当前草稿发给 Host 增强，成功后**整段替换草稿**并记住原文 |
| 增强中 | `✦ 增强中…`（禁用） | — |
| 已增强且草稿未被改动 | `↩ 恢复原文` | 还原成点击前的原文 |
| 已增强但用户又改了草稿 | 自动回到 `✦ 增强` | 再次增强当前草稿 |
| 失败 | `⚠ 增强失败`（title 显示原因） | 重试 |
| 草稿为空 | 禁用 | — |

- 草稿被手动改过即丢弃「恢复原文」（对齐 WorkBuddy 的 `contentDiverged`）。
- 切换会话自动重置；组件卸载时取消在途请求。
- 与 Host 的唯一通道是同源 `POST /prompt-enhance`，请求/响应体与工具的信封完全一致。

---

## 3. 输入 / 输出格式

### 3.1 输入（工具参数）

```jsonc
{
  "text":  "帮我写一个登录页面",   // 必填：用户原始提示词，原样传入
  "model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat" // 可选：`model-id` 或 `provider/model-id`
}
```

- `text`：不预设格式，中/英/混合语言、多行、含代码片段都可；空白输入返回 `empty_input`。
- `model`：只影响这一次调用，不写回配置。省略时用插件配置，再退到当前默认模型。

### 3.2 输出（固定信封，与 WorkBuddy 一致）

```jsonc
// 成功
{ "success": true, "text": "请解释这段代码的主要功能、执行流程和关键逻辑，并指出可能需要注意的边界情况。" }

// 失败（text 恒为空串）
{ "success": false, "text": "", "code": "llm_error", "error": "Enhanced result is empty" }
```

| code | 含义 | WorkBuddy 对应码 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `empty_input` | 输入为空白 | `empty_input`（同名同因） |
| `llm_unavailable` | 无 `llm` 服务 / 无可用模型路由 | `sidecar_unavailable`（运行时通道不可用） |
| `llm_error` | 模型侧失败、超时、被中断，或产出为空 | `llm_error`（同名同因） |
| `unknown` | 未预期异常 | `unknown` |

模型可见内容：成功时**只有增强后的提示词文本**（不加前后缀）；失败时是一行 `[code] error`，便于模型自行决定重试或回报。

### 3.3 Web 通道（输入框按钮使用）

`POST /prompt-enhance`，`content-type: application/json`，请求体 `{ "text": string, "model"?: string }`，响应体就是 §3.2 的同一个信封（HTTP 200）。信任检查委派官方 `connection.requestRejection`，缺席或抛错一律 fail-closed；非 POST 返回 405，坏 JSON 返回 400。

---

## 4. 优化所遵循的规则与约束

以下规则与 WorkBuddy 的那套**规则一致、措辞为本项目原创**。重要区分：它们是**模型行为约束**（写进提示词，由模型执行），本插件在代码里只强制 §2 第 1、5 步与超时/取消，不做事后校验、截断或改写。

### 4.1 硬约束（提示词中标为最高优先级）

- **语言一致**：输出必须与输入同语言；中文入 → 全中文，英文入 → 全英文，混合入 → 自然混合。不得翻译成单一语言。
- **只输出提示词**：不加解释、前言、Markdown 围栏、标签或分析。
- **不输出语言元信息**：不写「用户输入是中文」「需用中文回答」这类说明。
- **保留原意**：保留原请求的意图、主题、约束和目标输出类型，**不回答**该请求。

### 4.2 增强要求

- 尽量做出**实质性**增强：澄清任务、范围、约束、期望产出。
- 原提示词已经清楚时，做轻度润色，而不是原样返回。
- 完整且简洁，**不得**以未完成的列表、悬空连词或冒号结尾。
- 不添加无关要求、无依据的事实或多余章节。

### 4.3 分析与改写原则（system 提示词）

- 先评估：主目标、歧义与缺口、指令清晰度、缺失的上下文。
- 再应用：写清具体指令、补必要上下文、设定显式参数与约束、规定输出结构、给相关示例、语气与复杂度匹配用途、删除冗余。
- 保持原目标，只做现实可加的改进。

### 4.4 明确禁止

- 不索要指南/教程（除非用户主动要）、不索要代码片段。
- 不引入用户未提及的具体技术栈。
- 不解释「怎么做（HOW）」，聚焦「做什么（WHAT）」。
- 不回答提问，而是把它扩写得更具体。

### 4.5 长度

提示词要求「**约 800 字符以内**」。这是模型侧软约束：代码**不做截断**，也不因超长报错。

---

## 5. 适用场景

- 用户说「帮我优化/增强/润色这个提示词」「把这句话改成能直接发给模型的提示词」。
- 把一句口语化需求（「给我的狗做个网站」）扩成可执行的任务描述。
- 将提示词交给另一个模型/另一个会话前，统一做一次清晰化。
- 批量为已有提示词库做统一风格的改写（逐条调用）。

**不适用**：

- 代替执行用户请求（本工具只改写提示词，不写代码、不解释代码）。
- 事实检索、翻译、摘要、改写文章正文（会被语言一致 + 只输出提示词两条规则带偏）。
- 需要多轮追问才能澄清的需求——本工具单轮、无对话状态。

---

## 6. 边界条件与已知差异

| 场景 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 输入为空白 / 只有换行 | `empty_input`，不调用模型 |
| 模型返回空白或只有引号 | `llm_error` / `Enhanced result is empty` |
| 模型返回被引号包裹 | 剥掉首尾各**一个**引号字符（`"` `'` `“` `”` `‘` `’`）；`""abc""` → `"abc"` |
| 只有一侧带引号 | 只剥那一侧（如 `"abc` → `abc`）——与原应用行为一致 |
| 输入含 `$&`、`$'`、`` $` `` | **按字面量保留**。原应用把替换串当模式处理，会损坏原文；本插件改用函数式替换修正该问题 |
| 超时 | 默认 60s（`timeoutMs` 可配），返回 `llm_error` / `Request timed out …` |
| 调用被取消 | 返回 `llm_error` / `Request aborted` |
| 超长输入 | 不截断、不预校验；超出模型上下文时由 provider 报错 → `llm_error` |
| 超长输出 | 不截断（800 字符仅是提示词要求） |
| 并发 | 无共享状态，可并行调用 |
| 无可用模型 | `llm_unavailable`，不影响插件其余功能 |

**与 WorkBuddy 的差异（均不影响输入输出契约）**：

1. **指令文本原创**：规则一致、措辞自行撰写，因此模型的文风可能与原应用略有出入；这是为公开分发有意做的取舍（见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`）。
2. 按钮位置：WorkBuddy 在输入框右下角工具区；本插件挂在 `conversation.input.right`（提交按钮前），受宿主布局约束。
3. `model` 语义：WorkBuddy 传模型 id 给 sidecar；本插件传 `provider/model` 路由，省略时取默认模型。
4. `$&` 替换修正：原应用把用户原文当替换模式，本插件按字面量插入。

---

## 7. 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config`（全部可选）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-prompt-enhance
      name: 'dsh-prompt-enhance'
      config:
        provider: ''      # 默认模型 provider；空则用当前默认模型
        model: ''         # 默认模型 id；空则用当前默认模型
        timeoutMs: 60000  # 单次补全墙钟上限（毫秒）
```

路由优先级：工具参数 `model` > 配置 `provider`+`model` > 当前默认模型。

---

## 8. 安装与自测

安装（三种等价方式）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sun04222/dsh-prompt-enhance   # 从 GitHub 安装
# 或在 dsh-market / dsh-m 市场里搜「提示词增强」一键安装
# 或本地开发：把本目录作为 bundle 安装（plugin_manager 的 install_bundle，target 传绝对路径）
```

本地开发时安装后无需重启即可用；再次修改代码后需把该 bundle 关一次再开，才会重新载入新模组。

```powershell
node test/prompt.test.mjs                  # 纯函数单测（10 项，进程内运行）
node --check index.js; node --check prompt.js; node --check client.js
```

> 沙箱下 `node --test test/` 会因子进程管道 EPERM 失败，直接跑测试文件即可（`node:test` 在同进程执行）。

安装后确认工具已注册：查询 `Tool.listTools`，应出现 `enhance_prompt`，参数为 `text`（必填）与 `model`（可选）。

### 工程备注（维护者必读）

- **不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**：本地目录安装是软链到 profile，`defineTool` 这类宿主包在该路径下解析不到（`ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，插件激活失败）。因此 `index.js` 直接构造 `ToolDefinition`，`parameters` 写的就是 `defineTool` 归一化后的同一份原始 JSON Schema —— 模型看到的 schema 与用 `defineTool` 完全一致。
- **`output.schema` 用原始 JSON Schema 写法**（`required: ['success','text']`）；若改回 `defineTool`，同一处必须改成逐属性 `required: true` 的 author DSL 形式，否则编译报错。

---

## 9. 实测记录（本机验证，改写版指令）

| 输入 | 输出 |
| --- | --- |
| `这段代码有 bug，帮我看看` | 中文：`请定位这段代码中的 bug，说明其根本原因与触发条件，给出最小化的修复方案，并指出可用于验证修复的测试点或输入示例。如果存在多处问题，请按严重程度逐一列出。` |
| `fix the login error` | 英文：`Diagnose the login error: identify the error message or failure behavior, trace it to its likely root cause in the code, and provide a corrected fix…` |
| `write a weekly report, markdown, keep it short` | 英文，补出章节结构与篇幅约束，未回答请求本身 |
| `"   "` | `{ success:false, code:'empty_input' }`，无模型调用 |
| `model: no-such-provider/no-such-model` | `{ success:false, code:'llm_error', error:'no adapter registered for provider "no-such-provider"' }`，不崩溃 |

以上覆盖「同语言输出」「只产出提示词」「不做零增强」「空输入短路」「通道不可用降级」五条关键契约。

---

## 10. 功能契约的来源（取证说明）

功能契约是从本机安装的 WorkBuddy（闭源客户端）**观测**得到的，用于确认行为规格；本仓库**未分发**其中任何文本、代码或资源，指令文本已按规则重写（见 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`）。复现取证的方法：

```powershell

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-glass-skin

Acrylic / frosted-glass appearance for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): translucent surfaces that let **your desktop show through the window**, layered on top of whatever theme you already use.

![DeepSeek Harness with glass surfaces over a desktop wallpaper](assets/screenshot.png)

```bash
npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin
```

One command. It installs the plugin *and* patches the window material.

> **Windows 11** is the fully supported platform (native acrylic). On macOS the plugin half works and uses the vibrancy the app already has. On Linux the window patch is skipped.

---

## What you get

| Layer | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| **Native window material** | the OS blurs the desktop behind the window (acrylic on Windows) |
| **Glass surfaces** | the app's own backgrounds become 70–82% transparent, keeping the active theme's colours |
| **Frosted blur** | a 30px backdrop blur so text stays readable over a busy wallpaper |

Works **together with existing theme plugins**. It does not replace your theme; it stacks on top of it. Mineradio, the official homepage theme, open-sea-skin and custom themes all keep their palette — only opacity changes.

---

## Install

### The one-liner

```bash
npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin
```

Or from a clone:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin.git
cd dsh-glass-skin
node scripts/install.mjs
```

**Close DeepSeek Harness first if you can.** The installer patches `app.asar`, and a running app holds a lock on it. If it is open, the installer tells you so and leaves your files untouched — just quit and re-run.

Then **restart the app**.

### Options

```bash
node scripts/install.mjs --dry-run      # show what it would do
node scripts/install.mjs --no-patch     # plugin only: translucency, no desktop show-through
node scripts/install.mjs --no-plugin    # window patch only
node scripts/install.mjs --asar <path>  # app.asar it could not find on its own
node scripts/install.mjs --uninstall    # undo everything
```

---

## Uninstall

```bash
npx github:InkStain258/dsh-glass-skin --uninstall
```

Or just turn it off: **Settings → General → Glass skin**. That restores your surfaces immediately and leaves the window patch in place (the window stays blurred acrylic).

To restore the window exactly as it shipped, `--uninstall` puts back the byte-exact backup the installer made.

---

## Editing the look

Every surface value lives in one array at the top of `plugin/client.js`:

```js
const GLASS_TOKENS = [
  { name: '--dsw-alias-bg-base',            light: 30, dark: 22, … },
  { name: '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill',    light: 26, dark: 18, … },
  …
]
```

`22` means "keep 22% of this surface's own colour", i.e. **78% of the desktop shows through**. Raise the numbers for more density and better text contrast; lower them for more glass.

The blur strength is one line in the same file:

```css
backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(140%);
```

After editing, restart the app (or let HMR pick it up if you are running `dsh web` with the watcher).

---

## Why a patch is needed at all

Two layers are required, and only one of them can be a pure plugin.

The **surfaces** are a plugin: DSH lets a client plugin stack a theme-token overlay via `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()`, which is the cooperative path — the theme service composes it on every palette switch, so it survives theme changes and does not fight other themes.

The **window material** cannot be a plugin. `transparent` / `backgroundMaterial` are `BrowserWindow` constructor options evaluated when Electron creates the window, before any plugin code runs. So the installer makes one surgical, **length-preserving** edit to `lib/main.js` inside `app.asar`:

```js
// injected right after `show,`
backgroundColor:"#00000000",backgroundMaterial:"acrylic",
```

It inserts N bytes and removes exactly N bytes from an adjacent JSDoc comment, so the archive's size, header and **every entry offset stay identical**. Before replacing anything it verifies: size unchanged, header byte-identical, all entry offsets unchanged, only `lib/main.js` differs, and the extracted file still parses. If any check fails, nothing is written.

### Why not `transparent: true`?

Measured on Electron 44.7.0 / Windows 11 26300 over a high-frequency checkerboard backdrop:

| Window options | Desktop visible | Genuinely blurred | Native shadow |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `backgroundMaterial:"acrylic"` | yes | **yes** | **intact** |
| `+ transparent: true` | yes | yes | **collapses to ~2px** |
| `transparent: true` only | yes | **no** — crisp, not blurred | ~2px |
| `backgroundMaterial:"mica"` | **no** | — | none |

`acrylic` alone already yields a real blurred backdrop *and* keeps the window shadow. Adding `transparent: true` costs the shadow without improving the blur. It is also the exact shape DSH's own welcome window already uses.

### Why the blur is a separate layer

`backdrop-filter` makes an element a **containing block for fixed-position descendants**. The shell's menus and dialogs are viewport-positioned, so putting the filter on the app frame would silently re-anchor every popover to that frame — and on Windows the frame is offset by the title bar, so everything would shift down.

Instead the plugin appends **one empty fixed layer at `z-index:-1`**, behind all content. It has no children, so it cannot become anyone's containing block.

---

## Compatibility

- **DSH 0.2.x** (Electron 44). The patch anchors on `createWindow()` in `lib/main.js`; if a future release moves it, the tool **refuses and reports** instead of guessing.
- **Theme plugins**: unaffected — the overlay reads colours *from* the theme registry and only changes alpha.
- **`prefers-reduced-transparency: reduce`**: the plugin turns itself off and says so in Settings instead of ignoring you.
- **Menus and popovers** stay opaque on purpose, so they remain readable.
- **An app update replaces `app.asar`** and drops the window patch. Re-run the installer; your plugin and its settings survive.

---

## Known limits

- **Windows only** for desktop show-through. macOS gets surfaces + the app's own vibrancy; Linux gets surfaces only.
- The **sidebar** keeps its own background layer, so it looks slightly less blurred than the main pane. That layer also hosts fixed-position menus, so blurring it carries positioning risk and is left opt-in.
- Acrylic's blur radius is chosen by Windows, not by the app.
- Very bright wallpapers reduce text contrast. Raise the `GLASS_TOKENS` percentages if you read long text.

---

## Development

```bash
npm test
```

Three suites, no browser needed:

| Suite | What it protects |
| --- | --- |
| `glass-client-contract.test.mjs` | loads the **real** `client.js`, runs its factory, renders the settings row with **zero props**, asserts the token overlay and the single blur layer |
| `glass-row-render.test.mjs` | the settings row in three states (on / reduced-transparency / no locale service) |
| `glass-render.test.mjs` | the theme overlay's re-entrancy guard |

Each contains a "the old shape must fail" assertion, so the tests cannot silently stop testing anything.

Two bugs these suites exist for, both found the hard way:

1. Reading `props.t` in the settings row. That slot's owner declares `children?: never` and passes nothing, so every render threw and the slot system **permanently abdicated** the entry — an empty Settings page with the error only in the console.
2. Using `ctx.get('theme')` instead of declaring `inject: ['theme']`. Under HMR the service already existed so it worked; on a cold boot the plugin activated first, got `undefined`, and silently vanished.

---

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © dsh-glass-skin contributors

DeepSeek Harness is a separate product; this repository only adds files to your own installation and keeps a byte-exact backup of anything it touches.
