that directory (`<dir>/.venv/bin/python`, else `python3`) and the arguments from
the configured upstream port, so the panel cannot run arbitrary commands. The
directory and the **Start with DSH** flag are stored in the plugin's own
`dsh_comfyui` domain, not in the DSH profile.

For advanced setups, the plugin row still accepts a `supervise` block that
takes precedence at start-up:

```yaml
        supervise:
          enabled: true
          command: /opt/ComfyUI/.venv/bin/python
          args: [main.py, --listen, 127.0.0.1, --port, '8188']
          cwd: /opt/ComfyUI
          restartDelayMs: 5000
          maxRestarts: 5
          probeIntervalMs: 20000
          startTimeoutMs: 120000
          logPath: /var/log/comfyui/comfyui.log
```

`cwd` is required when that block is enabled; a missing value fails the plugin
load instead of silently never starting ComfyUI. `command` defaults to
`python3`, `args` to `main.py --listen 127.0.0.1`. An upstream that already
answers `/system_stats` is adopted (`state: external`) rather than duplicated.
Unloading the plugin stops only a process it started.

## Requirements

- A running ComfyUI whose frontend is the standard `comfyui-frontend-package`
  build (relative `./assets/...`, `api_base` derived from the path).
- The DSH Web profile with `storage` + `storage-json` + `storage-domain`
  mounted (the default profile has them). Without them, workflows stay in
  memory.
- The panel relies on the same-origin iframe and on
  `window.comfyAPI.app.app`, a legacy compatibility shim exposed by the
  ComfyUI frontend, not a stable public API. Pin the ComfyUI frontend version
  for anything beyond this milestone. What the plugin actually uses — and how
  to re-derive it after an upgrade — is in
  [docs/comfyui-bridge.md](docs/comfyui-bridge.md); the panel was last verified
  against frontend 1.57.1.

## Try it without ComfyUI

A mock upstream is included so the proxy/iframe/bridge can be tested without
torch:

```bash
node test/mock-comfyui.mjs
```

Then open the **ComfyUI** tab in a session and wait for **Connected**. The
mock page exposes a one-node workflow. `comfyui_run` should return `p1`. Stop
the mock before starting a real ComfyUI on port 8188.

Run the checks with:

```bash
npm install       # once: typescript and @types/node for the type check
npm run typecheck # checkJs over the plugin, the tests and the scripts
npm test          # checks, host smoke, editor ops, hygiene, market index
npm run contract  # real DSH runtime, needs ../deepseek-harness
npm run ui        # live panel in a headless bro

plugins.description: Port of dsh-status-rotator to dsh-TUI: phase-aware rotating status phrases with typewriter, adaptive gradient, weighted shuffle-bag selection and a native /settings section. / 把 dsh-status-rotator 移植进 dsh-TUI
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tui-status-rotator

> A port of [dsh-status-rotator](https://github.com/01Virex/dsh-status-rotator)'s **rotating status line** to [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI).
>
> Phase-aware phrases · typewriter reveal · theme-adaptive gradient · weighted shuffle-bag anti-repeat · 14 phrase packs (1362 entries) · conditional phrases & live placeholders · presets and weekday schedule.
>
> Wired into dsh-TUI's native `/settings` section and `/status-rotator` command - install and go.

[中文](./README_ZH.md) · [Install](#install) · [First run](#first-run) · [What it looks like](#what-it-looks-like) · [Settings](#settings) · [Commands](#commands) · [Advanced config](#advanced-config) · [Differences](#differences-from-the-web-original) · [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) · [Development](#development-and-verification) · [Documents](#documents)

---

## Install

### Requirements

| Dependency | Version / notes |
| --- | --- |
| dsh-TUI | **v0.16+** (uses the `tuiStatus.registerView` and `tuiSettingsSections` seams) |
| DeepSeek Harness | verified on 0.2.1-rc.2; older hosts may lack seams (the plugin degrades with diagnostics) |
| Node.js | `^22.19 || >=24` |
| pnpm | `>=10` (used by `dsh plugin` when installing) |
| Terminal | must be a **real TTY** (Windows Terminal WSL tab, VS Code terminal, ...); stdout must not be piped/redirected |
| Model auth | `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` or `/auth login deepseek-account` (detected by the dsh-tui onboarding) |

The package ships `dsh-plugin.json` (Community v0.15 declaration surface) and `cordis.patch.yml` (profile composition row).

### Install from GitHub

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Umamed26/dsh-tui-status-rotator
cd dsh-tui-status-rotator
npm install && npm run build          # compile into lib/types/
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add file:$PWD
```

If the `dsh-tui` profile does not exist yet, install the host first: `dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui`. If DSH reports an incompatible host dependency, run the printed `dsh plugin allow-version ... --accept-risk` and retry.

### After install

```sh
dsh --profile dsh-tui
# shorter alias: alias dsh-tui='dsh --profile dsh-tui'
```

The first launch runs a 4-step onboarding (API key / language / model / shortcuts). Choose Chinese to switch the status phrases to Chinese as well.

### Uninstall

```sh
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui remove dsh-tui-status-rotator
```

`remove` does **not** delete user data: the external bank and caches stay in `~/.dsh-tui/status-rotator/`. See [Uninstall and data](#uninstall-and-data).

---

## First run

After launching, send any prompt and run these three checks within 30 seconds:

1. **The line appears**: one extra row above the prompt with a phase glyph - `◌` (thinking) / `●` (running) / `◍` (long) - typed out and color-shifting.
2. **The command works**: type `/status-rotator status`; expect one line like:
   ```text
   status-rotator on lang=zh phase=none ; view=on set=on settings=on cmd=on ;
   sessions=1 proj=on/N active=idle events=N/N frames=N packs=10 preset=none ; line=- errors=none
   ```
3. **The settings page exists**: open `/settings` -> "Status rotator" page (15 fields).

> **Only two characters at first, looks stuck?** That is a typewriter mid-frame (30 ms/grapheme by default; a full phrase takes ~0.3-0.6 s). To show whole phrases at once, set `/settings -> Status rotator -> typewriter speed` to `0`.

---

## What it looks like

While a turn runs, a line above the prompt rotates (real TTY frame examples; `◌` / `●` / `◍` are the phase glyphs):

```text
◌ 正在自刎归天…
● 正在灰度一个不该上线的功能…
```

(Both are real entries from the shipped corpus; see `src/bank/packs/`.)

- Typewriter reveal; after the phrase settles it rotates at the configured interval;
- Each grapheme is colored from a flowing palette (host theme palette by default, adapts to light/dark themes);
- Phase transitions (thinking ◌ -> running ● -> long ◍) swap the phrase immediately;
- Idle sessions, finished turns, disabled plugin: the line renders nothing - no placeholder row, no flicker, no focus stealing;
- Coexists with the host's own working-activity line: this plugin only adds its own row, it never overwrites the host text.

---

## Settings

`/settings` gains a **"Status rotator"** page (seam `tuiSettingsSections`). Every field applies live and is persisted through the host's revision-fenced settings writes - no restart needed; reverting a value to its default also removes the profile override.

| Field | Default | Range | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | on/off | Master switch; off renders nothing |
| `language` | `auto` | auto / zh / en | Phrase language; auto reads `DSH_TUI_LANG` -> `~/.dsh-tui/lang.json` -> system locale |
| `intervalMs` | `10000` | 500-600000 | Rotation interval (ms) |
| `typeSpeedMs` | `30` | 0-2000 | Typewriter per-grapheme interval; 0 = instant |
| `thinkingMs` | `15000` | 0-600000 | "thinking" phase duration before "running" |
| `longAfterMs` | `60000` | 0-3600000 | "long" phase threshold |
| `weightedRandom` | `true` | on/off | Weighted draw; off = uniform |
| `antiRepeatRecentLimit` | `3` | 0-50 | Cross-bag recency memory (0 = bag-only) |
| `labelSource` | `phrases` | phrases / host | `host` = leave the host line untouched |
| `gradientEnabled` | `true` | on/off | Per-cell flowing gradient |
| `gradientMode` | `theme` | theme / day / night | `theme` = host theme keys (adapts); day/night = custom palettes |
| `gradientDirection` | `rtl` | rtl / ltr | Flow direction |
| `gradientColors` | original night palette | >= 2 colors | Custom night palette (hex / rgb() / ansi256() / ansi:name / host theme key, comma separated) |
| `gradientDayColors` | original day palette | >= 2 colors | Custom day palette |
| `gradientSpeedSec` | `4` | 1-60 | Seconds per gradient cycle |

Nested structures (`presets` / `schedule` / `enabledPacks` / `bankPath`) are edited in the profile row config (see [Advanced config](#advanced-config)), not the declarative form.

---

## Commands

```text
/status-rotator next      # rotate immediately
/status-rotator on|off    # runtime toggle (persist via /settings)
/status-rotator status    # diagnostics: phase / line / packs / host seams / recent errors
```

Registered through dsh-commands; the mediated host surface (`tuiPluginHost.registerCommand`) is preferred when present so ownership and authorization checks apply.

---

## Advanced config

Add keys to the plugin row in the profile patch:

```yaml
- id: status-rotator
  config:
    intervalMs: 8000
    enabledPacks: [deepseek, coding, daily]   # omitted = default 10; null = all; [] = core only
    activePreset: night
    presets:
      - id: night
        name: Night
        phrases:
          en:
            thinking: ["Sneakily booting up Valorant…", "Entering the deep-slacking wind-up…"]
            running: ["Being lazy with a straight face…", "Writing a mini-game after finishing your task…"]
            long: ["Slacking so hard it forgot the task…"]
    schedule:
      - preset: night
        days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]     # ISO weekday, 1 = Monday; omitted = every day
        from: "22:00"
        to: "06:00"               # wraps midnight
    bankPath: null                # null/omitted = ~/.dsh-tui/status-rotator/bank.json
```

- **Packs**: 14 built-in packs (1362 entries, default 10 enabled = 945), ported verbatim from the web plugin;
- **Conditions / weights / rarity**: entries accept `{ text, weight, when, rarity }`; `when` supports `tool` / `retry` / `pending` / `phase` / `hour` / `firstTurn`, and matching conditionals win the draw;
- **Placeholders**: `{elapsed}` `{phase}` `{phaseLabel}` `{model}` `{provider}` `{tps}` `{pending}` `{tools}` `{running}` `{retry}` `{retryMax}` `{locale}` `{date}` `{time}`.

> Every example phrase in this document is taken from the shipped corpus (verify with `npm run check:bank` or `/status-rotator status`), including the preset and third-party registration examples.

### External bank (hot reload)

Put an override-only JSON at `~/.dsh-tui/status-rotator/bank.json` (or point `DSH_TUI_STATUS_ROTATOR_BANK` / `bankPath` at a path):

```json
{ "packs": [{ "id": "c

plugins.description: Provider usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: shows the remaining share of each quota window (GLM Coding Plan today) as a chip beside the model selector, with a detail popover.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-usage-panel

给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个**供应商套餐用量面板**：在模型选择器右侧显示一枚小徽标，点开是与 ZCode 客户端同款的三列明细（5 小时窗口 / 每周 / 工具调用）。目前接入了 **GLM Coding Plan**，后续可以在同一插件里接其他供应商。

- 只在模型选择器显示 **GLM** 时出现（读模型控件的 aria-label，读不到就隐藏）
- **平时不发任何请求**：徽标只写「额度」两个字，不显示百分比；悬停时现查一次（`?refresh=1` 绕过缓存），移开即关闭
- API key 只在 Host 进程内使用，不下发到浏览器；上游结果缓存 20 秒

数据来自 ZCode 客户端使用的同一个接口：

```
GET <base>/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit
authorization: <api key>
```

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin install dsh-plugin-usage-panel
```

或在 Plugins 页安装后重启。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `ZAI_CODING_CN_API_KEY` | 通过 Host 凭据服务解析的 key 名 |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.z.ai` | 接口域名；BigModel 用 `https://open.bigmodel.cn` |
| `refreshSeconds` | `60` | 缓存与轮询间隔（下限 10 秒） |

API key 只在 Host 进程内使用，不会下发到浏览器。

## 位置与可见性

- 挂在 `conversation.input.activity`：**输入框工具行里、模型选择器右侧紧邻**。
  （布局没有"模型左侧"的插槽：`conversation.input.left` 是最左边那一簇，而模型选择器本身是 single 槽，不能被扩展。）
- **只有模型选择器是 GLM 时才出现**：读模型控件的无障碍名称（`aria-label` 形如「选择模型，当前: GLM-5.3-Flash，推理…」），从中取出当前模型名，命中 `/glm/i` 才渲染；读不到就隐藏（宁可不显示）。

  为什么不用接口：harness **没有向插件暴露当前模型**——`agentDefaultModel.currentSelection()` 在插件里是 `undefined`，会话快照与 projection 都没有模型字段，模型控件的 slot props 只有 `{locked}`。会话日志里的 `model/selection` 事件是模型菜单浏览时写入的预览，不代表已提交的选择，所以不能拿它判断。

## 显示内容

- 触发徽标：`GLM <最紧的窗口百分比>`，颜色随余量变化（>30% 绿、>10% 橙、≤10% 红）
- 弹层：套餐等级 + 三列（5 小时 / 每周 / 工具调用），每列是标签、剩余百分比、重置日期、进度条
- 底部：本次读数时间

## 接口字段对照

| 面板 | 接口 |
| --- | --- |
| 5 小时 | `TOKENS_LIMIT` + `unit: 3` |
| 每周 | `TOKENS_LIMIT` + `unit: 6` |
| 工具调用 | `TIME_LIMIT`（`usage` 总额、`currentValue` 已用） |
| 套餐 | `data.level` |

剩余百分比 = `100 - percentage`。

## 相关插件

| 插件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [dsh-plugin-composer-predict](https://github.com/Dogtiti/dsh-plugin-composer-predict) | 预测下一条指令并显示为占位文字，`Tab` 采纳 |
| [dsh-plugin-composer-history](https://github.com/Dogtiti/dsh-plugin-composer-history) | 输入框中按 `↑` / `↓` 回填历史消息 |
| [dsh-plugin-subagent-bridge](https://github.com/Dogtiti/dsh-plugin-subagent-bridge) | 让 Codex 通过本机 MCP 把 DSH 当 subagent 用（spawn / wait / followup），反向也能把任务派给 Codex |
| **dsh-plugin-usage-panel**（本仓库） | 在模型选择器旁显示供应商套餐额度余量（目前 GLM Coding Plan），点开是明细浮层 |

plugins.description: Aqua 玻璃质感主题 · 适配 DeepSeek Harness V0.2.1-rc.2 · glassmorphism theme for DSH: adjustable blur/frost, fluid or wallpaper backdrop, unified corners; toggle off for the stock UI, no source changes
plugins.readme_text:
# Aqua glass theme (community-maintained fork)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> **Upstream notice**: this package continues from **WYH66666666**'s [DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin](https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin) (published on npm as `dsh-client-ui-aqua`) at **v1.3.0**. The original author states he cannot keep up with new DSH APIs, so this fork fixes and adapts that code. It is **not guaranteed** to work with future DSH versions — back up your profile before upgrading DSH.

## Supported DSH version

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| **DSH desktop / web** | **V0.2.1-rc.2** |
| Host client packages | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-*` **0.2.1-rc.2** |
| Declared in metadata | `package.json` → `engines.dsh: ">=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0"` |

**V0.2.1-rc.2 is the version this release is built and verified against** — the theme hooks are read from that host build (page-head markup, composer/dock seams, slot names). These are private client surfaces, so a DSH upgrade can break the look or the mount even though nothing changes here. If you are on another DSH build, treat the theme as unsupported and keep a profile backup.

## Topics / community listing

Published under the `dsh-plugin` topic, so it shows up on the [dsh-plugin community page](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) alongside other DeepSeek Harness plugins.

`dsh-plugin` · `dsh` · `deepseek-harness` · `deepseek-harness-plugin` · `theme` · `glassmorphism` · `aqua`

## Credits

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Original author | **WYH66666666** — [repository](https://github.com/WYH66666666/DSH-Transparent-UI-Plugin) |
| Upstream npm package | `dsh-client-ui-aqua` (latest 1.3.1) |
| Base of this fork | upstream **v1.3.0** sources |
| Maintained by | **ZHUBAI0528** — [repository](https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua) |
| This package | `@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix` |
| Version | **2.1.0** (independent since this release) |
| **DSH support** | **V0.2.1-rc.2** |
| License | **AGPL-3.0** (inherited from upstream `LICENSE`; original copyright and licence notice retained verbatim) |

Aqua is a highly customizable glassmorphism theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI and desktop app. The floating header, composer and stats line, and the trajectory view become panes of frosted glass, while the main column can sit on the living fluid board or on your own wallpaper (image or video); the sidebar keeps its stock look. Switch it off and the stock UI comes back exactly, with no source changes to DSH itself.

![](assets/1.png)

![](assets/2.png)

![](assets/3.png)

![](assets/4.png)

## Differences from upstream v1.3.0

| Item | Upstream v1.3.0 | This package v2.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Layout modes | **Mica + Compatibility**, switchable | **Mica only** — compatibility mode and its selector are removed (tokens and styles too) |
| Edge blur bands | 5px gradient blur bands at the top/bottom (an upstream feature) | **Removed** — they read as an extra gradient wash over the page edges; readability is carried by the column veil instead (the 13px edge fade stays) |
| Submenu opacity | not available | **New** setting, default 96%, in the same group as "Chat surface opacity" |
| Submenu click | opens on hover, then a click closes it | **New "click keeps it open"**: a hover-opened submenu survives the click and closes on the next one; works at any depth via ARIA, keyboard Enter unaffected |
| Popup material | `62% × frost` fill (≈8.7% by default), text behind was legible through it | **96%** fill + `blur + 4px`, panels no longer show the text behind |
| Composer and stats line | two panes with a 6px gap | **one continuous piece of glass** (single radius, hairline divider) |
| Light-mode conversation area | if the host or a skin plugin wrote the column background, the veil lost and the area went all-white; the opacity knob did nothing | **Fixed**: the veil is `!important` and also matches `[class*='centerCol']`, so it no longer depends on stamp timing |
| Scheme switching | switching to dark left the backdrop light until a knob was touched | **Fixed**: the layer watches `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` and recomputes the fluid palette, glow tone and brightness direction |
| Cold-start fluid | a GPU that was not ready permanently disabled the canvas (all-white in light mode) | **Fixed**: retried with backoff (up to 8 attempts, ~12s) |
| Published tarball | `files` omitted `cordis.patch.yml`, so installs never loaded | **Fixed**: the tarball ships `cordis.patch.yml` and `lib/*` |
| Dependency range | peer `^0.1.0-rc.5` (mismatched a 0.2.x host) | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`, pinned to the host line the theme is built against |
| Licence statement | repo `LICENSE` is AGPL-3.0 while `package.json` said MIT | **Aligned**: both now declare AGPL-3.0 |

## Features (current)

- **Mica layout**: floating glass header, composer, stats line and trajectory view, with adjustable blur and frost
- **Theme control panel**: one page collects every knob — colours, wallpaper, opacity, blur and decor
- **No 3D tilt on the composer**: the 3D effect is gone — it interfered with text rendering
- **Free backdrop**: the living fluid board (hue and depth adjustable) or your own wallpaper — images and video both supported; wallpapers have their own blur and frost, video adds a brightness knob
- **Desktop scheme following**: tracks the desktop app's light/dark switch and re-tunes the palette, glow and brightness direction on its own
- **Background brightness**: follows the resolved scheme — dark 0–50 darkens, light 50–100 brightens, 50 is unchanged
- **Chat surface opacity**: 0 lets the wallpaper/fluid show untouched, 100 is an opaque slab
- **Submenu opacity**: fill strength for popups (menus, dropdowns, quick-invoke panels), independent of the cards
- **Submenu display**: popups get a 96% fill plus extra blur, so multi-level menus stay legible above the transcript
- **Submenu interaction → click keeps it open**: a hover-opened submenu stays open when clicked, and closes on the next click
- **Ambient decor**: particle whale (the deepseek.com/harness centerpiece), fish, and the interactive mesh — each toggleable
- **Hover effects → cursor glow**: a highlight that follows the pointer
- **Glossy "Harness" badge**: dark mode swaps the sidebar wordmark for the official nameplate pill
- **Edge fade**: a 13px fade so content melts into the viewport edges
- One switch: off restores the stock UI exactly and removes every effect

## Installation

> Upstream `dsh-client-ui-aqua` and this fork `@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix` must **not** be installed together — the profile would end up with two `ui-aqua` entries.

### Option 1: npm one-liner (recommended)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix
```

Installs the latest version from npm and registers it as a profile plugin layer (`dsh.bundle` patch) — works on every platform. Reload the UI and it is on.

### Option 2: GitHub installer (fallback)

No npm account and no git needed (falls back to a plain zip download).

**Windows (one command):**

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Invoke-WebRequest 'https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua/raw/main/install.ps1' -OutFile install.ps1; .\install.ps1"
```

Installs the **latest release** by default; the script links the plugin into the profile's `node_modules` and registers `ui-aqua` in `cordis.patch.yml` (idempotent).

### Option 3: manual (macOS / Linux)

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ZHUBAI0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua.git
ln -s "$PWD/dsh-client-ui-aqua" "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix"
```

then append to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ui-aqua
      name: '@zhubai0528/dsh-client-ui-aqua-community-fix'
```

## Usage

Reload the UI. Aqua is **on by default**; the master switch sits at the top of the **Glass theme** page in the left sidebar (it is its own page, not a tab inside Plugins/Settings). Panel groups, top to bottom:

`Glass material` (glass blur, frost) → `Backdrop` (fluid/wallpaper, hue, colour depth, background brightness, chat surface opacity, subme

plugins.description: DSH 桌宠额度挂件：可拖拽 / 抛掷 / 散步 / 打瞌睡的桌宠，点开是 ChatGPT · Codex 订阅额度气泡（DeepSeek Harness plugin）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gpt-niang · DSH 桌宠额度挂件

[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai)（DeepSeek Harness）原生插件：在 **Web UI 和 Desktop 的页面右下角**
挂一只可拖拽的桌宠——能拖、能抛、能散步、会打瞌睡、偶尔冒一句话；点一下弹出
**OpenAI / Codex 订阅额度**气泡（5 小时窗口 + 周上限、模型级可用性、积分与附加额度池，
分区可折叠，警戒线响告警音）。额度由宿主侧插件直连 ChatGPT 后端取得，**令牌一步都不进浏览器**。

- 纯 DSH 插件：不依赖 Codex 桌面端、不需要本机装 Node 或 PowerShell、不写开机自启、不注册计划任务
- 代码 MIT；角色立绘沿用上游素材声明（见「素材与许可」），仅供个人非商业使用
- 灵感来自 [T7moris/GPT-Niang](https://github.com/T7moris/GPT-Niang)（Codex 桌面插件 + WPF 挂件），
  本仓库是从零重写的 DSH 插件，只沿用了它的角色立绘，未使用其代码

![额度气泡与桌宠](docs/screenshot.png)

## 安装 / 卸载

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Deepsleep-one/dsh-gpt-niang.git

# 安装（写工作区之外，需要 danger-full-access）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add 'link:<克隆下来的绝对路径>'

# 卸载
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-gpt-niang
```

装完**重启 DSH Desktop**（或刷新 Web UI）才会加载新 bundle；改 link 目录里的代码同样只需重启。
本插件没有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer 依赖，不会被 profile 的兼容性闸门拦下。

## 前置条件

需要有 OpenAI Codex 的登录凭据，任一即可（按优先级）：

1. 插件 `dsh-codex-provider` 管理的凭据（DSH 模型设置里登录 OpenAI Codex 后写入
   `%DSH_HOME%\.credentials.yaml` 的 `OPENAI_CODEX_API_KEY`）；
2. `llm-pi-ai/openai-codex` 记录；
3. `$CODEX_HOME\auth.json` 或 `~/.codex/auth.json`。

都没有时气泡会直接提示「尚未登录 OpenAI Codex」，不会静默失败。

## 桌宠交互

| 操作 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 左键点击 | 开/关额度面板，角色蹦一下并「叮」一声 |
| 拖拽 | 跟着指针走，身体按速度倾斜（±13°） |
| 松手（有位移） | **抛出去**：重力 2100px/s²、撞墙/落地反弹并带摩擦，停下后记住落点 |
| 右键 | 8 项菜单（见下表） |
| 放着不管 5 分钟 | 打瞌睡，头顶飘 `Z z`；点一下先「唔…我醒了」，第一下只唤醒不开面板 |

落点、缩放、折叠状态、音效开关全部记在 localStorage；**重力只在被抛出后的飞行阶段生效**，
所以手动把角色摆到半空它也不会自己掉下去。

右键菜单：

| 项 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 刷新额度 | 强制刷新（绕过 45s 缓存） |
| 散步：开 / 关 | 沿窗口底部来回走，走走停停（默认关） |
| 闲聊：开 / 关 | 每 1.5–4 分钟冒一句话，额度紧张时换语气（默认开） |
| 放大一点 / 缩小一点 | 缩放 0.75–1.6 |
| 音效：开 / 关 | 点击「叮」声 |
| 告警音：开 / 关 | 额度警戒时的提示音（独立开关） |
| 复位位置 / 复位大小 | 回到右下角默认 |

角色图加载失败（例如路由拿不到 PNG）会自动退回内联 SVG 小人，不会留一个破图占位。

## 额度面板

打开时强制刷新一次，之后每 60s 轮询；Esc 或点空白处关闭：

- **5 小时窗口 / 周上限**：百分比 + 进度条 + 重置时间（`MM-DD HH:mm（N 小时后）`）
- **模型用量**：按模型列出可用性。`model_usage` 只给「是否可用 / 何时可用 / 是否需积分」，
  所以默认显示状态 chip（`可用` / `x 可用` / `需积分` / `不可用`）；
  **只有当接口真的下发了百分比时才画进度条**，绝不编造数字
- **积分与附加**：余额、超额是否已达上限、花费控制、附加额度池（有则显示）
- 每个分区点标题栏即可折叠，折叠状态记在 localStorage

**配色与告警**：剩余 ≤30% 变黄、≤10% 变红并让角色轻微抖动、状态点呼吸。
告警音只在**变差跨线**时响一次（10% 警戒三连降调，30% 警戒两连音），
额度恢复后再次掉下去还会重新响——不会每轮轮询都吵你。

## 路由

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-gpt/widget.js` | 挂件脚本（45s 或 7d 缓存） |
| GET/HEAD | `/dsh-gpt/pet.png` | 角色立绘，带 ETag + `max-age=86400`，命中 `If-None-Match` 回 304 |
| GET/POST | `/dsh-gpt/quota` | 额度快照；GET 45s 缓存，POST 强制刷新 |

三条路由都做 Host 头防 DNS-rebinding 校验；额度与脚本路由只允许回环地址
（127.0.0.1 / ::1），其它方法 405，非回环 403。立绘 ETag 由 `size-mtime` 生成，换图后普通刷新即可生效。

`GET /dsh-gpt/quota` 返回（`models` / `credits` / `spend` / `additional` 无数据时省略）：

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "fetchedAt": 1792769304735,
  "account": "a23***@gmail.com",
  "plan": "plus",
  "windows": [
    { "window": "primary_window", "label": "5 小时窗口", "remaining": 62, "used": 38, "resetsAt": "2026-10-23T19:37:21.000Z" },
    { "window": "secondary_window", "label": "周上限", "remaining": 52, "used": 48, "resetsAt": "2026-10-29T17:45:05.000Z" }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "name": "gpt-6-astra", "available": true, "availableAt": null, "creditsWouldEnable": false }
  ],
  "credits": { "hasCredits": false, "unlimited": false, "overageLimitReached": false, "balance": "0" },
  "spend": { "reached": false, "limit": null },
  "additional": []
}
```

失败时统一返回 `{ "ok": false, "error": "<固定中文文案>", "windows": [] }`，
**不转发上游 body、不回显令牌**。

## 素材与许可

- 代码：MIT，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)
- 角色立绘 `assets/pet/gpt-dragon-niang.png`（1254×1254 RGBA）来自
  [T7moris/GPT-Niang](https://github.com/T7moris/GPT-Niang)，**不适用 MIT**，
  随包原样保留了原作者的使用声明与生成说明：
  [`assets/pet/CHARACTER-NOTICE.txt`](assets/pet/CHARACTER-NOTICE.txt)、
  [`assets/pet/GENERATION-NOTES.md`](assets/pet/GENERATION-NOTES.md)
  - 允许范围：随本项目及其非商业副本，作为挂件或项目说明的一部分展示和分发，保留声明与来源
  - 不允许：商业产品、广告、周边销售、收费素材包等商业用途，以及作为独立素材包分发
  - 参考角色、参考图与可能涉及的第三方权利仍归各自权利人
- 音效：WebAudio 现场合成，不含任何音频文件
- 台词：自写

因此本仓库按**个人非商业用途**使用。要商用或做素材包分发，请先替换立绘：把任意 PNG 覆盖成
`assets/pet/gpt-dragon-niang.png` 即可（路由按 `size-mtime` 生成 ETag，刷新即生效），
或删掉它让插件退回内联 SVG 小人。

## 结构

```
cordis.patch.yml               # Bundle patch：把 dsh-gpt-niang 插进插件表
lib/index.js                   # 宿主半区：注入行、3 条路由、凭据、45s 缓存 + 单飞、payload 解析
assets/gpt-niang.js            # 客户端半区：纯 IIFE，桌宠行为 + 可折叠气泡 + WebAudio 音效
assets/pet/gpt-dragon-niang.png # 角色立绘（不适用 MIT，见「素材与许可」）
assets/pet/CHARACTER-NOTICE.txt # 上游立绘授权声明（原样保留）
assets/pet/GENERATION-NOTES.md  # 上游立绘生成说明（原样保留）
test/widget.test.js            # 25 项单元测试（node --test）
```

关键点：`apply()` 里**第一件事**就同步注册 `root.on('webserver/index-inject', ...)`。
Desktop 端的注入表在宿主启动时只收集一次，晚注册的行永远进不了表（这也是
`dsh-whale-widget` 踩过的坑）；注入行必须用内联 `script` 行而不是 `script-src` 行，
因为后者加载失败会 reject `__DSH_BOOT_READY__` 把整个应用带崩。

解析层是**纯函数**（`toModelRow` / `parseModels` / `parseCredits` / `parseSpend` /
`parseAdditional`），全部有单测覆盖信任边界：上游给什么就显示什么，缺字段就不显示，
`individual_limit: null` 不会被 `Number()` 误转成「上限 0」。

## 测试

```bash
node --test --test-isolation=none test/widget.test.js
```

25 项单测覆盖：窗口映射与重置时间、账号脱敏、注入行去重、三条路由的 403/405/304/200、
缺凭据不抛错、上游畸形数据的容错、立绘路由的 ETag 协商。

必须加 `--test-isolation=none`：DSH 沙箱下默认的进程隔离会 `spawn EPERM`。

另有一套真浏览器验收装置（不在本仓库）：把 desktop profile 镜像成临时 profile 起宿主 +
headless Chrome，再用 CDP 做 23 项交互检查（立绘加载、点击开面板、折叠切换、抛掷位移、
散步开关、菜单项），并截图比对。

plugins.description: A task-first mobile workspace for DeepSeek Harness, with session overviews, compact input, and full-record access.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile 简体中文 | [English](README.en.md) [DeepSeek Harness（DSH）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的全屏手机工作台，以任务为中心组织需要你处理的工作、会话概览和继续对话的入口，使用同一个 DSH Host 与会话记录。 这是独立维护的社区 UI 插件，可在能够访问 DSH 的浏览器中单独使用。如需临时 HTTPS 远程入口与手机配对，可加装 [dsh-remote-control](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control)；当前完整手机体验建议两个都装。 ## 宣传片 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/763e9698-6479-40da-9685-b201a600c2e4 [下载完整 MP4](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-30s.mp4) · [GIF 预览](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-preview.gif) · [封面](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases/download/v0.1.0/DSH-Anywhere-cover.png) 30 秒宣传片，16:9、1080p 60 fps，使用原创音乐与音效，中文画面，无口播。 ## 界面预览

截图使用中文界面和公开演示会话。 ## 功能 - **任务：** 优先排列待你处理的工作，再显示进行中和已就绪会话；按名称或工作区搜索，在已有工作区中新建任务。 - **概览：** 查看待处理问题或审批、当前阶段、最近正文进展、最新已完成回复及折叠的此前结果。 - **完整记录：** 使用 DSH 原有会话渲染器查看历史、工具详情、图片和交互。 - **简洁输入：** 发送文字和停止任务；通过 **更多工具** 打开完整编辑器。包含附件、结构化引用或命令时会自动恢复完整编辑器。 - **设备：** 配合 dsh-remote-control 修改当前已配对设备名称，或切回桌面界面。 概览只是已有会话原文与状态的展示投影，**不是模型生成的摘要，也不会额外调用模型**。 ## 兼容性 - **Node.js 22.19 或更新版本**，已安装 DSH；profile 包管理需要 `PATH` 中有 `pnpm`。 - 声明的 DSH 版本范围：`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`。Client / Slot API 尚未稳定，升级 DSH 可能需要同步更新插件。 - 已在 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 源码构建版、macOS arm64** 上完成 live 浏览器验证；并未对所有操作系统、浏览器和设备组合完成端到端验证。 - 本版面向 DSH Web UI。宽屏桌面窗口默认保持原布局。 ## 安装与启动 通过 GitHub tag 安装到 Web profile： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-mobile#v0.1.0 ``` 如需通过临时 HTTPS 隧道从手机访问，再安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#v0.3.1 ``` 使用 `dsh web`（或 `dsh --profile web`）启动。若已运行，CLI 安装后请重启该 profile，再刷新页面。[GitHub Releases](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-mobile/releases) 也提供发行压缩包，无需发布到 npm。 DSH 默认 Web 监听位于电脑本机（`127.0.0.1`），dsh-mobile 本身不会将其开放给手机。远程使用请按 [remote-control 安装与配对文档](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#安装与启动) 操作：在电脑安装 cloudflared，打开 **设置 → 远程控制**，扫码后确认设备名称，再明确点击 **配对并进入**。Quick Tunnel 无需 Cloudflare 账号或域名，但首次启动可能接近一分钟。其桥接要求 DSH origin 使用 `localhost`、`127.0.0.1` 或 `[::1]`，不支持 LAN 地址及通配监听目标。 ## 使用与配置 窗口宽度**不超过 900 CSS 像素**时自动进入工作台。底部提供 **任务、会话、设备** 三个入口。打开任务默认显示概览；切换到 **完整记录** 可进入完整对话界面。新任务使用已有 DSH 工作区；缺少工作区时，请先在桌面界面创建。 在 **设备 → 切回桌面界面** 返回原界面。窄屏桌面界面底部提供恢复手机工作台的按钮。设置侧栏没有单独的手机工作台入口。 本版没有 Host 配置字段。布局偏好与选中会话只存储在当前浏览器。默认自动模式不改变宽屏桌面布局；手动恢复工作台的偏好会作用于该浏览器。 ## 限制与安全范围 概览只使用**已加载的会话历史**，展示最新已完成的文字回复和最多三条此前已完成结果，不表示已概括全部存储历史，也不根据未完成正文推断任务完成。概览不展示推理、原始工具参数、图片和长日志；请在 **完整记录** 查看，通过 **更多工具** 使用复杂输入或操作。 插件展示现有 DSH 数据，沿用原有会话、输入、排队、停止、提问和审批机制，不新增网络监听、远程访问服务、独立账号或权限边界。所有操作继续受 Host 的既有权限约束。设备自助更名需要通过 remote-control 配对连接；其他工作台功能不依赖该插件。 配合 dsh-remote-control 时，已配对手机拥有 **Host 的 owner 权限**，包括其权限策略允许的本机文件及命令能力。这不是只读界面或操作系统远程桌面，也不会锁定电脑。详见 [远程插件的安全范围与有效期说明](https://github.com/slicenferqin/dsh-remote-control#安全范围与限制)。默认 8 小时访问有效期和滚动 10 天刷新窗口仅适用于同一远程入口持续运行：关闭入口、重启 DSH、重载 Host 插件或更换隧道域名都会清空配对。 ## 开发与测试 包中包含可读源码、构建脚本和测试。在仓库根目录或解压后的源码包中执行： ```sh pnpm install --ignore-scripts pnpm run build pnpm run check pnpm test ``` 构建会打包 Markdown 解析与净化依赖；运行时从 DSH Host 加载 React。测试覆盖概览正文选择、完成证据、历史数量边界、进展和待处理事项优先级，不能替代浏览器及设备验证。本地试用可在仓库根目录运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add .` 安装 checkout，然后重启 Web profile 并刷新页面。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)。打包依赖的许可证说明见 [第三方声明](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Per-agent tool filter for the main agent (orchestrator) in DeepSeek Harness — minimal toolset for the orchestrator, full toolset for subagents.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-tool-filter

[![CI](https://github.com/Kiol-V/dsh-agent-tool-filter/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Kiol-V/dsh-agent-tool-filter/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

English version: see [README.en.md](<README.en.md>).

Per-agent фильтр инструментов **основного агента** (ведущего задачу) для DeepSeek Harness.

Цель — независимые наборы tools: выбранные пресеты работают с обрезанным набором
(экономия на tool-схемах в каждом запросе), субагенты сохраняют полный набор,
включая web. Штатного per-agent фильтра для основного агента в DSH нет.

## Важно перед установкой

01. **Возможности плагина могут пересечься с обновлениями DSH.** Функциональность
    per-agent фильтрации со временем может быть встроена в саму платформу. Прежде чем
    устанавливать плагин, проверьте актуальную версию DSH и список её обновлений:
    если нужные возможности уже доступны штатно, отдельный плагин не требуется.
02. **Фильтрация действует только на основного агента.** Скрытые инструменты у него
    отключаются; у субагентов они остаются доступными — плагин не переносит
    ограничения автоматически. Чтобы ограничение стало сквозным:
    - настройте для каждого субагента собственный пресет с подходящим набором
      инструментов. Например, для веб-поиска оставьте субагенту только web-инструменты
      и `read`; для других сценариев выберите свои наборы;
    - пропишите основному агенту рабочие сценарии: когда задача требует скрытого
      инструмента — не пытаться вызвать его напрямую, а передать задачу
      субагенту, у которого этот инструмент доступен.
    Без этих настроек агент будет упираться в отключённые инструменты вместо
    делегирования — фильтрация сработает, но рабочий процесс сломается.

Ограничение набора инструментов через пресет не подходит для этой задачи: оно
фиксируется при создании чата и наследуется субагентами, ограничивая их вместе
с основным агентом. Маска плагина применяется только к основному агенту и может
меняться без этих ограничений.

## Механика

01. На событии `agent/created` (listeners отрабатывают до первой сборки prompt) плагин
    определяет **пресет агента** (`agentPresets.composedPreset(agent.ctx)`) и по
    конфиг-матрице «пресет → профиль» выбирает профиль фильтрации.
02. Ограничение ставится в scope самого агента: `agent.ctx.tools.restrict(...)`.
    Фильтруются **только корневые агенты**: in-process субагенты присоединяются к пресету
    родителя (`composeFrom`) и показывают тот же пресет — без проверки `roots()` фильтр
    задел бы субагентов. SDK-субагенты живут в отдельном процессе и не задеваются вовсе.
03. Маски `restrict()` пересекаются, поэтому при смене конфига старые ограничения
    **снимаются** (disposers), а новые ставятся заново. Состояние хранится на самом агенте
    и переживает hot-reload плагина.
04. Собственные registrations scope (own-layer и динамические: `team_*`, `team_task_*`,
    `spawn_teammate`, `wait_agent`, structured-output и пр.) `restrict()` не маскирует.

## Конфигурация

Пакет устанавливается как bundle через Plugin Manager и сам предоставляет строку плагина.
Настройте матрицу и профили в UI-карточке; изменения применяются горячо (HMR). Ниже — пример
значений конфигурации:

~~~yaml
- insert:
    - id: agent-tool-filter
      name: dsh-agent-tool-filter
      config:
        enabled: true
        behavior: auto               # auto выбирает hide/block по истории; hide или block фиксируют режим
        debugLog: false              # файловая диагностика шагов фильтрации
        language: auto               # язык UI плагина: auto/ru/en
        presets:                    # матрица «id пресета → имя профиля»; пусто = не фильтровать нигде
          cordis: cordis-trim
          standard: minimal-orchestrator
        profiles:                   # свои профили и правка дефолтных (переопределяют по имени)
          my-profile:
            mode: deny              # deny — убрать перечисленные; allow — оставить только их
            tools: [web_search, web_fetch]
~~~

| Поле | Дефолт | Значение |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `false` — плагин пассивен |
| `behavior` | `auto` | режим совместимости: `auto` выбирает по истории, `hide` скрывает схемы (см. сноску о рисках), `block` оставляет схемы видимыми, но блокирует выбранные вызовы |
| `debugLog` | `false` | файловая диагностика шагов фильтрации (путь файла — в блоке «Диагностика») |
| `presets` | пусто | матрица «пресет → профиль»; пусто = ничего не фильтровать (установка не меняет поведение пресетов) |
| `profiles` | встроенные (см. ниже) | пользовательские профили; совпадение имени перекрывает встроенный |
| `language` | `auto` | язык UI плагина: `auto` — как в приложении, либо `ru` / `en` |

⚠ **Риск режима `hide`:** фиксированное скрытие схем не защищает от ошибок строгих
провайдеров — если в истории чата остались вызовы скрываемых инструментов, ходы могут
завершаться ошибкой «Провайдер вернул некорректный вызов инструмента». Режим `auto`
сам выбирает безопасное поведение по истории; фиксируйте `hide` только когда история
чиста либо провайдер мягкий.

## Профили фильтрации и шаблоны

По умолчанию установлен один универсальный профиль; остальные добавляются импортом
пакетов-шаблонов прямо из UI-карточки.

| Профиль/пакет | Содержимое (deny) | Идея |
|---|---|---|
| `balanced` (встроенный) | админ: `plugin_manager`, `security_audit`, `test_drive`, `drive_report`, `create_skill`, `subagent_fork` | базовая обрезка для любого пресета |
| пакет `gradient` | `strict` (админ + web), `soft` (web) | ступени ограничения вокруг `balanced` |
| пакет `roles` | `focus`, `no-web`, `no-admin`, `minimal` | профили по назначению |
| пакет `layers` | `no-web`, `no-admin`, `no-dev-skills` | одна категория = один профиль, комбинируйте копиями |

Любой профиль можно скопировать и править под себя (свои списки tools, режим
`deny`/`allow`); встроенный `balanced` переопределяется по имени, но не удаляется.

## Что делает установка

Пакет **не добавляет** пресетов, инструментов и чужой конфигурации — только файлы плагина и bundle-строку с безопасной конфигурацией по умолчанию. При первой активации плагин **сканирует установленный DSH** (реальные tools и
пресеты) и сверяет профили обрезки с вашим набором; отчёт — в лог. Фильтрация выключена до
тех пор, пока вы не свяжете пресет с профилем (матрица `presets`). Подробная инструкция —
[docs/filtering-guide.md](<docs/filtering-guide.md>).

## UI

UI-карточка настроек открывается из Plugin Manager: строка `dsh-agent-tool-filter` →
Configure. В карточке:

- тумблер «Фильтрация включена» и статус (агенты с маской, скрыто схем);
- тумблер «Файловая диагностика» — вкл/выкл запись лога шагов фильтрации; путь файла
  показан в блоке «Диагностика»;
- **матрица «пресет → профиль»** карточками в два блока (дефолтные и кастомные):
  связка/замена/снятие профиля, копия пресета (с предпросмотром описания) и
  удаление кастомных;
- **профили**: создание/правка/копия в модальных окнах, три группы tools (включённые,
  управляемые, неуправляемые), импорт пакетов-шаблонов; проблемные имена (опечатки,
  «ограничитель отклонит маску») показываются с активным чекбоксом и пометкой —
  снятие отметки и сохранение убирает имя из профиля;
- **сканирование tools** — сводка по палитре DSH («✅ N tools можно отключить /
  ⚠ M tools нельзя отключить») и предупреждения с причинами; у предупреждений
  «не найдено» — кнопка «Убрать имя из профиля» (имя исчезает из всех профилей);
- **диагностика** — свёрнутый блок с техническими данными (remote, locale, версия,
  путь файла лога, счётчики);
- интерфейс на русском и английском (переключатель языка, режим «Как в приложении»); в Plugin Manager также доступны русские и английские метаданные и оригинальная иконка плагина.

## Валидация имён и диагностика

- При старте и по `scanTools()` плагин сверяет имена инструментов в профилях с глобальным
  списком tools. Неизвестные и нефильтруемые имена (own-layer registrations: `team_task_*`,
  `spawn_teammate`, `wait_agent`) попадают в **предупреждения** (лог и UI-карточка), а не в
  тихий пропуск.
- `restrict()` дополнительно проверяет имена при применении: неизвестное имя не блокирует
  остальные (deny применяется поимённо), ошибка

plugins.description: QR/barcode scanner for DeepSeek Harness: decode images, the live screen or a webcam with zxing-cpp (WASM), and generate QR codes. 4 model tools, ~14 ms per decode.
plugins.readme_text:
# AI-QR-code-scanning-

QR / barcode scanning for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): give the model eyes for codes — from image files, the live screen, or a webcam — plus QR generation.

Decoding is powered by **zxing-cpp compiled to WebAssembly** (`zxing-wasm`), the same C++ core behind most desktop scanners, so rotated, inverted, tiny, perspective-skewed and multi-symbol images all work.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Input |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `qr_scan` | Decode every code in an image, with positions | path, glob, http(s) URL |
| `qr_scan_screen` | Capture the screen (optionally a region) and decode | `region: "x,y,w,h"` |
| `qr_scan_camera` | Grab one webcam frame and decode | optional device name |
| `qr_make` | Render text/URL as a QR PNG | writes to `.dsh-qr/` in the workspace |

```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "source": "C:\\shots\\poster.png",
  "results": [
    { "text": "http://cloud.example.com/embed/76e3ca", "format": "QR Code", "kind": "url", "box": [215, 403, 300, 489] }
  ]
}
```

`kind` classifies the payload as `url` / `wifi` / `contact` / `email` / `phone` / `sms` / `numeric` / `text`.

## Install

From GitHub (recommended; add the `dsh-plugin` topic and the marketplace picks it up automatically):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mkingyixing/AI-QR-code-scanning-
```

From npm: not published yet. npm rejects uppercase package names, so publishing would need a lowercase name (e.g. `ai-qr-code-scanning`) — see [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md).

Local install (desktop profile, no network):

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install.ps1
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards. Uninstall with `-Uninstall`.

## Why a plugin instead of a script

On the shared 10-image corpus (rotation, inversion, 78px thumbnail, blurry JPEG, perspective, two codes in one frame) zxing-cpp scores 10/10 — see `tools/_bench/results.md`. Running it in-process removes the interpreter startup:

| Metric | Python script | This plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| One decode (cold) | ~750 ms | 92 ms (WASM load) |
| One decode (warm) | ~750 ms | **13.6 ms** |
| Full-screen capture + decode | ~1 500 ms | **227 ms** |

## Config

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: tool-qr-scanner
      name: AI-QR-code-scanning-
      config:
        outputDir: .dsh-qr
        maxInputBytes: 20971520
        timeoutMs: 20000
```

## Privacy

Everything runs locally: WASM decoding, GDI screen capture, ffmpeg frame grabs. No network calls unless you pass an explicit http(s) URL to `qr_scan`. Screenshots stay in memory unless `save: true`.

## Limitations

- Screen capture uses Win32 GDI via `koffi`, so it is **Windows-only**; `qr_scan` and `qr_make` still work elsewhere.
- Webcam capture needs `ffmpeg` on `PATH` (or `DSH_FFMPEG`).
- Image formats: PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP/TIFF/AVIF (decoded by sharp).

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 自管理插件管理器：插件安装、升级、回滚、健康检查与注册表扫描。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-self-plugin-manager

DSH 自安装插件管理器：在 **设置 → 插件** 中新增一个 **「自安装插件」** 页签，
把「哪些插件是这个 profile 自己装的」「它们现在是否健康」「能不能更新/回滚」三件事
一次说清，并且**只读数据来自权威记录**而非目录扫描。

目标宿主：**DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0-rc.2**。

---

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 数据来源 |
| --- | --- |
| **自安装归属**：区分 profile 自装插件与 DSH 自带插件 | `pluginManager.listBundles()` 的 `installed` / `removable` / `optional`，与 profile `package.json` 的依赖表交叉验证 |
| **运行健康** | Loader 的 `PluginFiberPhase`（`active` / `failed` / `pending` / `loading` / `unloading` / `null`）＋ `BundleInfo.error` |
| **宿主兼容** | `pluginManager.listVersionExemptions()` 的豁免记录＋当前运行版本（由本机可解析的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 包版本得出，并回报来源） |
| **更新** | 本插件按宿主同款方式询问 registry（`pnpm view <name> version --json`，在 profile 目录内），再 `installBundle('<name>@<version>')` |
| **回滚** | 回到本插件自己记录的「上一次变更前」的精确版本 |
| **更新后验证会话**（默认关闭） | `sessionController.create → selectModel → rename → prompt` |
| **DPIP 前置校验** | 读取 `$DSH_HOME/operation-security/plugin-state.json` |

---

## 安全契约（请先读这一节）

**写路径不受 DSH 既有审批门禁覆盖。** 实测事实（对本机 0.2.0-rc.2 安装产物核对）：

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-operation-security` 只挂在**工具管线**上
  （`ctx.on('tools/pre-execute')` + `ctx.tools.guard()`），因此它看不到任何 Gateway 调用；
- 它的检测器匹配 `dsh plugin …` shell 命令与动态 Cordis 生命周期工具，
  **没有** `plugin_manager` 的规则；
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager` 服务内部没有安全或审批钩子；
- DSH 自带的 Web Plugins 页同样是直接调用 `remote.pluginManager.*` 的。

所以本插件的「更新 / 回滚」是一条**额外的写通道**，唯一守着它的是本插件的
`lib/gate.js`：

1. `plugin-state.json` **不可读 / 损坏 → 一律拒绝**（fail closed，与安全层
   `pluginStateUnknown` 的语义一致）；
2. 状态为 `BLOCKED` / `QUARANTINED` / `ROLLBACK_REQUIRED` → **拒绝**；
3. 状态为 `ACTIVE` → 放行；
4. 其余（含「没有任何 DPIP 记录」）→ 需要调用方显式传
   `acknowledgedUncovered: true`，UI 以此强制一次逐动作的二次确认。

第 4 条**不等于一次 DPIP 审批**：安全层对这种插件返回的是 `ask`，
而本插件只能把它变成一次用户点击，无法代替 DPIP 的来源核验、制品完整性校验、
依赖审查与隔离安装。**README、UI 与代码注释都不得把它描述为已受 DPIP 保护。**

另外，安装动作本身**不接受任意 spec**：

- `update` 只能给**包名**；版本由本插件问 registry 得到（见下），调用方无法指定它；
- `rollback` 只能回到本插件记录的精确版本；
- `link:` / `file:` / `workspace:` 本地依赖一律拒绝更新与回滚
  （否则会把开发者的 checkout 换成 registry 上的另一个包）；
- 不提供「安装新插件」入口。

### 「检查更新」为什么自己问 registry（2026-10-15 实测）

**宿主的 `pluginManager.inspect(spec)` 不能用来查已安装包的版本。** 它在询问
registry **之前**就先拒绝：`known` 集合 = profile 的 `bundles` + `dependencies`
+ 安装锚点的 dependencies，命中即返回 `problem: 'already-installed'`
（`dsh-plugin-manager/lib/index.js`；`name@latest` 之类的写法也没用，解析后仍取裸包名）。
本插件能操作的对象按定义都在这个集合里，所以用 `inspect()` 实现「检查更新」必然报
`inspect-already-installed`——这正是首版上线的缺陷。宿主也没有第二个只读入口：
它的全部方法只有 `cancelInstall` / `inspect` / `installBundle` / `listBundles` /
`listPlugins` / `listVersionExemptions` / `registries` / `removeBundle` /
`setBundleEnabled` / `setPluginEnabled` / `setVersionExemption` / `waitForInstall`，
且 `BundleInfo` 里没有「最新版本」字段。

因此版本由 `lib/registry.js` + `service.resolveLatest()` 自己问，方式与宿主自己的
预检一致：在 **profile 目录内** 运行 `pnpm view <name> version --json`，所以同一份
`.npmrc`、代理与认证设置生效；registry 顺序来自 `pluginManager.registries()`
（配置项 → 声明的 fallback）。

三条约束是刻意的：

- **只读**：`pnpm view` 只询问并打印，不安装、不写 profile 文件；这是本插件**唯一**
  的子进程。
- **参数不可注入**：包名由 `findSelfBundle()` 限定为已在 profile 清单里的名字，
  且必须通过 `isSafePackageName()`；registry URL 必须通过 `isSafeRegistryUrl()`。
  Windows 上命令经 `cmd.exe` 执行（npm 的 pnpm 垫片是 `pnpm.cmd`，Node 不能直接执行），
  因此这两个校验是命令行的安全边界。
- **私有源不外泄**：只有首问地址是公共的（npm 官方源，或部署自己声明的 fallback）
  才允许转问下一个 registry；私有源的包名不会被拿去问公共镜像。

---

## 更新后的验证会话（`autoVerify`，**默认关闭**）

打开 `autoVerify` 后，每一次**真正生效**的版本变更（更新或回滚）都会：

1. `sessionController.create({})` 建一个会话；
2. 选模型（见下）；`selectModel`；
3. `rename` 为 `插件更新验证：<包名>`；
4. `prompt` 一条验证任务：**是否加载 / 是否运行 / 是否返回结果**，最后要求一行 `PASS` 或 `FAIL`，
   并在提示里明确要求：**若 DSH 提示需要重启才能加载新的 JS 世代，不得判 PASS**。

三条边界是刻意的：

- **默认关闭。** 建会话并给 Agent 发问是**代你执行**的动作，因此只有你在 `cordis.patch.yml`
  里显式打开才会发生；配置开关比 UI 开关更难被误触。
- **`restart-required` 不触发。** 此时新的 JS 世代还没加载，新会话验证的是**旧代码**，
  有可能报出误导性的 PASS。这类变更只返回 `verification.reason = "restart-required-first"`。
- **不声称"最低成本"。** 见下。

### 为什么没有「自动选最低成本模型」

实测（0.2.0-rc.2）：**Harness 不向插件暴露任何 token 价格**。

| 候选来源 | 实际字段 |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionController.modelCatalog()` → `ModelCatalogModel` | `id` / `name` / `description?` / `reasoning?` |
| `llm.listModels()` → `LlmModelInfo` | `provider` / `id` / `name` / `description?` / `inputModalities?` |
| `llm.resolveModelInfo()` → `LlmResolvedModelInfo` | 上述 + `context?` / `defaultMaxTokens?` / `reasoning?` / `systemPromptUpdate?` / `toolUpdate?` |
| `llm.imageRequestPricing()` | 只给**图像** token 计价，与文本单价无关 |

本机唯一的价格表属于第三方插件 `dsh-budget` 自己的配置。因此**成本排序无法从被支持的 API 算出**，
本插件不用「名字里有 mini/flash 就便宜」这类猜测去冒充它。

实际行为：`verifyModelProvider` + `verifyModel` **两者都设置**时用你指定的路由
（`modelSource: "configured"`），否则用 `modelCatalog()` 的部署默认
（`"deployment-default"`），再否则用第一个可路由模型（`"first-routable"`）。
`modelSource` 会随结果一并返回，四种取值都不含任何成本含义。想固定用某个便宜路由，就在这里指名。

---

## 结构与两侧

```
dsh-self-plugin-manager/
├── package.json          dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + icon + locale 导出
├── cordis.patch.yml      Host 行（含 writesEnabled 开关与风险说明）
├── client.js             浏览器半边（经 window.__ModuleLoader__.load 加载）
├── lib/
│   ├── index.js          插件入口：apply() + Config
│   ├── service.js        SelfPluginsService：overview/check/update/rollback
│   ├── scan.js           纯函数：归属判定与视图模型组装
│   ├── health.js         纯函数：fiber 相位 / bundle error → 健康判据
│   ├── gate.js           DPIP 前置校验（镜像 FilePluginStateStore 语义）
│   ├── registry.js       纯函数：registry 计划、pnpm view 的 argv、输出解析与失败归因
│   ├── update.js         回滚点日志与 ChangeResult 归因
│   ├── runtime.js        运行版本探测（回报来源）
│   ├── wire.js           Remote 方法表 + 手写 @Remote 标记 + 无依赖 strict codec
│   └── json-safe.js      Remote 结果的无损 JSON 归一化
├── test/                 node --test
└── verify/               wiring / activation / dispatch 三档真实装配验证
```

两侧通过**本插件自己的** Gateway 命名空间 `selfPlugins` 通信，客户端
**从不**直接调用 `remote.pluginManager` —— 否则 Host 侧的 DPIP 前置校验会被绕过。

### 两个刻意的工程取舍

**不用 `@Remote` 装饰器。** 装饰器需要编译/转译；本插件是零构建的纯 ESM。
`lib/wire.js` 直接写入装饰器会写的那个原型属性
（`'@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol/remote-methods'`），`verify/wiring.mjs`
用真实的 `remoteMethods()` 证明它可被读取。

**不用 zod 构造 codec。** Gateway Client 要求每个参数 codec 有
`mode: 'strict'`，Typert registry 要求非空 `typeSymbol` 与可调用的 `create`；
这条路径上**没有任何代码会调用 `create()`**（客户端把值直接放进 `args`，
Host 侧按 SRC 派生以 `src-json` 解码）。因此 codec 无需 schema 库。

---

## 安装

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle   target = 本包目录的绝对路径
```

或 CLI：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本包目录>`。

**本机注意（2026-10-12 实测）**：`dsh-ops@0.2.9` 依赖
`@dsh-ops/bash-win32-x64@0.2.1`，该版本在 **npmjs 上存在**，
但配置的 `registry.npmmirror.com` 上只有 `0.0.0-stage`。
因此任何 `pnpm add` 都会在解析阶段失败（`ERR_PNPM_NO_MATCHING_VERSION`），
与本插件无关。绕过方式是一次性指定 registry：

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target=<绝对路径>  registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

该参数只作用于本次操作，不修改 `.npmrc`。

安装是 `link:` 方式（`dsh-self-plugin-manager link:<本包目录>`），
**因此本包目录的 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/*` 是运行时依赖**：
它指向本机 DSH 安装内的同名包，保证插件与宿主使用同一份 `cordis` /
`dsh-typert-protocol`，避免版本漂移。该目录被 `.gitignore` 排除，
新克隆的仓库需先重建（见 `AGENTS.md`）。

---

## 验证

```powershell
npm test                 # node --test，全部单元与 stub 集成用例
npm run check            # 语法检查 + 全部测试
npm run verify           # wiring + activation + dispatch 三档真实装配验证
npm run verify:registry  # 真实 pnpm + 真实 registry（需要网络与 PATH 上的 pnpm）
```

`verify/registry.mjs` 是唯一**真的去问 registry** 的一档：它用真实的
`runPnpmView` 启动真实的 `pnpm`，证明「宿主不能回答的那个问题」这条路真的通
（默认问 `dsh-ops`，可用 `DSH_SPM_VERIFY_PACKAGE` / `DSH_SPM_VERIFY_REGISTRY` 覆盖）。
因为它需要网络，所以不在 `npm run verify` 里。

`verify/dispatch.mjs` 是三档里最有价值的一档：它用**真实的** Host Gateway
调度器调用本插件的端点，证明「没有生成式 strict 定义时 SRC 派生仍然可用」
「wire 参数按名送达」「DPIP 门禁在 Host 侧生效且拒绝是正常结果而非传输故障」。

组合层：

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config   # 退出码 0 且包含 id: self-plugin-manager
```

---

## 已知边界

- **不做**自建下载器、SHA256 自校验、`backup/` 或 `old-version/` 目录：
  pnpm 与 `pluginManager` 已提供 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 的快照与恢复，
  重复实现只会制造第二份真相。
- **不做** API 翻译层（原方案的 `adapter/0.2-to-0.3.ts`）：rc.2 没有这样的机制，
  兼容性由 `peerDependencies` + `engines.dsh` + 精确版本豁免实现。
- `restart-required` **不视为已生效**：改动过已安装包的 JS 世代需要重启进程。
- `autoVerify` 默认关闭；打开后仍不会在 `restart-required` 的变更上建会话。
- 本插件不提供、也不推断模型成本，因此没有「自动选最低成本模型」这一能力。
- 健康判据只映射 rc.2 真实存在的信息；`null` 相位被如实报为「无活动实例」，
  不猜测成失败或成功。
- **「检查更新」依赖 `pnpm` 在 PATH 上且有网络**：两者缺一时如实返回
  `pnpm-missing` / `registry-network` 等拒绝码并附上诊断，而不是假装已是最新。
  版本解析不经过 DPIP 前置校验（它只读、不安装

plugins.description: Recursive Harness for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): Propose, Probe, Compose loops and a cross-task experience library (Harness², arXiv:2610.14224). Work in progress.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-recursive-harness · Recursive Harness

English · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

A plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) that evolves the agent's **harness** while the model weights stay frozen, following the two-level recursion of Google Research's **Harness²** ([arXiv:2610.14224](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.14224)):

- **Per task: Propose → Probe → Compose.** A model proposes two candidate harnesses (a *general* one that sharpens reasoning and tool discipline, and a *domain* one that adds memory, guardrails and a skill). Each candidate runs in an isolated headless dsh with a copy of the task workspace. Objective checks decide first, behavioral metrics (tool errors, steps, tokens) second, an optional model judge last. Complementary winners are merged and verified again; a worse merge falls back to the best single candidate.
- **Across tasks: Reflector → Experience Library.** What worked and what failed is written as plain Markdown entries that later proposals can draw on, in strict time order.

What gets evolved: four system prompt sections (`systemprompt`, `guardrails`, `tool_guidance`, `longTermMemory`) and candidate skills (`SKILL.md` plus small scripts). What never changes: your `AGENTS.md`, `.dsh/`, `.git/`, and anything you list in `lockedSurfaces`.

**Status: experimental.** It works end to end on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2, and the evaluation in [`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md) was run with a real model on a 12-task synthetic set. Read the report's limitations before expecting gains on your own tasks.

## What you see

1. Install the plugin. Every new Session now carries the active harness version (four sections once each in the system prompt; `/harness inspect` shows the version and the mounted skills).
2. `/harness start gen-dev-01` (a built-in task) or `/harness start ./my-task.mjs` starts an evolution run in the background: reference runs, proposals, probes, comparison, compose. `/harness status <runId>` follows it; `/harness cancel <runId>` stops it and kills the child processes.
3. When a candidate beats the baseline on the objective checks and by more than the baseline's own variance, it becomes the active version. **New Sessions** get it; running Sessions are never changed mid-flight. `/harness rollback [versionId]` goes back.
4. `/harness listExperience` lists what the reflector kept.

The same commands exist on the command line: `npx dsh-recursive-harness inspect | start | status | cancel | rollback | listExperience` (state under `./.dsh-harness` by default; `--config` takes a JSON file with the same keys as the plugin settings).

## Requirements

- dsh 0.2.x. Tested on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 (Windows 11, Node.js 24.21) with the web profile; probes use the headless profile that ships with dsh.
- Node.js 22.19 or later in the 22 line, or 24 and later (the same as dsh).
- A **proposer endpoint**: any OpenAI-compatible chat completions server (vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, Ollama, or a hosted API). Until you configure one, the proposer is a fixed template and no text leaves your machine.
- Probes run with the model of the profile you name in `probe.templateProfile` (default `web`), or with `probe.provider` / `probe.model` if you set them. Each probe is a full agent run; budget accordingly.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness
```

Through npx: `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`. Restart `dsh web`. The plugin prints `[recursive-harness] ready: …` on start.

**Update:** `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`, then restart. dsh installs plugins with pnpm, which picks a newly published version only once it is a day old; to update right away, name the version (`add dsh-plugin-recursive-harness@0.1.0`).

To remove: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-recursive-harness`, delete the `recursive-harness` entry from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` if you added one, and delete `~/.dsh/recursive-harness/` if you do not want to keep the harness versions and the experience library.

## Settings

Settings go in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (web profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`). An entry with `id: recursive-harness` replaces the plugin's whole `config`; keys you leave out keep the defaults in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml).

```yaml
- id: recursive-harness
  config:
    proposer:
      engine: llm
      endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions
      model: my-model
      apiKeyEnv: ""            # env var with the key, if the endpoint needs one
      allowEgress: false       # true before anything goes to a non-loopback endpoint
      allowHttpHosts: []       # non-loopback hosts that may be reached over plain http
      judge: true              # model judge as the third tier; never overrides objective checks
      jsonMode: false          # send response_format json_object (vLLM, OpenAI)
      extraBody: {}            # e.g. { chat_template_kwargs: { enable_thinking: false } }
    probe:
      templateProfile: web     # probes inherit this profile's model rows and credentials
      provider: ""             # override the probe model (a provider id from llm-pi-ai)
      model: ""
      blockedTools: []         # tasks needing these tools are never probed
    lockedSurfaces: []         # extra paths a candidate may never touch
    protectedPatterns: []      # regexes that reject a candidate (e.g. "\\bPROD-DB\\b")
    maxConcurrency: 2          # parallel probe child processes
    maxTokensPerIteration: 120000
    probeTimeoutMs: 600000
```

### Your own tasks

A task file is an ES module that exports a task (or `tasks`, an array). The plugin writes `workspaceFiles` into an empty workspace, runs the agent with `prompt`, and hands the final output to `objectiveCheck`:

```js
// my-task.mjs
export default {
  taskId: 'orders-report',
  split: 'dev',
  domain: 'general',
  prompt: '讀取 orders.csv，輸出 { total, byRegion } 的 JSON，byRegion 依名稱排序。',
  workspaceFiles: { 'orders.csv': 'region,amount\nEast,10\nWest,5\nEast,2\n' },
  expected: { total: 17, byRegion: { East: 12, West: 5 } },
  objectiveCheck(record, task) {
    const data = JSON.parse(record.finalOutput.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/)[0]);
    const ok = data.total === task.expected.total;
    return { passed: ok, score: ok ? 1 : 0, details: ok ? [] : [`total 應為 ${task.expected.total}，實得 ${data.total}`] };
  },
};
```

The proposer never sees `expected`; the numbers in `details` are masked before they reach it. Keep a held-out set of tasks the proposer has not seen to tell real improvements from overfitting.

## Where things live

`$DSH_HOME/recursive-harness/` (by default `~/.dsh/recursive-harness/`):

- `active/` the mounted harness: `systemprompt.md`, `guardrails.md`, `tool_guidance.md`, `LongTermMEMORY.md`, `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (+ `scripts/`). You can edit these by hand; the next Session mounts the edited version.
- `state/` `manifest.json`, `checkpoints/<runId>.json`, `harnesses/<versionId>/` snapshots, `sessions/` sidecars, `events.jsonl`.
- `experience/` `INDEX.md` and one folder per entry (`EXPERIENCE.md`, the harness snapshot it came from).

Each probe runs in `<tmp>/dshp-*/` with its own `DSH_HOME` (profile, credentials copied from the template profile, the candidate harness) and workspace, deleted when the probe ends. Stale directories left by a killed process are swept at the next start.

## What leaves your machine

- To the proposer endpoint: the task prompt, the current harness text, summaries of the reference runs (tool names, argument excerpts, error messages, a final-output excerpt with keys and private IPs redacted), and relevant experience entries. Only when `proposer.engine` is `llm`.
- From the probes: whatever the agent's model receives in a normal dsh Session, through the model rows of the template profile.
- Nothing else. There is no telemetry; the plugin never calls GitHub or npm.

## Evaluation

See [`docs/evaluation-report.md`](docs/evaluation-report.md) for the real-model run (setup, per-task numbers, limitations). The two gates it re

plugins.description: Medical literature search, citation formatting, and open-access full text for DeepSeek Harness (PubMed, Europe PMC, arXiv, bioRxiv, medRxiv).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-medical-literature
项目想法来源于本人之前想做的deepresearch，好像目前没有做医学文献检索的就用deepseek改了一版适配dsh的插件。简单用gemini 4 argon测试了一下检索skill，可以下载之后让agent根据用户习惯来修改不同检索源的检索skill，以下为插件介绍：

面向**医学 / 生命科学**的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：检索 PubMed、Europe PMC、arXiv、bioRxiv、medRxiv，生成引用（Vancouver / APA / GB/T 7714 / Nature / BibTeX / RIS / CSL-JSON），并读取开放获取全文用于核对“这句话是否有文献支持”。

工具统一使用 `medical_` 前缀，与 `@shlv/dsh-literature`（dblp + arXiv 的 CS 工具）区分，两者可以共存。

插件是零运行时依赖的纯 Node ESM 模块（只用 Node 内置的 `fetch` 和 `node:fs`），不依赖 Python、Biopython 或任何 npm 包。

---

## 1. 五个工具

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `medical_literature_search` | 多源检索 + 去重 + CSV/JSON 导出 |
| `medical_literature_get` | 单篇题录（含 volume/issue/pages、撤稿标记）+ 完整摘要 |
| `medical_literature_cite` | 题录 → 格式化引用 / `.bib` / `.ris` / CSL-JSON |
| `medical_literature_fulltext` | 开放获取全文 → 章节索引 + 有界正文 + Markdown 落盘 |
| `medical_literature_check` | 句子 → 最相关段落；参考文献表 → 重复/撤稿告警 |

### `medical_literature_search`

| 参数 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | string | 共享检索词。自由文本按源自动适配（arXiv 去停用词） |
| `queries` | object | **推荐。** 每个源一条原生 query，值原样发送；键即源名 |
| `sources` | string[] | 默认 `["pubmed","europepmc","arxiv","biorxiv"]`；可选 `medrxiv` |
| `max_results` | integer | **融合后**最终返回条数，1–100，默认 10 |
| `candidates` | integer | 每个源的召回窗口，1–100，默认 `max(20, 3×max_results)`；预期论文排在源内靠后时调大 |
| `fusion` | string | `rrf`（默认，只用各源自己的排名做倒数排名融合）/ `source`（按源分块）/ `bm25`（本地词频重排，显式要求才用） |
| `year_from` / `year_to` | integer | 出版年闭区间 |
| `sort` | `"relevance"` / `"date"` / `"cited"` | 默认 `relevance`；`date` 按日期倒序；`cited` 按 Europe PMC 被引次数倒序，**只能单源 `sources:["europepmc"]`** |
| `abstract_chars` | integer | 摘要截断长度，默认 600；0 = 不显示 |
| `save_path` | string | `.csv` / `.json` / `.jsonl`；相对路径按会话工作目录解析 |

**排序策略**：默认信任各引擎自己的排序——PubMed 的 Best Match 已经综合了 MeSH、字段权重、时间等信号，Europe PMC 和 arXiv 也一样。插件只做 **RRF（倒数排名融合）**：每个源的第 1 名得 `1/61`、第 2 名 `1/62`……跨源相加，**不重新按词频打分**。只有显式写 `fusion: "bm25"` 才会用本地 BM25 覆盖源排序（它不知道 MeSH/引用量/时间，通常更差）。想扩大召回就调大 `candidates` / `max_results`，而不是重排。

**经典 vs 前沿**：被引次数和时间是相反的信号。`sort: "cited"` 只走 Europe PMC 的 `CITED desc`，记录会带 `cited_by_count`；PubMed 没有引文排序。需要两者兼顾时分两次查——第一轨 Europe PMC `sort:"cited"` 捞 PROSEVA、CAPP2 这类奠基文献，第二轨 PubMed `sort:"date"`/`relevance` 捞最新试验，由模型分别呈现，不要混成一个分数。引文排序也偏袒老旧、宽泛的论文，查询里要先加设计过滤器或主题约束。

**为什么要分源写 query**：PubMed 认 `[tiab]` / `[MeSH Terms]`，Europe PMC 认 `TITLE_ABS:` / `MESH:` / `SRC:PPR`，arXiv 认 `ti:` / `abs:` / `cat:`。同一字符串发给三个引擎，轻则精度暴跌，重则 0 结果。插件会在发请求前拦截跨引擎语法并报错。完整语法见 [skills/medical-literature/SKILL.md](skills/medical-literature/SKILL.md)。

```json
{
  "queries": {
    "pubmed": "(CRISPR[tiab] OR \"Gene Editing\"[MeSH Terms]) AND 2024:2026[dp]",
    "europepmc": "TITLE_ABS:CRISPR AND MESH:\"Gene Editing\" AND PUB_YEAR:[2024 TO 2026]",
    "arxiv": "(abs:CRISPR OR abs:\"gene editing\") AND submittedDate:[202401010000 TO 202612312359]",
    "biorxiv": "TITLE_ABS:CRISPR AND TITLE_ABS:\"base editing\""
  },
  "max_results": 20,
  "save_path": "crispr_preprints.csv"
}
```

**召回技巧**：arXiv 用词干/通配符 `abs:patholog*`、`abs:histopatholog*`、`abs:prognos*`，否则 `pathology` 匹配不到 `pathological`；`totals` 远大于返回数时（如 `arxiv 5/444`），目标方法可能排在 42 位，需按名查或调大 `max_results`。

**已知系统名**（如 PathAgent、NOVA、SPARK）不要当概念查：`agent` 匹配不到 `agentic` 或 `PathAgent` 这个 token，SPARK/NOVA 还是会撞上普通词。直接 `ti:PathAgent OR ti:NOVA OR ti:SPARK`，并注意预印本在 arXiv、正式版在 PubMed/Europe PMC。

单个源失败不会让整个调用失败：错误进 `errors`，其余源照常返回；只有所有源都失败才抛错。

### `medical_literature_cite`

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `identifier` | 一条 DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID |
| `identifiers` | 多条（最多 50），生成一个参考文献列表 |
| `output` | `vancouver`（默认）、`apa`、`gb-t-7714`、`nature`、`bibtex`、`ris`、`csl-json` |
| `save_path` | 可选；`.bib` / `.ris` / `.json` 自动选择对应格式；显式 `output` 与扩展名冲突会报错 |

```jsonc
// 润色时插入一条引用
{ "identifier": "10.3390/cells13100800", "output": "vancouver" }

// 整理整份参考文献，导出给 Zotero
{ "identifiers": ["10.3390/cells13100800", "PMID:32939066", "arXiv:1706.03762"],
  "output": "bibtex", "save_path": "refs.bib" }
```

输出示例：

```text
# Vancouver
Laurent M, Geoffroy M, Pavani G, Guiraud S. CRISPR-Based Gene Therapies: From Preclinical to
Clinical Treatments. Cells. 2024;13(10):800. doi:10.3390/cells13100800

# APA 7
Laurent, M., Geoffroy, M., Pavani, G., & Guiraud, S. (2024). CRISPR-Based Gene Therapies: From
Preclinical to Clinical Treatments. Cells, 13(10), 800. https://doi.org/10.3390/cells13100800
```

- 元数据来自 PubMed / Europe PMC / Crossref，工具不会编造作者或年份。
- 模板是标准样式的近似实现，投稿前请按目标期刊的具体规则复核。
- 预印本使用 `@misc`（BibTeX）、`TY  - UNPB`（RIS）、`[EB/OL]`（GB/T）。

### `medical_literature_fulltext`

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `identifier` | DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID / URL |
| `section` | 可选，按章节标题过滤（如 `"methods"`） |
| `max_chars` | 返回给模型的正文上限，默认 12000 |
| `save` | 是否保存完整 Markdown，默认 `true` |
| `save_path` | 可选；默认 `literature/<id>/fulltext.md` |

```jsonc
{ "identifier": "PMID: 38786024", "section": "discussion", "max_chars": 8000 }
```

| 来源 | 全文途径 | 实测 |
|---|---|---|
| PMC / Europe PMC OA（有 PMCID） | `rest/{PMCID}/fullTextXML`（JATS） | ✅ 章节 + 参考文献完整 |
| arXiv | `arxiv.org/html/{id}` | ✅ 有 HTML 的论文 |
| bioRxiv / medRxiv | 无可靠途径 | ❌ PDF 端点 Cloudflare 429 |
| 付费墙期刊 | 无 | 只有摘要 |

**关于 403**：`europepmc.org/articles/...?pdf=render` 返回 Cloudflare 人机校验页，`pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/.../pdf/` 返回 reCAPTCHA 页，bioRxiv 返回 `429 error code: 1015`——这些是下载端点的反爬，不是付费墙，也不是代码问题。插件改用 **Europe PMC REST 的 JATS XML** 和 **arXiv HTML**，完全绕开 PDF 端点。

### `medical_literature_check`

用于润色时的两件事：**找支持句子的段落**，以及**审校一组参考文献**。

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `claim` | 要核对的句子；省略则只做参考文献审计 |
| `identifier` / `identifiers` | 1–10 条 DOI / PMID / PMCID / arXiv ID |
| `top_k` | 每个来源返回几段，默认 3 |
| `deep` | 是否读取 OA 全文，默认 `true`；`false` 只用摘要、更快 |

```jsonc
// 这句话是否有文献支持？
{ "claim": "CRISPR-based therapy has been approved for sickle cell disease",
  "identifiers": ["PMID: 38786024"], "top_k": 3 }

// 参考文献表是否有重复 / 撤稿？
{ "identifiers": ["PMID: 38786024", "10.3390/cells13100800"], "deep": false }
```

输出每段的 `coverage`（句子关键词命中比例）、`score`（BM25）和所在章节；同时给出：

- **重复**：同一 DOI / 标题对应多条引用
- **撤稿**：题录带 `retracted` 时警告
- **极性差异**：句子含否定词而最相关段落不含（或反之）时提示人工核对
- **弱匹配**：最高 coverage 低于阈值时提示“可能不支持”

**必须明确的限制**：这是**词面检索**（BM25 + 关键词覆盖），不是语义蕴含判断。它能可靠地把范围缩到几段，是否真的支持结论仍要读原文。实测中：

- “CRISPR 疗法已获批用于镰状细胞病” → 第一段直接命中摘要里 FDA 批准 Casgevy 的那句（coverage 0.71）
- “碱基编辑不产生双链断裂” → 正确句在 top 3 内，但缩写 DSB 导致 Cas9 段落排第一，同时触发极性警告
- “碱基编辑治愈所有实体瘤” → 无支持段落，触发 partial-match 警告

---

## 2. 安装到 DSH profile

插件按 DSH bundle 规范打包：`package.json` 声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`，`cordis.patch.yml` 插入 `medical-literature` 行。

### 从 npm 安装（推荐）

包已发布到 npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-medical-literature>

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-medical-literature
```

### 从本地源码安装（开发用）

```bash
# 先把 PLUGIN 指向本仓库（任意位置）
PLUGIN=/path/to/dsh-medical-literature-plugin
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add link:$PLUGIN
```

把包名加入 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`：

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-plugin-medical-literature"]
    }
  }
}
```

profile 默认开启配置热重载：改 `cordis.patch.yml` 或重新 `pnpm add` 可触发重组。**新增或修改工具 schema 时，已运行的 `dsh web` 仍缓存旧定义，需要新开会话或重启服务**；只改 skill 文本则下一次读取即可生效。

### 安装检索/引用 skill

从 npm 安装时：

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
ln -sfn ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-plugin-medical-literature/skills/medical-literature \
        ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

从本地源码安装时：

```bash
PLUGIN=/path/to/dsh-medical-literature-plugin
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills
ln -sfn $PLUGIN/skills/medical-literature ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

skill provider 会监听根目录，创建后无需重启即可出现在会话的 skill 目录里。

Skill 自带一个 PICO 拆解模板（人群/干预/对照/结局/研究类型 → MeSH + 自由词 + `[pt]` 过滤器）和一个 MeSH 映射脚本：

```bash
node ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature/scripts/mesh-map.mjs "chronic kidney disease"
# → PubMed 实际翻译："renal insufficiency, chronic"[MeSH Terms]
# → descriptor D051436，条目词 Chronic Kidney Diseases / Chronic Renal Insufficiency ...
```

它还能提前暴露缩写歧义：`MACE` 会被 PubMed 映射成 *Myristica*（肉豆蔻），`ATTR` 映射成 TTR 蛋白。

卸载：

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm remove dsh-plugin-medical-literature
# 从 dsh.profile.bundles 删除包名
rm ~/.dsh/skills/medical-literature
```

---

## 3. 数据源与限速

| 源 | 接口 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| PubMed | E-utilities `esearch` + `efetch`（MEDLINE） | 题录、摘要、MeSH、DOI、卷期页码、PMC |
| Europe PMC | REST `search` + `{PMCID}/fullTextXML` | 覆盖 MEDLINE/PMC/预印本；O

plugins.description: Glacier-blue glass UI layer for the DeepSeek Harness web client — light-field canvas, frosted panels, flat controls. Shipped as a dsh plugin.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-glacier

给 **DeepSeek Harness（dsh）web 端**用的玻璃质感 UI 层：Antigravity 风格的蓝调画布、磨砂玻璃面板、扁平控件。以标准 dsh 插件形态分发，不改宿主一行代码。

> 状态：**v0.2.0 — 画布 + 语义色 + 侧栏/输入容器 + 对话区已实现**，冒烟 7 项全通过。剩余：空态 hero 细节、浮层（模型菜单/设置）。
> 设计定稿：`design-prototype/`（可交互原型，含 11 张验收截图）。

---

## 它做什么

| 层 | 内容 | 手段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| L0 画布 | 蓝调渐变 + 三个缓慢漂移的色团 + 三条斜向光带 + 颗粒 | 自建 `.dsg-canvas` 固定层 |
| L1 语义色 | 文字 / 强调 / 边框 / 面板底色 | 覆盖 `--dsw-alias-*`（组件自动跟随） |
| L2 玻璃 | 侧栏、输入容器、气泡、代码块的磨砂质感 | CSS（低白度 + 高饱和 + 定向边缘高光 + 内部颗粒 + 投影） |
| L3 对话区 | 用户气泡、Markdown、代码块、工具卡与思考块、轮次尾巴 | CSS，锚点全部来自真实 DOM（`[data-chat-flow-kind]`、`[data-code-block-*]`、`[data-slot="tool.call.toolview"]`） |

原则：**只动视觉**。不改组件树、不重写交互、不注册 slot 组件（v0.1）。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-glacier
```

本地开发时用路径安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-glacier
```

装完刷新页面即可（前端半热生效）；卸载会恢复原样——插件的样式与画布层都在 `apply` 里可回收。

## 开发

```sh
npm run check      # 语法 + 选择器守卫 + 构建
npm run smoke      # 在真实 Chrome 里加载产物，验证注入/幂等/销毁（需本机 Chrome）
node tools/inspect-dsh.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=..."   # 抓宿主真实 DOM
```

零运行时依赖、零打包器：

```
client/index.js   ← 前端半（自包含，构建时注入 CSS）
client/*.css      ← tokens / canvas / theme / chat 四层（顺序即层叠顺序）
                    内部类前缀 dgl-（dsh-glacier layer），属性 data-dsh-glacier
src/index.js      ← 宿主半（占位，避免 boot 期副作用）
scripts/build.mjs ← 拼 CSS → 包成 window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)
```

产物：

- `client/client.js` — `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`
- `lib/index.js` — 宿主半

两者都不入库（见 `.gitignore`），`npm publish` 前由 `prepack` 生成。

## 三条硬约束（来自真实 DOM 实测）

1. **不新增全宽顶栏**。dsh 是三列布局（sidebar / center / rightbar）+ 拖拽把手，顶栏会打断它。窗口按钮走 `shell.leading`。
2. **不删空态 hero**。「探索未至之境 / 预览版 / 选择工作区 / 标准模式」是真实功能入口，只能改配色。
3. **选择器只用 `[data-slot]` / `[data-*]` / 组件名子串**（`[class*="_newSession"]`），绝不写包哈希前缀（`hHd-Xa_`）。`scripts/check-selectors.mjs` 会在 CI 里拦。

详见 [docs/structure-map.md](./docs/structure-map.md)。

## 版本策略

- 语义化版本；`0.x` 期间次版本号可能包含**选择器调整**（跟随 DSH 升级），补丁号只修样式与 bug。
- 每个版本必须写 `CHANGELOG.md`，分类 `Added / Changed / Fixed / Removed`。
- 发布前 `npm run check` 必须全绿；`npm run smoke` 建议在本地跑一遍。
- 新增 CSS 文件要登记进 `scripts/build.mjs` 的 `CSS_FILES`（顺序即层叠顺序）。

## 文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/structure-map.md](./docs/structure-map.md) | **实现前必读**：真实 DOM 骨架、191 个插槽、选择器策略、原型→真实映射、3 条必须避开的坑 |
| [docs/design-system.md](./docs/design-system.md) | 设计系统：画布配方、玻璃六件套、对比度实测、组件规格 |
| [docs/prototype-review.md](./docs/prototype-review.md) | 原型验收：截图、V01–V13、已知问题 |
| [docs/2026-10-21-dsh-web与插件市场调研.md](./docs/2026-10-21-dsh-web与插件市场调研.md) | 基础调研：插件契约、主题 API、市场机制与「兼容模式」 |
| [design-prototype/](./design-prototype) | 可交互原型（`npm run dev`） |

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件：划选会话文字一键引用到输入框 / Quote selected message text into the composer in DeepSeek Harness
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Selection Quote

[中文](README.zh.md)

Select text in a conversation message and quote it into the composer with one click. The quote keeps its source role, survives sending as a card, and can take you back to the original message.

- Package: `@lifenrir/dsh-selection-quote`
- DSH: `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`
- Node: `^22.19 || >=24`

## What it does

1. Select text inside a user or assistant message. A small toolbar appears above the selection.
2. Click **Quote**. A quote chip is inserted at the composer cursor, the composer regains focus, and the cursor lands after the quote.
3. Send the message. The quote is rendered as a card above the message text.
4. Click the chip or the card to scroll back to the quoted message and flash its outline.

The whole flow is two actions: select, then quote.

## Features

- **One-click quoting** from any user or assistant message; `steering` messages count as user text.
- **Non-destructive insertion**: the existing draft and other composer chips are left untouched, and insertion is a single undo step.
- **Role-labelled source**: the quote block starts with `[Quote] User message` / `[Quote] Assistant reply` (localized), so the model can tell who said it. Turn numbers are never included.
- **Code-aware**: when the selection lies entirely inside one fenced code block, the fence and language are preserved; partial selections fall back to plain text so no unterminated fence is produced.
- **Safe text**: output is plain text (never HTML), delimiters in the quoted body are escaped, and quotes longer than 4000 code points are truncated with a marker.
- **Scoped selection**: only text inside a single message can be quoted. Cross-message selections show a short hint instead of producing a misleading source.
- **Keyboard and theme support**: the toolbar is reachable by Tab, activates with Enter/Space, closes with Escape, uses DSH theme tokens, and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- **Localized** in Chinese and English, following the DSH UI locale.
- **No runtime dependencies** beyond the platform-provided `react`; all `@deepseek-ai/*` imports are type-only.

## Install

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin add @lifenrir/dsh-selection-quote
```

### From a local directory

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LiFenrir/dsh-selection-quote.git
cd dsh-selection-quote
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-selection-quote
```

`lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js` are committed, so `pnpm build` is only needed after changing `src/`.

### From git

```sh
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/LiFenrir/dsh-selection-quote.git
```

Reload the Web UI (or restart the profile) after adding and enabling the plugin.

## Usage

- Quote a passage: select it, click **Quote** (or focus the toolbar with Tab and press Enter).
- Dismiss the toolbar: click elsewhere, scroll, press Escape, or press the close button.
- Return to the source: click the quote chip in the composer, or the quote card in a sent message. If the message is not loaded yet, the plugin loads older history pages (up to 8) before giving up.

Quoting is refused while the composer is submitting; a short notice explains why.

## Development

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build    # esbuild -> lib/index.js + lib/client.js
pnpm test     # vitest (offline, jsdom for component specs)
```

Repository layout:

```text
src/index.ts             Host half (client-only plugin; empty apply)
src/client/              Selection observer, formatting, chip/card, toolbar
tests/                   Vitest specs
scripts/build-client.mjs esbuild bundler; also sets the client module id
lib/                     Built output (committed; shipped in the npm package)
```

**Type checking** is done inside a DSH source checkout. This repository intentionally omits the `tsconfig.json` `paths` entries that point into `deepseek-harness/...`, because those relative paths do not exist here. The shipped `tsconfig.json` keeps the compiler options for editors; run the full `tsc --noEmit` type check with the original tsconfig in the DSH source tree.

The client bundle is a `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` registration. Its `id` must equal the package name, so `scripts/build-client.mjs` sets `PLUGIN_ID = '@lifenrir/dsh-selection-quote'`.

## How it works

- A session-scoped observer listens for pointer and selection changes, validates that both endpoints belong to one message, and publishes a snapshot to a small root-scoped dock.
- A root-scoped toolbar renders above the selection and insert the quote through DSH's reference-chip insertion path.
- Sent messages pass through a user-text rule that recognizes the quote delimiters and renders a card; both the chip and the card can reveal the source message.
- All registrations go through `ctx.effect()` or slot injections; the plugin adds no Host route and no runtime dependency.

## Known limitations

- Selection is pointer-driven; touch long-press is not handled beyond leaving the native selection menu alone.
- A selection must stay inside one message.
- Jump-back matching uses the quote body as plain text. Markdown markers such as `**` in the first line can prevent a match; the plugin then reports that the source message is not loaded instead of jumping.
- The quote toolbar can linger until the next interaction if the anchored node is replaced without a `selectionchange`; insertion is still rejected safely.
- Only message text is quotable; tool results and reasoning content are excluded.
- Quote length is capped at 4000 code points; there is no quote history manager or "quote into a new session" flow.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: 在windows平台用everything实现@file
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-at-file-everything

Instant `@file` completion for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) on Windows, answered from the [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) search index through `es.exe`.

> 中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Why

The shipped `@deepseek-ai/dsh-file-reference-local` provider answers `@` from a workspace walk it performs itself, bounded by `maxEntries`. In a large tree that walk is both slow and lossy. On the Unity project this plugin was written for:

| | upstream walk | this plugin |
|---|---|---|
| what it searches | every file under the workspace root | Everything's index, scoped with `-path` |
| entry budget | `maxEntries` (50 000 by default) | none |
| first `@` of a session | full traversal | ~80 ms |
| warm query | re-ranks a bounded index | ~70–80 ms |
| coverage | ~469 k of ~1.5 M files, after tuning | the whole scope |
| heap | ~99 MB for the index | none held by the provider |

A concrete failure the upstream budget caused: ~1.2 M files under `Library/` and ~270 k under `Output/` exhausted the index before any `Assets/` source was reached, so `@PlayablePrefab` answered `Library/*` noise while the real file was missing. Everything already maintains that index machine-wide as a Windows service, so this provider answers from it and walks nothing.

## Install

```powershell
# once per machine (see "Why es.exe is not bundled" below)
winget install voidtools.Everything
winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli

# once per profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-at-file-everything
```

The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` then:

1. inserts the `file-reference-everything` row (this plugin), and
2. disables `file-reference-local`, so exactly one owner provides `ctx.fileReferences`.

Restart the Harness profile afterwards. Nothing else in the composition changes: the Session Controller's `fileReferences/list` Remote and the Web composer keep resolving the same service.

The published tarball ships the built `lib/`, so there is nothing to compile first.

### From a local checkout

While developing, install this repository directly instead:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<path to this repository>
```

> **Updating a `link:` install.** Under this profile's pnpm settings a `link:` dependency is materialised as a *copy*, not a symlink, so rebuilding `lib/` is not enough — the installed copy keeps serving the old bundle until you re-run `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:<path>` (or delete `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-at-file-everything` and re-add it). This bites during development: the plugin can look like it ignored a change.

## Requirements

- **Windows.** The plugin declares `os: win32`; on other platforms Everything does not exist and the plugin has nothing to answer from.
- **Everything 1.4+ running and indexing.** The plugin queries it; it does not bundle or start it.
- **`es.exe` v1.1.0+ on `PATH`**, or `esCommand` pointing at it.

Check the environment before blaming the plugin:

```powershell
es -get-everything-version   # the Everything service answering
es -version                  # the command-line client
```

### Why `es.exe` is not bundled

Bundling it does not make the plugin install-and-go, because `es.exe` is only the *client* half of Everything. It talks to the Everything service over its IPC window, and without that service it answers:

```
Error 8: Everything IPC window not found. Please make sure Everything is running.
```

So even with a copy vendored into this package, the user still has to install Everything, keep it running, and let it index the drives they care about — the part that actually makes `@file` work. A bundled client also silently drifts from the user's service, because Everything's IPC and index format are upgraded together with the service while a pinned client is frozen at release time.

The honest install story is therefore two commands, in this order:

```powershell
winget install voidtools.Everything          # the service and its index
winget install voidtools.Everything.Cli      # es.exe on PATH
```
