plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-confirmation-resolution

[![offline verification](https://github.com/bbaz123/dsh-confirmation-resolution/actions/workflows/offline-verification.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/bbaz123/dsh-confirmation-resolution/actions/workflows/offline-verification.yml)
[![License: Apache 2.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-Apache_2.0-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19.0-brightgreen.svg)](https://nodejs.org)
[![offline tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/offline%20tests-130%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](https://github.com/bbaz123/dsh-confirmation-resolution/actions/workflows/offline-verification.yml)

**让 DSH 在任务完成后的"待确认事项"阶段，既不机械照做，也不反复询问。**

> ⚠️ **安装前警告**
> 本插件按 npm 全局安装版 **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`** + web profile 构建，涉及 DSH 源码修改；
> **更新 DSH 可能导致插件不兼容**，请注意。升级 DSH 后请重跑 `npm run check` 与
> `dsh --profile web --dump-config`，详见下文「兼容与风险说明」。

**当前支持并验证的宿主：DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`；profile 内 `dsh-tools` /
`dsh-brand` / `dsh-util-values` 同为 `0.2.0-rc.2`，peer 声明为 `^0.2.0-rc.2`）。
V1 契约保持不变，V2 是**默认启用**的版本化入口。

`dsh-confirmation-resolution` 是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的待确认事项决策插件。

当 DSH 完成主任务、留下 `C1` / `C2` / `C3` … 等待确认事项之后，用户的回复不会被简单理解为"照原话修改"。

插件会按照固定顺序判断：

```
整体质量影响
      ↓
保持现状是否影响用户实际使用
      ↓
用户真实目标
      ↓
最优可行方案
```

最终决定：

| 情况 | 决定 |
| --- | --- |
| 质量不受损 | `MODIFY` |
| 质量会下降，但保持现状不影响实际使用 | `KEEP_CURRENT` |
| 质量会下降，而且保持现状会影响实际使用 | `MODIFY` → 选择用户收益更高、质量损失更小、副作用更少的方案 |

## 核心特性

- **固定决策顺序，不是模型即兴判断**：`质量影响` → `保持现状是否影响实际使用` → `用户真实目标` → `最优可行方案`。
- **用户提出的做法只是一个候选方案**。它必须通过同一组硬性淘汰条件，不会因为用户说了就照做。
- **代码级硬守卫 + 会话账本**：未登记的 `C` 编号、已关闭的确认项会被拒绝（`NOT_APPLICABLE`），
  而不是被静默当成一次决策。硬守卫不依赖模型是否遵守 Prompt。
- **三态状态机**：`register → decide → complete`。`MODIFY` 决策后必须真的执行成功才变 `RESOLVED`，
  执行失败可重试，不会把确认项永久关死。
- **纯函数决策核心**：`lib/decide.js` 无 I/O、无服务访问、无定时器，可完全离线单测。
- **调用纪律写进两层**：规则段落与工具描述都要求"一次只判定一个确认项、不并发 decide、
  候选只写有证据的字段、JSON 只用一个冒号且字符串内引号必须转义"——降低工具参数 JSON
  被宿主判为不合法（`MALFORMED_RESPONSE`）而整轮失败的概率。
- **零构建、零配置、零运行时依赖**：纯 ESM，无编译步骤；只依赖宿主 DSH 提供的
  `tools` 与 `systemPrompt` 两个服务；安装后规则自动进入每个会话的 System Prompt。

## 为什么需要它？

例如 DSH 完成一个页面后提出：

> **C1** — 是否需要进一步强化主操作按钮？

用户回复：

> 把按钮放大 300%

插件不会因为用户说了"放大 300%"就机械执行。它先区分两件事：

```
用户提出的方案     按钮放大 300%
用户真正的目标     让关键操作更容易发现
```

再比较候选方案：

```
放大 300%
适度增加尺寸
调整视觉层级
改善位置与间距
提高对比度
```

最后选择能解决真实问题、同时质量损失与副作用更小的方案：

```
没有本插件（或模型直接照做）
→ 按钮放大 300%，布局被挤压，视觉层级失衡

有本插件
USER_GOAL                 提高关键操作的可发现性        ← 先识别真实目标，而不是执行字面做法
QUALITY_IMPACT            MEDIUM（300% 会显著破坏布局）
USER_IMPACT_IF_UNCHANGED  MEDIUM（用户确实找不到入口）
ACTION                    MODIFY
SELECTED_SOLUTION         把主按钮提高一个视觉层级，并强化局部间距
EXECUTION_SCOPE           主按钮尺寸、层级、局部间距
DO_NOT_CHANGE             页面整体布局、导航结构、其他组件
```

也就是说：**目标达成，质量损失更小，边界写死。** 如果用户的做法本来就是最优解，它会照采用；
如果保持现状根本不影响实际使用（纯审美偏好），它会返回 `KEEP_CURRENT`，而不是为了讨好用户
牺牲质量。

## 只在待确认阶段生效

这个插件不是全局修改规则。只有同时满足以下条件时，才进入确认决策流程：

```
主任务已经完成
+
DSH 已经主动输出待确认事项
+
用户当前正在回复其中某个待确认事项
```

普通新任务、普通修改、新需求和无关 follow-up 继续使用 DSH 原有行为。

## 双层触发保护

| 层 | 位置 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 软规则 | System Prompt 段落 + 工具描述 | 告诉模型什么时候应该调用、什么时候不该调用 |
| **硬守卫** | `execute()` + 会话账本（Session Ledger） | **代码级校验**：这个 `C` 编号是否真的由当前会话发布过、是否仍处于未关闭状态 |

未登记的确认项、已经完成的确认项会被**拒绝**（返回 `NOT_APPLICABLE`），而不是进入决策流程：
**没有任何隐式登记后门**，也不会被静默当成一次"决策"处理。
硬守卫不依赖模型是否遵守 Prompt——这正是本插件与"只靠提示词约束"的区别所在。

## 状态机

每个确认事项都经过明确的生命周期：

```
DSH 输出 C1
      ↓
register(C1)  → 登记本轮发布的编号      STATUS = REGISTERED，状态 PENDING
      ↓
用户回复 C1
      ↓
decide(C1)    → 账本校验 → 固定决策
      │
      ├─ KEEP_CURRENT → 决策即完成 ───────────────────→ RESOLVED
      │
      └─ MODIFY       → STATUS = READY_TO_EXECUTE
                        （账本状态 AWAITING_EXECUTION：等待执行）
                              ↓
                        DSH 实际执行
                              ↓
                        complete(C1)  → STATUS = REGISTERED，状态 RESOLVED
```

**`MODIFY` 决策不等于执行。** 只有 DSH 真的执行成功、并调用 `complete(C1)` 之后，该项才变成
`RESOLVED`；如果修改执行失败，就不要调用 `complete`，确认项保持**等待执行**，可以重新决策、
重试执行，不会被误判成"已经完成"。`KEEP_CURRENT` 是自完成的——不修改本身在决策那一刻就已完成。

**每一次新的决策都会先废除上一份尚未执行的授权。** 重试 `decide` 时，旧的 MODIFY 授权在重新计算
**之前**就被撤销；因此如果这次的结果是 `INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT`，该项回到 `PENDING`，
`complete` 再也无法拿旧授权把它关掉。不存在"最新判断是信息不足、旧 MODIFY 却仍可完成"这种状态。

## 插件不会直接修改你的项目

`confirmation_resolution` 只负责：

```
判断质量影响
判断用户实际使用影响
识别决策条件
淘汰不合理方案
比较候选方案
返回 MODIFY / KEEP_CURRENT
限制允许修改的范围
```

它**不会直接修改**你的页面、代码、文件、设计稿或项目结构，也**不自动执行**任何东西。
实际修改仍由 DSH 完成。

## 设计目标

这个插件试图避免两个极端：

```
极端 1    用户说怎么改 → 不判断影响，直接照做
极端 2    为了保护当前结果 → 忽略真实的用户使用问题
```

目标是：**当修改不会降低质量时满足用户；当修改会降低质量且没有实际使用收益时保持现状；
当真实使用确实受到影响时，解决问题，同时尽可能减少质量损失和副作用。**

---

## V2：上下文感知的多目标综合评判（默认启用，可关闭）

上面的 `confirmation_resolution`（V1）以「质量影响」为主轴。V2 是对同一批待确认事项的**综合评判**：
在满足权限与硬约束的前提下，把 `KEEP_CURRENT`、用户原话方案与替代方案放在一起比较，给出更贴合用户
目标、风险可控且可解释的裁决。**V1 没有被替换**——V2 是一个独立版本化入口 `confirmation_resolution_v2`，
**默认注册**（`enableDecisionV2` 默认 `true`），所以任何挂载本插件的 profile、任何工作区开箱即用，
不需要任何 profile 补丁。

### V1 / V2 对照

| | V1 `confirmation_resolution` | V2 `confirmation_resolution_v2` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 决策主轴 | 质量影响 → 保持现状的实际使用影响 → 目标 → 最优方案 | 硬门禁 → 证据可信性 → 场景化多维比较 → 必要审批 |
| 「不改」的地位 | 质量不受损就不进入比较 | 是显式候选基线，修改方案必须胜过它 |
| 缺证据 | 乐观默认（缺 `violates_constraints` ≈ 未违反） | `UNKNOWN`，拦住自动执行 |
| 结果枚举 | `MODIFY` / `KEEP_CURRENT` | 另加 `REQUEST_APPROVAL` / `REJECT`，并区分 `INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT` |
| 场景权重 | 固定优先级 | `ui_preference` / `accessibility` / `code_change` / `external_action` / `urgent_fix` / `generic` 各自一套 |
| 幅度规则 | 200% 为普适硬淘汰 | 仅界面场景的异常信号，且可由 `scale_verified` 覆盖 |
| 授权令牌 | 状态即授权 | 每次 decide 递增 `decision_revision`，`complete` 必须带对版本 |
| 审批 | 无 | `AWAITING_APPROVAL` 状态；**不**接受模型自填的 `approved: true` |

### 默认行为与关闭方式

V2 **默认启用**：不加任何配置时，该行会注册两个工具（`confirmation_resolution` 与
`confirmation_resolution_v2`）和两条规则段落（`confirmation:policy` 与 `confirmation:policy.v2`）。
这是刻意的——本插件是全局部署，作者要求"无论在哪个 profile、哪个工作区都默认 V2"，
所以**不依赖任何 profile 补丁**。

要回到「只有 V1」，显式关闭即可。**注意：删掉该配置并不会关闭 V2**，因为默认值就是 `true`：

```yaml
# profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml 中该行的 config
- id: confirmation-resolution
  config:
    enableDecisionV2: false            # 唯一可靠的关闭方式
    # 可选：V2 开启时只对特定会话生效；留空表示所有会话都可用
    decisionV2Sessions:
      - <session id>
```

`decisionV2Sessions` 只在 V2 开启时有意义：列了会话 id 就只对它们注册 V2，其余会话仍是纯 V1。
V2 的两样贡献（独立工具 + 独立规则段落）都随该行一起卸载，`ctx.effect` 是可逆的。

### 五个 outcome 与处理方式

| outcome | 含义 | DSH 应当怎么做 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MODIFY` | 已选定可行方案 | 按 `selected_solution` + `execution_scope` 执行，成功后用同一 `decision_revision` 调 `complete` |
| `KEEP_CURRENT` | 现状综合更优 | 不修改；该项已 `RESOLVED` |
| `REQUEST_APPROVAL` | 候选合法，但有必须由用户拍板的重大权衡 | **不是执行授权**：把 `approval_question` 转达用户，用户答复后再发起新的 `decide` |
| `INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT` | 关键目标、权限、风险或证据不足 | 按 `missing_information` 补齐后重判；**不得**回落用户原方案 |
| `REJECT` | 请求触犯不可突破的约束 | 不执行；解释被挡住的硬门禁。**`REJECT` 不是 `KEEP_CURRENT`** |

### 安全边界（V2 特有）

- **`UNKNOWN ≠ PASS`**：门禁证据缺失一律按 `UNKNOWN` 处理并拦住自动执行，绝不乐观默认。
- **权限与审批分别验证**：`authorization.verification` 决定许可性；审批不能赋予原本没有的权限。
- **不实现自动审批跃迁**：当前宿主没有可供工具核验的用户确认事件，因此 `approve` 动作一律返回
  `NOT_APPLICABLE`（`NO_VERIFIABLE_APPROVAL_SOURCE`），只返回审批建议。模型自己填写的
  `approved: true` 永远不被采信；只有 `source=USER_REPLY` 且 `user_decision=APPROVED`
  的显式记录才会被当作「调用方申明的用户同意」，并在决策轨迹里标记为 attested 而非 verified。
- **陈旧授权无法复活**：每次 `decide` 都递增 `decision_revision` 并清空旧审批与旧执行许可；
  `complete` 必须带上本次的 `decision_revision`，否则拒绝（`STALE_DECISION_REVISION`）。
- **两套契约互不驱动**：同一个 `C` 编号由 V1 还是 V2 登记，就只能由那一版继续驱动
  （`ITEM_VERSION_MISMATCH`）。

### 兼容与风险说明

- V2 的 `.docx` 规范与代码同步在 `02`/`03` 中以 V1/V2 版本标注；**两套契约并存期间以代码为准**。
- V2 增加了调用方需要准备的输入（`context`、`authorization`、带证据的 `candidates`），
  载荷比 V1 大。这是「不确定不等于安全」的代价；也正因为载荷更重，才保留了
  `enableDecisionV2: false` 这条一键回到纯 V1 的退路。
- **当前支持并验证的宿主：npm 全局安装版 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`**，`package.json` 的 peer 声明同步为
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools: ^0.2.0-rc.2`。本插件按该版本与对应 web profile 构建，涉及宿主内部模块
  （`dsh-tools` 等）。**更新 DSH 可能导致插件不兼容**，升级后请重跑 `npm run check`
  与 `dsh --profile web --dump-config`。
- 回滚：把 `enableDecisionV2` **显式设为 `false`** 即回到纯 V1（删掉该配置不会关闭，因为默认是
  `true`）；已产生的 V2 会话账本随进程重启清空，
  不会与 V1 的执行授权混用。

## 工具调用鲁棒性（2026-10-07）

触发这条改进的是一次真实事故复盘：同一个会话里连续两个回合都以

```
DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON   （code: MALFORMED_RESPONSE）
```

终止，坏点全部落在 `confirmation_resolution` 的工具参数 JSON 上——一处是
`"user_impact_if_unchanged"::`（键值之间多写了一个冒号），一处是

plugins.description: Windows toast notifications for DeepSeek-Harness: get pulled back when a task finishes or the agent needs you.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-notify

Windows desktop notifications for [DeepSeek-Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH).

中文文档：[README.zh-CN.md](./README.zh-CN.md)

Hand a task to DSH, switch to something else, and get pulled back only when it matters: a toast tells you the task is done, or that the agent is waiting on you. Click the toast to return to the app.

> Windows only. On other platforms the plugin loads and stays idle.

## What it does

| Moment | Toast |
| --- | --- |
| A task finishes | `DSH · 任务完成` with the assistant's last answer |
| A task ends in an error or an unexpected stop | `DSH · 任务已结束` |
| The agent asks you a question and nobody answers within 6 s | `DSH · 需要你确认` with the question |

Clicking the toast, or its **打开 DeepSeek-Harness** button, brings DSH to the front. If the window is minimized it is restored; if it was closed to the tray it is reopened. This uses the `dsh://notify` URL handler that the desktop app already registers.

Toasts stay quiet while you are already looking at the app: the page reports from the browser whether one of its tabs is the foreground tab of a visible window, and no toast is raised in that case. Plan reviews keep their own approval UI and are not announced by default.

Everything above is adjustable in **Settings → Notifications**, the plugin's own page beside General and Models, or from its row on the Plugins page.

## Install

Published on npm — this is what the in-app **Plugin Center** uses:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @cmwl1231/dsh-notify
```

For the Desktop app, replace the profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @cmwl1231/dsh-notify
```

Install straight from this repository instead (no npm package involved):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lixiangdong122333/dsh-notify
```

Quit DSH before running the command, and start it again afterwards. A newly added bundle is read at startup, not picked up live.

## Configure

Open **Settings → Notifications**, the plugin's own page in the settings panel, or **Settings → Plugins → this plugin** — both render the same form. It edits the `dsh-notify` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and applies each change immediately, with a **Send a test notification** button to confirm the whole chain works.

Editing that row by hand works just as well — both write the same block. Every key is optional; the defaults below are what an install without overrides uses.

```yaml
- id: dsh-notify
  config:
    onTurnEnd: true              # toast when a turn ends
    notifyEndKinds:              # which endings are worth a toast
      - completed
      - error
      - max-tokens
    minTurnMs: 0                 # ignore turns shorter than this (ms)
    notifyQuestions: true        # toast for an unanswered question
    questionDelayMs: 6000        # how long a question waits before the toast
    notifyPlanReviews: false     # announce plan reviews too
    skipWhenFocused: true        # stay quiet while a DSH tab is in the foreground
    skipWhenOthersRunning: true  # stay quiet while another session still works
    bodySource: answer           # answer | prompt | none
    bodyLength: 150              # characters of body text
    sound: default               # default | silent | important
    titleCompleted: "DSH · 任务完成"
    titleEnded: "DSH · 任务已结束"
    titleQuestion: "DSH · 需要你确认"
```

`forked` and `interrupted` are handovers inside the app rather than a finished task, so they are not offered as endpoints. `sound: important` keeps only the question toast audible.

## How it works

The plugin is a Cordis plugin: it exports `apply(ctx)` and registers listeners on the host context.

* **Turns** — DSH commits a `turn/end` event to each session's log. The plugin follows that feed and raises a toast when a turn ends, skipping subagent sessions and turns you cancelled yourself.
* **Questions** — a `user-questions/request` reaches the plugin before the web answerer sees it. The plugin holds the request, and once `questionDelayMs` passes without an answer it raises the toast and steps aside, so the normal answerer takes over as usual. The plugin never answers, and never interferes with the on-screen question card.
* **Focus** — a small script served by the host reports tab visibility and focus back to the host, which is the only reliable signal for "the user can already see this".
* **Delivery** — `notify.ps1` raises the toast through WinRT as the app's Start Menu shortcut. Windows resolves a toast's application name from the `AppUserModelId` registry entry, not from the toast XML, so the script (re)writes that entry before each send. Without it the header falls back to showing the raw shortcut path.

## Requirements

* Windows 10 or 11
* Windows PowerShell 5.1 (present on every supported Windows)
* DeepSeek-Harness with a Start Menu shortcut for the app

## Development

```bash
# plugin logic and the settings store, against a fake context — no DSH needed
node test-plugin.mjs

# toast payload and encoding checks (Windows, sends one real toast)
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File test-toast.ps1
```

`notify.ps1` must keep its UTF-8 BOM. Windows PowerShell 5.1 reads a `.ps1` file in the system code page unless a BOM says otherwise, and the action label is Chinese — without the BOM it renders as mojibake. The test suite checks this.

## Releasing

Pushing a `v*` tag stages that version on npm; a normal push only runs the tests.

```bash
npm version 1.2.0 --no-git-tag-version
git commit -am "Release 1.2.0"
git tag v1.2.0
git push origin main --tags
```

CI checks that the tag matches `package.json` and that the version is not already published, then stages it. **The version is not installable until a maintainer approves it** at <https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cmwl1231/dsh-notify> under *Staged versions*, entering a 2FA code. The token in CI is stage-only: it can queue a release but cannot publish one, so a compromised workflow cannot ship a version nobody approved.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 插件：在右侧文档预览面板直接播放工作区视频，支持 HTTP Range 拖动进度 / Native video playback in DeepSeek Harness's document preview panel
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Video Preview

[中文](README.zh.md)

Play workspace videos directly in DeepSeek Harness's right-side context / document preview panel. Instead of showing "unsupported file type", the panel renders a native video player with working seeking, including files larger than the 32 MiB RPC preview read limit.

- Package: `@lifenrir/dsh-video-preview`
- DSH: `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`
- Node: `^22.19 || >=24`

## Features

- Inline `<video controls playsInline preload="metadata">` inside the right-side document panel: play, pause, seek, and fullscreen.
- Authenticated Host route `/api/dsh-video-preview/stream` that implements HTTP `Range` (`206` / `416`), so seeking is not limited by the RPC preview cap.
- 4 MiB chunked reads through `ctx.fs.readByteRange`; a `HEAD` probe validates the path, MIME type, and workspace permission before the browser issues its `GET`.
- Only known video extensions are accepted; everything else returns `415`.
- The player follows the DSH theme through `--dsw-alias-*` design tokens.

## Supported containers and codecs

| Extension | Content-Type |
| --- | --- |
| `.mp4`, `.m4v` | `video/mp4` |
| `.mov` | `video/quicktime` |
| `.webm` | `video/webm` |
| `.ogv`, `.ogg` | `video/ogg` |
| `.mkv` | `video/x-matroska` |

Container recognition does not imply codec support. The browser still has to decode the stream:

- H.264/AAC in MP4 and VP8/VP9 in WebM have the widest compatibility.
- `.mov` often contains ProRes, and `.mkv` often contains H.265/AC-3 or other codecs browsers do not ship decoders for. When decoding fails the panel shows "This browser cannot play this video format" with a Retry button.

## Install

### From npm

```sh
dsh plugin add @lifenrir/dsh-video-preview
```

### From a local directory

```sh
git clone https://github.com/LiFenrir/dsh-video-preview.git
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-video-preview
```

No build step is required: the Host half is the ESM entry `index.js`, and the browser half is `client.js`, loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__`.

### From git

```sh
dsh plugin add git+https://github.com/LiFenrir/dsh-video-preview.git
```

Reload the Web UI (or restart the profile) after adding and enabling the plugin.

## Usage

1. Open a workspace video from the Files tab.
2. The right-side preview panel shows the player.
3. Use the native controls to play, seek, and enter fullscreen.

## How it works

- `index.js` registers the streaming route on the authenticated connection layer via `ctx.connection.fetch.register`.
- The route resolves the session workspace through the `workspaceFileScope` lookup, then resolves and stats the requested path with `ctx.fs`, which keeps sandbox rules in force.
- `client.js` registers a document-preview definition for the supported extensions and the panel component. It parses the `dsh-resource://file/session/<sessionId>/<path>` address, performs the `HEAD` probe, and only then points the `<video>` element at the stream URL.

## Security

- The stream route is served through DSH's authenticated connection layer; paths are resolved relative to the session's workspace root and remain subject to the `ctx.fs` sandbox.
- Responses use `Cache-Control: private, no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.
- Error responses do not leak internal error details.
- Request paths containing NUL bytes are rejected, and only the extensions listed above are served.

## Verify

1. Enable the plugin and reload the Web UI.
2. Open a `.mp4` file from the Files tab.
3. The right-side preview should show a player, and dragging the progress bar should seek correctly.
4. Optionally open a file larger than 32 MiB and confirm that seeking still works.

If the panel reports a load failure, check that the file exists, lies inside the current session workspace, and has a supported extension. If it reports an unsupported format, the container may be recognized but the codec is not decodable by the browser.

## Development

This package has no build step and no runtime dependencies. The source files are the shipped files:

```text
index.js            Host half (stream route)
client.js           Browser half (document preview + player)
cordis.patch.yml    Bundle manifest
locale/{en,zh}.json Display metadata
icon.svg            Plugin icon
```

To test a change locally, point `dsh plugin add` at this directory and reload the Web UI.

## License

MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness native plugin for real browser interaction, PDF reading, offline Chinese/English OCR and video frames.
plugins.readme_text:
# 网页操作与文档读取 · Web Workbench

面向 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop 0.2.1-rc.2** 的原生 Cordis 插件。注册 13 个工具，使用现有 Harness 工具调度、会话日志和系统提示词接口。原有 `web_search` 和 `web_fetch` 保持可用。

**0.2.1 增加侧栏拖拽、正常鼠标光标和输入插入光标，并修复窗口外松手后的卡死清理**。工具和侧栏继续使用同一个 Playwright 浏览器实例、标签页与登录状态。[验证范围](docs/verification.md)。

## 已补充的能力

| 需求 | 实现 |
| --- | --- |
| 打开需要 JavaScript 的网站 | 真实 Edge/Chromium，返回渲染后的文字、元素和标签页 |
| 点击、翻页、输入、选择、提交表单 | 使用最近一次快照中的元素 `ref`；交互后返回新快照 |
| 看见并接管 AI 操作 | 右侧栏“AI 浏览器”显示同一浏览器的实时画面；接管后可点击、滚动、键盘输入和粘贴，AI 浏览器工具暂停 |
| 登录网站 | 在侧栏接管后人工登录、处理验证码/MFA，独立浏览器 profile 与 Cookie 保留在本机 |
| 上传、下载 | 上传已暂存的文件；保存点击产生的下载；直接下载支持当前浏览器的站点 Cookie |
| 读取 PDF 全文 | 下载后二进制解析，按页提取，支持页码和文字分页；扫描页可 OCR |
| 阅读图片文字 | 内置英文和简体中文 OCR 语言文件，运行时无需联网下载 |
| 核对论文公式、插图和布局 | PDF 页面转 PNG，或对网页截图；图像语义需要额外视觉模型 |
| 读取视频 | 通过本机 ffprobe 读取信息，ffmpeg 按时间取帧，再对画面做 OCR |
| 发帖、发邮件、下单等网站写操作 | 可通过网站表单和按钮执行，是否成功应核对页面结果；遵守用户实际授权 |

不能保证站点都接受自动化；不能绕过验证码、MFA、订阅权限或付费墙。图片 OCR 不等于理解图片、图表或视频；本版不包含语音转写或额外视觉模型，不需要填写另一个模型的 API Key。

## 安装

### Windows：独立安装器

先打开过一次 DSH Desktop，然后克隆或下载本仓库，在文件资源管理器中双击 `Install.cmd`。也可以在普通终端运行：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/CoraEJones/dsh-web-workbench.git
cd dsh-web-workbench
.\Install.cmd
```

安装器使用 DSH 自带运行时打包，再调用官方 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add <压缩包> --ignore-scripts`，同时安装插件依赖；会先备份配置，并将结果写入 `.install-results/install-result.json`。它不手工覆盖 profile 配置，不修改全局权限，不需要管理员账号。Windows 执行策略只对此安装子进程生效。

**请从普通终端或文件资源管理器运行安装器。** 在 DSH 的“工作区内修改”命令工具中运行，仍会受该聊天的沙箱限制，不能因此获得 profile 写权限。

默认使用已安装的 Edge，无需下载 Chromium，浏览器画面显示在 DSH 侧栏。默认安装压缩包而不是源码软链，因此干净克隆也能装齐依赖。保留 `.install-results` 中的安装压缩包，以便 pnpm 后续重装。开发时可给安装脚本加 `-DeveloperLink`，该模式需要先在源码目录安装依赖并保留源码目录。

### 使用 Harness 自带的管理入口

标准模式默认没有 `plugin_manager` 工具。可以切换到提供管理工具的 Creator/创造模式，或使用**侧边栏“插件”页面**安装；设置里的插件列表可能仅供查看。

在提供管理工具的聊天中，可以发送：

```text
请用 plugin_manager 安装插件：action=install_bundle，target=github:CoraEJones/dsh-web-workbench。
使用当前 desktop profile，不手工改 profile 的 package.json 或 cordis.patch.yml。
安装后检查 application 和 warnings，再核对 web_workbench_status、web_browser_open、web_browser_action、web_download_file、pdf_read、image_read。
调用 web_workbench_status 验证工具可用。只有实际生效后才报告已安装；如需重启请明确告诉我。
```

本地安装可将 `target` 改成插件目录的绝对路径。

### 验证是否生效

让 DSH 实际调用 `web_workbench_status`，再打开一个测试网页。**依赖安装成功不等于已经激活。** HMR 开启时，新增工具可以在当前运行实例动态生效；仅在 DSH 报告 `restart-required` 或热加载失败时重启，不必一律新开聊天。

可选的 `verifyOnLoad:true` 会在插件加载时，通过当前 Host 的真实工具调度器运行本机网页与 OCR 自检，输出到 `dataDir/diagnostics/live-host.json`。默认关闭；测试时建议同时设置 `headless:true`，测试完成后恢复设置。自检不调用 LLM，也不访问外部网站。

首次从 0.1.x 升级时，DSH 可能缓存了旧版本不含客户端界面的声明。若工具已出现而“AI 浏览器”入口没有出现，保存工作后重启 DSH。桌面端界面热更新连接失败时，也需要刷新页面或重启；工具加载成功不能证明客户端界面已加载。

## 在右侧栏观看和接管

在会话输入框附近点击“打开 AI 浏览器”，或在右侧栏新增页面中选择“AI 浏览器”。AI 第一次打开网页时，当前会话的侧栏也会自动展开。原有 DSH“浏览器”页仍可使用；共享 AI 浏览器使用单独的“AI 浏览器”页。

点击“接管浏览器”后，新的 AI 浏览器操作会返回 `HUMAN_CONTROL`。已经开始的操作会先结束，手动输入排在它之后，避免双方同时点击。直接点击网页画面，然后输入、粘贴或滚动；中文输入也可使用底部输入栏。点击“交还给 AI”后，AI 需要重新获取快照才能继续。关闭或收起侧栏不会自动交还控制权。

接管后使用正常鼠标光标，悬停到文字输入区、链接和拖拽控件时会显示相应的光标。输入框、文本区和可编辑内容中显示竖直插入光标，随输入、方向键和侧栏缩放更新。

支持按住鼠标拖动网页滑块、进度条、文字选择和拖动控件。指针捕获让拖动可以延续到画面外；取消、失去捕获、切换窗口、隐藏侧栏、交还 AI 或请求中断时会清理按键状态。服务端还会在失联后自动松键，避免浏览器一直处于按下状态。这个能力供人工操作，不代表 AI 可以自动完成验证码。

针对 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 的分栏拖动，插件会在窗口失焦、丢失捕获或发现漏掉松手时取消残留的宿主手势，并清理 `data-dockkit-pointer`。正常分栏松手先由 DSH 提交布局；插件不会用全局 `pointer-events` 覆盖来绕开宿主交互规则，也不修改 DSH 安装文件。

“选择文件”将本机文件放入当前会话暂存区，供 AI 使用。接管后点击网页的上传按钮，再选择文件，会上传到同一个浏览器；也可使用“上传到当前网页”。网页下载会列在“下载文件”中，可另存到本机，AI 仍能读取同一份暂存文件。

画面采用 JPEG 视口刷新，正常约每 350 毫秒一帧（实际取决于网页和主机性能），不是高帧率视频流。移动事件串行转发并合并尚未发送的中间移动，保留按下和松开的顺序；网站的动画、风控和拖拽实现仍可能影响结果。侧栏隐藏时停止取帧。网站的原生选择菜单可用键盘操作；音视频实时播放、浏览器扩展界面及从系统桌面拖文件进入网页不在本版范围内。

## 使用示例

装好后，直接对 Harness 说：

```text
打开这篇论文的页面，用真实浏览器查找并下载我有权访问的 PDF，读取全文，按页码整理原理和实验参数。遇到登录或验证码先把浏览器交给我，完成后继续。
```

```text
打开这个网站，替我填好表单。提交前先让我检查内容，确认后再提交，并核对成功回执。
```

本地文件先调用 `web_workbench_status` 获得本会话暂存目录，把 PDF、图片、视频或待上传文件复制进去。工具仅能读取和上传该目录内的文件，不允许用路径跳转或符号链接跨出目录。浏览器 Cookie 和登录状态位于其外侧，不属于可读取、上传的文件区。

## 工具速查

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `web_workbench_status` | 能力、限制、文件暂存目录 |
| `web_browser_open` | 打开网页；返回 HTTP 状态、正文、元素 `ref` 和标签页 |
| `web_browser_snapshot` | 重新读页面；正文用 `text_offset`、元素用 `element_offset` 继续 |
| `web_browser_action` | `click/fill/select/check/press/upload/scroll/back/reload/switch_tab/dialog/wait` |
| `web_browser_screenshot` | 保存当前视口截图 |
| `web_browser_downloads` | 等待并获取浏览器触发的下载；也检查交互快照中的 `downloads` |
| `web_browser_close` | 关闭本会话浏览器，保留登录状态 |
| `web_download_file` | HTTP(S) 流式下载，`use_browser_session:true` 附加匹配站点 Cookie |
| `pdf_read` | `file`、`page_start`、`page_count`、`char_offset`、`ocr`、`language` |
| `pdf_render` | `file`、1 起算 `page`，返回 PNG 路径 |
| `image_read` | `file`、`ocr`（默认 true）、`language` |
| `video_inspect` | `file`，读取格式、时长、音视频流 |
| `video_frame` | `file`、`seconds`，返回该时间 PNG |

每次快照或操作都会使旧 `ref` 失效。`fill` 后继续使用返回的新 `ref` 点击提交。`select` 的 `text` 填选项 value。`press` 的 `text` 填 `Enter` 等键名。`upload` 使用文件输入框的 `ref`。新标签页需要 `switch_tab`。

浏览器弹窗默认立即取消，避免对话框卡死调用。若明确需要接受下一次确认框，先调用 `web_browser_action(action='dialog',accept=true)`，再点击触发它的按钮；这只对下一次弹窗有效。

读取长 PDF 时，优先按 `next_char_offset` 继续同一个页范围，再按 `next_page` 读取后续页。扫描页 `ocr:true` 只处理没有文本层的页面。复杂公式、多栏文章和表格的提取顺序可能失真，需要 `pdf_render` 核对。

## 设置与运行条件

通过 Harness 的插件设置修改 Config，不需要改源码：

| 配置 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- |
| `dataDir` | 用户目录下 `.dsh/web-workbench` |
| `headless` | `true`，后台运行并在 DSH 侧栏显示同一浏览器；`false` 可额外显示独立窗口 |
| `browserChannel` | `msedge`，也可用 `chrome`；空字符串使用 Playwright Chromium |
| `timeoutMs` | 30000 |
| `maxFileBytes` | 100 MiB |
| `maxTextChars` | 每次 20000 字符 |
| `ocrLanguage` | `eng+chi_sim`，支持 `eng`、`chi_sim` |
| `ffmpegPath` / `ffprobePath` | `ffmpeg` / `ffprobe`，可设绝对路径 |
| `verifyOnLoad` | `false`，是否运行显式的本机 Host 自检 |

Windows 上的 Edge、Node.js 24 和 FFmpeg 已用于测试。运行环境需 Node.js >=22.13；使用空 `browserChannel` 前执行 `pnpm exec playwright install chromium`。视频工具需要 FFmpeg/ffprobe 可用。登录状态按 Harness 会话隔离，同一会话重开保留；新会话不会自动继承另一会话的登录。

直接 HTTP 下载支持流式大小限制、重定向协议验证、取消和残缺文件清理。浏览器点击下载由 Playwright 完成后检查大小；浏览器下载过程中的临时磁盘用量不受该流式上限控制。某些网站还依赖浏览器指纹、动态 token 或挑战，此时应通过浏览器点击下载，不能保证只转移 Cookie 就成功。

该插件会在 Host 进程使用浏览器、网络和文件 API；它不是操作系统沙箱，也不替代 Harness 原有权限政策。网页、PDF、OCR 文本均标记为外部不可信数据，并在系统提示词中明确不得当作指令或用户授权。最终仍需要 Harness 的模型及既有权限机制正确处理这些边界。

不要分享包含浏览器 profile、`auth-state.json` 的数据目录；其中保存了本人的登录会话。不要把它加入版本库。插件不读取 `.credentials.yaml`，不更换模型，也不会自动向真实网站发帖、发邮件或下单。

## 开发、测试与交付状态

```powershell
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
pnpm test
pnpm pack
```

20 项本地测试通过，包括完整拖拽序列、取消与失联松键、过期指针隔离、输入和 iframe 光标位置、分栏残留恢复，以及同一浏览器的 AI/人工联动、上传下载、登录恢复、PDF/OCR/视频与文件边界检查。当前测试需要 Edge、FFmpeg 和 Microsoft YaHei 中文字体。

`test/client.integration.mjs` 另外使用 React 18.2、真实客户端代码和 Edge 检查侧栏事件绑定、滑块拖动、窗口失焦、误触防护、分栏残留恢复和窄侧栏的插入光标。React 只用于独立测试，插件运行时使用 DSH 提供的 React。运行方式：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .test-data/client-runtime
pnpm --dir .test-data/client-runtime add react@18.2.0 react-dom@18.2.0 --ignore-scripts
$env:WORKBENCH_REACT_FIXTURES = (Resolve-Path .test-data/client-runtime/node_modules).Path
pnpm test:client
```

另外，`test/native-host.integration.mjs` 可在安装的 DSH Electron 运行时中测试真实 Cordis、SystemPrompt、ToolRuntime 注册与调用。已经完成独立原生运行时验证和正在运行的 Desktop Host 验证。Harness 仍在迭代，其他版本尚未验证。

## 参考

- [DeepSeek Harness 官方仓库](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
- [Playwright 持久浏览器](https://playwright.dev/docs/api/class-browsertype#browser-type-launch-persistent-context)
- [Playwright 下载](https://playwright.dev/docs/downloads)
- [PDF.js](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js)
- [Tesseract.js 本地运行说明](https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js/blob/master/docs/local-installation.md)

插件自身使用 MIT 许可；依赖保留各自许可和声明。原生图标为本插件绘制。

plugins.description: 一款llama.cpp与DeepSeek Harness的多功能管理工具
plugins.readme_text:
# LlamaDSH 启动器

对llama.cpp和DeepSeek Harness集中管理，适合本地部署的同学
方便管理不同模型的不同参数配置方案，同时能够一键升级llama.cpp、node、deepseek harness；还能针对DSH的插件兼容性进行一键修复；一键安装、更新、卸载、停用插件；DSH更新频繁，旧插件容易过期，插件管理专门添加了版本豁免的实验性功能。
更多功能自行体验，本软件已成为我的后台常驻软件。另外给本地部署的同学推荐下我做的DSH上下文管理插件，128K、64K、甚至32k上下文的本地模型都能把活儿干起来！当然线上大模型api也能进行优质压缩，绝对比自带的压缩降智低很多：https://github.com/chocobo77/dsh-infinite-context

![主界面](assets/main-window.png)

（以下是我本地的Qwen3.8 27B写的，将就看看）
## 功能

### 参数面板

llama-server 的参数按官方 help 分成通用与加载、采样控制、推测解码、服务与扩展四组，组内再按用途分小节。勾一个参数就填一行，右边一栏列出当前勾了哪些，可以按关键字过滤。

参数之间有依赖和互斥，比如推测解码的子参数要等 spec-type 不填 none 才有意义。勾了不该勾的，底部会说明原因，生成命令时也会剔掉。

参数表放在 Resources/llama_params.yml。llama.cpp 升级之后改这文件，点「重载参数配置」当场生效，不用重启程序。

### 命令预览

「命令预览」页显示当前会执行的完整命令：程序路径、每个参数的取值、以及你在编辑模式里追加的自定义参数（橙色显示，跟自动生成的区分开）。

命令可以复制走，拿到终端里手动跑，排查启动问题的时候好用。

### 方案与配置文件

一套参数存一个方案。下拉切换方案即可切换模型、参数。

配置文件：「保存到文件」写回默认路径，「另存为」导出成新文件，「从文件加载」用磁盘上的文件覆盖当前配置，「配置目录」可以改存放位置。

### 启动控制

右侧「运行控制」管两件事。

llama 一个启动、一个停止，启动后显示进程有没有活着。

DSH 有启动 Web、停止、重建、打开网页。启动方式有三种：编译产物（node apps/cli/lib/bin.js，最快）、源码模式（pnpm dsh，依赖齐全但慢）、npx（临时下载）。程序自己选，编译产物不在就往下退。

需要提权的时候勾「以管理员身份启动 DSH」，启动时弹 UAC。

### 日志与诊断

底部日志区实时显示子进程输出，带时间戳，能自动滚动、清空、打开日志目录。

出问题点「复制诊断」，会把界面上的日志、最近 40 行 error.log 和 crash.log、系统版本和运行时版本一起复制到剪贴板，粘贴出来就能看出问题在哪。

### Node 环境

「运行环境」页里有一块 Node 环境。

检测会显示 node 和 pnpm 的版本、路径，判断是否满足 v24 和 pnpm 的要求。

「一键安装/更新」下载官方 v24 安装包，先验体积再验 SHA-256（取不到校验和时改用数字签名验签），静默装上，然后用 npm 装 pnpm，最后实际跑一次 pnpm --version 确认能用。

装完顺手检查 DSH 的 node_modules 有没有失效链接。

整个过程逐步写日志，超时会说明卡在哪一步。

### DSH 维护

「兼容性检查/修复」扫一遍 DSH 安装：bundle 激活表、失效的补丁、死依赖声明、node_modules 里的悬空链接。pnpm 的软链存的是绝对路径，DSH 目录搬过家就会全部断掉，这是最常见的一种坏法。能自动修的当场修，改之前先备份。

「插件智能检测/修复」处理插件和 DSH 版本对不上的情况，包括 peer 依赖缺失、版本越界。

「插件管理」是单独的窗口，可以启用、停用、升级、卸载，也能装本地插件。

启动 DSH 如果报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND，程序会先重连链接再重试一次，不用手动去点兼容性修复。

### 监控与保护

显示 CPU、内存、显卡占用、显存占用、显卡温度，以及 llama 的 TPS、首 token 延迟、prefill 速度。

显存熔断设一个阈值（百分比或 GB），超过就自动停掉 llama，免得显存打满把系统拖死。

显存预估拆成权重、KV 缓存、计算图缓冲、固定开销四项分开算。混合架构模型（滑窗 / 线性注意力）按全注意力层数折算 KV，不会把 64 层全按线性增长去算。

### 托盘

关窗口默认最小化到托盘，进程不退出。双击托盘图标恢复窗口，右键菜单里能真正退出。

## 环境要求

- Windows 10 / 11 x64
- llama.cpp 目录，里面有 llama-server.exe
- DeepSeek Harness 源码目录，含 apps/cli
- node 24 与 pnpm，没有可以用程序里的一键安装

发布版自带运行时，从源码跑需要 .NET 8 桌面运行时。

## 快速开始

1. 打开程序，在「运行环境」页填模型文件、llama.cpp 目录、DSH 目录
2. 点「刷新状态」，看 node 和 pnpm 是否就绪，缺哪个点「一键安装/更新」
3. 到「参数配置」页按需勾选，在「命令预览」页核对生成的命令
4. 点「启动 Llama」，等日志里出现 listening，再启动 DSH
5. 浏览器打开 http://127.0.0.1:3080

## 目录

- LlamaDSH_Launcher_CS：主程序，WPF
  - Services：进程执行、工具链探测、兼容修复、更新、GPU 采样
  - Resources/llama_params.yml：参数表
- LlamaDSH_Launcher_Linux：Linux 侧的 webui 版本，实验性质，能用但没细磨
- tests/SmokeTests：不依赖 NuGet 的冒烟测试，覆盖进程超时、大输出、验签、日志轮转
- WmiProbe：读进程命令行的小工具

## 常见问题

**启动 DSH 报 Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/...'**

DSH 目录搬过家，pnpm 的软链还指着旧路径。点「兼容性修复」重连；新版直接点启动也行，程序会先自愈再重试。还不行就在 DSH 目录跑一次 pnpm install。

**提示找不到 node 24**

只认 v24 及以上。用「一键安装/更新」装，或者把 node 目录加进 PATH 后点「自动检索」。

**改了参数但生成的命令没变**

点「重载参数配置」。参数表是从 Resources/llama_params.yml 读的，改完不用重启。

**显存不够，加载到一半就退出**

把 gpu-layers 调小，或者开显存熔断留点余量。日志里的 cudaMalloc 报错基本就是这个原因。

**托盘图标不见了**

系统设置里把它设成常显。程序退出会清掉图标，重启后恢复。

## 构建

    dotnet build LlamaDSH_Launcher_CS/LlamaDSH_Launcher.csproj

打安装包运行 一键封包.cmd，内部是 dotnet publish 单文件加 Inno Setup。

跑测试：

    dotnet run --project tests/SmokeTests/SmokeTests.csproj

## 参数表

当前对齐 llama-server 0.7.0-dev build 11680。升级 llama.cpp 之后，把新版 --help 存成文件，和 llama_params.yml 逐条对一遍，具体做法写在文件开头。

## 许可证

MIT，见 LICENSE。改完想怎么用都行，留着版权声明就好。

plugins.description: Project record system for DeepSeek Harness: node-based progress board, decision ledger, and right-sidebar UI.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Project Board

> 把「项目结构 + 待办 + 决策」收进一套可追踪的记录系统：一棵节点树、两份文件、右侧栏一键查看。

**简体中文** | [English](#english)

![浅色模式](docs/light.png)
![深色模式](docs/dark.png)

## 简体中文

### 它解决什么

- 待办和决策散落在聊天、文档、看板里，过两周就找不到；
- 看板按「阶段」分节，但每天是按「产品部位」干活，找不全一个页面的上下文；
- 决策只记结论不记理由，三个月后无法判断是否还成立；
- 汇总数字手写，改一处忘一处。

这套系统用三个约束解决：

1. **节点树**：`## 20 首页`，节点 = 持久的产品面/领域，不是任务、不是阶段；
2. **双轨记录**：进度看板放任务，决策台账放决策，共用同一套节点 ID；
3. **派生视图**：进度、未完成、待拍板全部算出来，不手写。

### 右侧栏

- 索引 chips + 互斥手风琴：一次只展开一个节点；
- 搜索、仅未完成、待拍板过滤；
- 决策按节点分组，点开底部抽屉看理由/备选/影响/复审；
- 浅色 / 深色自动跟随 DSH 主题。

### 安装

### 作为 DSH 插件（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @notoonex/dsh-project-board
```

> 从源码安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:Notoonex/dsh-project-board`

重启 DSH 后，右侧栏会出现「项目看板」。
插件会自动把 skill 安装到 `~/.dsh/skills/project-board/`，并托管本地 board server。

### 只装 Skill

在 `dsh-skills-marketplace` 里添加本仓库，稀疏路径填 `skill`。
Skill 本身不依赖插件，只要有 markdown 和 Node 就能用。

### 配置

| 环境变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_PROJECTS_DIR` | `~/Documents/Projects` | 项目根目录，每个子目录一个项目 |
| `DSH_PROJECT_BOARD_PORT` | 自动 | 可选；不设时从 8791 起自动找空闲端口 |

> 如果你的项目在别的目录，启动 DSH 前设置 `DSH_PROJECTS_DIR`。
> 不设端口时，server 会自动找空闲端口，前端也会自动探测，不需要手动配。

### 目录结构

```text
$DSH_PROJECTS_DIR/
└── my-app/
    ├── my-app 进度看板.md
    ├── my-app 决策台账.md
    ├── 踩坑.md            # 可选，只放教训
    └── README.md          # 可选，定位/背景
```

规则：

- 每个项目**各恰好一个** `* 进度看板.md` 和 `* 决策台账.md`；
- 两份文件 stem 必须一致，frontmatter 的 `project:` 必须等于 stem；
- 不建第三份记录，不用表格承载可勾选任务。

### 文件格式

### 进度看板

```markdown
---
schema: project-board/1
project: my-app
archetype: web-app
nodes:
  "00": 治理
  "10": 全局与架构
  "20": 首页
  "90": 归档
---

## 20 首页
> 范围：首屏 / 导航 / 视觉

- [ ] 首屏文案定稿 · 验收: 3 秒内说清产品是什么 · 关联: D-20-01
- [ ] [[首屏是否放演示视频]] 等 owner 拍板
- [x] ~~四屏结构定型~~ `abc1234`
```

### 决策台账

```markdown
---
schema: decision-log/1
project: my-app
---

### D-20-01 首屏采用单 CTA
- 节点: 20 首页
- 状态: 生效
- 日期: 2026-10-24
- 可逆性: 可逆
- 理由: 首屏只保留一个动作，降低选择成本
- 备选: 双 CTA / 无 CTA
- 影响: 20
- 复审: 上线两周看转化率
```

决策 ID 自带节点：`D-20-01` = 节点 20 的第 1 条。台账扁平按 ID 排序，天然按节点分组，不需要复制章节骨架。

### Skill

Skill 在 [`skill/`](skill/)：

- `references/init.md`：首次接入与迁移；
- `references/operate.md`：日常写任务/决策；
- `references/schema.md`：完整字段与编号规则；
- `references/packs/`：web / business / life 域包；
- `scripts/lint.mjs`：跨文件校验；
- `scripts/scan-legacy.mjs`：旧看板只读扫描，输出 mapping 草稿。

```bash
node "$DSH_SKILL_DIR/scripts/lint.mjs" "$DSH_PROJECTS_DIR/my-app"
```

### 安全

- 只监听 `127.0.0.1`，公网访问不到；
- 非本机来源的请求直接 **403**，不只是“不给读”；
- `project` 参数按目录白名单校验，拒绝路径穿越；
- 只读写项目目录内的 `* 进度看板.md` / `* 决策台账.md`；
- 勾选回写优先按任务 ID，其次按「节点 + 任务文本」定位，不依赖行号；
- 本地 token：首次启动自动生成，客户端自动携带；同一台机器上的其他页面没有 token，调用会被 401 拒绝。

### Token

- 首次启动生成 `~/.dsh/project-board/token`（权限 600）；
- 插件启动时把 token 写进已安装的 `client/client.js`；
- 客户端所有 API 请求带 `X-Project-Board-Token`；
- `/api/health` 不校验 token，只用于端口探测；
- 如果侧栏报 401：重载 DSH；或删除 token 文件后重启 DSH，让插件重新生成并注入。

> 这是**一次性自动配置**，不需要你输入任何东西。
> 只有一种情况会失败：插件安装目录本身是只读的（例如全局 npm 安装）。用 `dsh plugin add` 装到 profile 目录通常是可写的。

### 更新

- **增量更新**：只覆盖有变化的文件；
- 你新增的文件会保留；
- 你改过的文件会保留（日志提示 `kept local skill edit`）；
- 上游删除、且你没改过的文件会被删除；
- 想强制全量：删掉 `~/.dsh/skills/project-board/` 或其中的 `.manifest.json`，重启 DSH。

### 写入定位

侧栏勾选不再按行号硬写：

1. 任务有 `[T-<节点>-<序号>]` → 按 ID 找；
2. 没有 ID → 按「节点 + 任务文本」找；
3. 都找不到 → 返回 409，让前端刷新，不会误勾别的任务；
4. 勾选完成只加/去 `~~删除线~~`，不改任务原文（链接、反引号、加粗都保留）。

### 开发

```bash
npm test
```

测试包含：

- `lint` 正常/异常 fixture；
- board server 的 board/decisions API；
- 路径穿越拦截；
- CORS 远程来源拒绝 / 本地来源放行。

### 兼容

- DSH（Cordis）插件；
- 纯 markdown，Obsidian 可直接打开；
- Skill 部分对 Codex / Claude 也可复用。

### 发布

上架步骤见 [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md)。

### License

MIT

---

## English

**DSH Project Board** turns project structure, todos and decisions into one trackable system: a node tree, two Markdown files, and a right-sidebar view.

### What it solves

- Todos and decisions are scattered across chats, docs and boards.
- Boards are grouped by phase, but you work by product surface.
- Decisions record the conclusion but not the reason.
- Summary numbers are hand-maintained and drift.

Three constraints:

1. **Node tree** — `## 20 Home`; a node is a durable product surface or domain, not a task or a phase.
2. **Two records** — the progress board holds tasks, the decision ledger holds decisions; both share node IDs.
3. **Derived views** — progress, open items and pending decisions are computed, never typed by hand.

### Right sidebar

- Index chips and an exclusive accordion: one node open at a time.
- Search, "open only" and "pending decision" filters.
- Decisions grouped by node; a bottom sheet shows reason, alternatives, impact and review.
- Light and dark modes follow the DSH theme.

### Install

As a DSH plugin (recommended):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @notoonex/dsh-project-board
```

> Source install: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:Notoonex/dsh-project-board`

Restart DSH; a "Project Board" tab appears in the right sidebar. The plugin installs the bundled skill into `~/.dsh/skills/project-board/` and manages the local board server.

Skill only: add this repo to `dsh-skills-marketplace` with sparse path `skill`.

### Configuration

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_PROJECTS_DIR` | `~/Documents/Projects` | Project root; one subdirectory per project |
| `DSH_PROJECT_BOARD_PORT` | auto | Optional fixed port; otherwise 8791–8800 are probed |
| `DSH_PROJECT_BOARD_SKILL_DIR` | `~/.dsh/skills/project-board` | Advanced: override the skill install path |

### Project layout

```text
$DSH_PROJECTS_DIR/
└── my-app/
    ├── my-app 进度看板.md
    ├── my-app 决策台账.md
    ├── 踩坑.md            # optional
    └── README.md          # optional
```

The file suffixes are Chinese by design (`进度看板.md`, `决策台账.md`). The `project:` frontmatter must equal the file stem.

### File formats

### Progress board

```markdown
---
schema: project-board/1
project: my-app
archetype: web-app
nodes:
  "00": 治理
  "20": 首页
---

## 20 首页
> 范围：首屏 / 导航 / 视觉

- [ ] 首屏文案定稿 · 验收: 3 秒内说清产品是什么 · 关联: D-20-01
- [ ] [[首屏是否放演示视频]] 等 owner 拍板
- [x] ~~四屏结构定型~~ `abc1234`
```

### Decision ledger

```markdown
---
schema: decision-log/1
project: my-app
---

### D-20-01 首屏采用单 CTA
- 节点: 20 首页
- 状态: 生效
- 日期: 2026-10-24
- 可逆性: 可逆
- 理由: 首屏只保留一个动作，降低选择成本
- 备选: 双 CTA / 无 CTA
- 影响: 20
- 复审: 上线两周看转化率
```

Field names are Chinese (`节点`, `状态`, `日期`, ...) because the parser and the skill use them.

### Token

- Generated on first start at `~/.dsh/project-board/token` (mode 600).
- The plugin injects it into the installed `client/client.js`.
- Every API request carries `X-Project-Board-Token`; `/api/health` is public for port probing.
- Got a 401? Reload DSH, or delete the token file and restart DSH.
- This is a one-time automatic setup; no user input. A read-only plugin install directory is the only failure mode.

### Updates

- The bundled skill updates incrementally.
- Locally added files are kept; local edits are kept (`kept local skill edit`).
- Files removed upstream are deleted only if unedited.
- Force a full refresh by deleting `~/.dsh/skills/project-board/` or its `.manifest.json`.

### Write-back

- Task IDs `[T-<node>-<seq>]` are preferred; otherwise the server matches by node plus task text.
- If the task changed, the server returns 409 and the client refreshes; it never toggles a different task.
- Toggling done only adds or removes `~~`; links, code spans and bold are preserved.

### Security

- Listens on `127.0.0.1` only.
- A non-local `Origin` is rejected with 403.
- `project` is validated against the directory whitelist; path traversal is rejected.
- Only reads and writes `* 进度看板.md` / `* 决策台账.md` inside the project directory.
- Auto-generated token; remote pages and local pages without the token get 401.

### Development

```bash
npm test
```

Covers lint fixtures, board and decisions APIs, 401, 403, path traversal, content-based toggle and markdown preservation.

### Compatibility

- DSH (Cordis) plugin.
- Plain Markdown; opens in Obsidian.
- The skill is Markdown plus Node scripts and can be reused by other agents.

### Publishing

See [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md).

### License

MIT

plugins.description: Import the models, providers, API keys and OAuth logins that other agent harnesses keep on your machine (opencode, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, Gemini, Qwen, .env) into DeepSeek Harness, with a clean Settings page to manage them.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-import-models

Import the models, providers, API keys and OAuth logins that other agent harnesses
keep on this machine into **DeepSeek Harness**, then enable, disable and remove them
from a **Settings → Model Manager** page.

## What it reads

| Source | File | Becomes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **opencode** | `~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc` (`providers`, models, endpoints) | `llm-pi-ai` provider routes + API-key credentials |
| **opencode auth** | `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` | API-key credentials (and routes when opencode declared a provider) |
| **Codex / ChatGPT** | `~/.codex/auth.json` | `openai-codex` OAuth grant, or an OpenAI API-key route |
| **Claude Code** | `~/.claude/.credentials.json`, `~/.claude/settings.json` | `anthropic` OAuth grant or API key |
| **Gemini CLI** | `~/.gemini/oauth_creds.json` | `google` OAuth grant |
| **Qwen Code** | `~/.qwen/oauth_creds.json` | `qwen-token-plan` OAuth grant |
| **`.env` files** | `<cwd>/.env`, `~/.env`, `~/.dsh/.env`, `~/.config/dsh/.env`, `~/.config/opencode/.env` | API-key credentials (keys are imported; endpoints are not guessed) |

Every secret is redacted before it reaches the browser or the model: the page only
sees hints like `sk-ab…(51 chars)`. Imports re-read the source inside the Host, so a
key value never travels through the page.

## What you can do

- **Import** — scan, tick what you want, preview the plan, import. Per-source
  "Import" buttons do the same for one harness.
- **Providers** — disable (the route is stashed, not deleted), re-enable, or remove.
- **Models** — open a route's model list, search it, disable or re-enable single models.
- **Add a provider** — any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint, with an
  optional key written straight to the credential store.
- **Agent tools** — `model_manager_sources`, `model_manager_plan`,
  `model_manager_import`, `model_manager_routes`, `model_manager_toggle_route`,
  `model_manager_toggle_model`, `model_manager_add_route`,
  `model_manager_remove_route`, `model_manager_set_secret`.

## Install

```text
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: <path-to>/dsh-import-models
```

The bundle inserts one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: model-manager
      name: 'dsh-import-models'
```

Refresh the Web GUI once, then open **Settings → Model Manager**.

### Config

| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Turn the plugin off without uninstalling. |
| `allowWrite` | `true` | Refuse every import/toggle/add write (read-only page). |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | Add a short system-prompt section describing the tools. |
| `stateFile` | `~/.dsh/model-manager/state.json` | Where disabled routes/models and extra `.env` paths are remembered. |

## How writes work

Only first-class Host seams, never a hand-edited file:

- provider routes go through `configEditor.edit()` on the live `llm-pi-ai` row
  (falling back to `settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai', …)` when no editor is mounted);
- API keys go to `credentials.set(ref, value)`;
- OAuth logins become the credential record `llm-pi-ai/<route>`
  (`{ kind: 'grant', payload: { type: 'oauth', access, refresh, expires, accountId } }`).

Disabling a provider stashes its route config in the plugin state file and removes it
from the live config, so re-enabling restores it exactly. Model toggles rewrite the
route's `models` array the same way.

## Security

- HTTP routes are loopback-only; writes additionally require a same-origin
  `Origin`/`Host` pair or `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`.
- No secret appears in a response, a log line, or the plugin state file.
- Other harnesses' files are read only; nothing outside DSH is modified.

## Limitations

- OAuth grants are copied as-is. If the other harness already rotated the refresh
  token, import again.
- `.env` keys that match no known provider are stored as credential references only.
- The plugin performs no interactive sign-in of its own; use DSH's own Models page for
  that.
- Non-chat models (embeddings, TTS, image generation) are filtered out of imported
  routes and counted in the plan summary.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DSH 书架 / 论文模式：EPUB/PDF/论文阅读、AI 解释、全文搜索、论文翻译与中英对照
plugins.readme_text:
# Book Shelf / 书架

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-0avatar0%2Fdsh--reading--shelf-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/0avatar0/dsh-reading-shelf)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v2.4.4-2ea44f)](https://github.com/0avatar0/dsh-reading-shelf/releases/tag/v2.4.4)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

A persistent DSH Web UI plugin that adds a full-page multi-format reader to the
sidebar and an AI explanation rail for selected text. It also includes a
separate paper library with paragraph/whole-paper translation and bilingual
comparison.

## Install

1. Download `dsh-epub-reader-2.4.4.tgz` from the
   [latest release](https://github.com/0avatar0/dsh-reading-shelf/releases/tag/v2.4.4).
2. In DSH open **Plugins → Add plugin** and choose the downloaded tgz.
3. Reload the plugin and open **书架** in the sidebar.

Chinese step-by-step guide: [INSTALL-zh.md](INSTALL-zh.md). Publishing and npm
instructions: [PUBLISHING.md](PUBLISHING.md).

## What it does

- **Shelf** — scans the archive shelf (the first registered workspace by
  default, which is `D:\BookLib` on this deployment), plus any extra
  `libraryDirs`, for supported book files.
- **Copies external books** — a book opened or imported from outside the
  archive shelf is copied into `archiveDir` first. Identical files are reused;
  a name collision gets a ` (2)` suffix rather than overwriting anything.
- **Public-domain search** — the **Search books** tab queries Project Gutenberg
  (Gutendex, with the Gutenberg website search as a fallback), a Chinese-only
  Project Gutenberg catalog (`lang=zh`), Chinese Wikisource, Chinese Wikibooks,
  and Standard Ebooks, then saves the chosen book (EPUB, or an HTML book for
  the Wikimedia sources) into the archive shelf. Simplified Chinese queries are
  also tried as traditional Chinese for the Chinese catalogs. Results stream
  into the page one source at a time; slower sources keep searching while the
  first results are already usable. The search store lives outside the Library
  component, so opening a book or switching Harness pages does not abort the
  stream; returning restores the query and results, and the Host keeps result
  ids downloadable for 30 minutes. Only
  public-domain / openly licensed catalogs are used; DRM and unauthorized book
  sources are not supported. Choose which catalogs to query with **Choose
  sources**; the selected source homepages are shown as small links. A custom
  **OPDS** search URL can be added, but only entries that declare an
  `open-access` EPUB acquisition link are accepted. Several custom OPDS sources
  can be added with the **+** button. The built-in Chinese catalogs cover
  traditional Chinese Gutenberg titles and Wikisource; other catalogs are
  mostly English.
- **Reader** — parses the book into chapters, sanitizes HTML, and renders a
  comfortable serif reading page with per-book progress. EPUB keeps its OPF
  spine, headings, lists, tables, images and TOC; PDF/Text/Markdown/HTML/FB2/
  DOCX are normalized into readable chapters.
- **Ask while selecting** — the floating selection bar contains a question
  field to the left of **解释**. Type a specific question and press Enter or
  **解释**, or leave it blank for a direct explanation. The question is sent
  together with the book, chapter, selection, and nearby context; the right
  rail opens and streams the answer.
- **Follow-ups** — keep the whole Q&A thread in the panel and send the previous
  turns to the model, so pronouns and earlier details stay in context. You can
  stop the stream, copy the answer, or use quick asks (translate / example /
  background).
- **Per-book annotations** — every completed explanation and its follow-ups are
  saved on the Host under the archive directory. Opening a book opens the right
  annotation rail with that book's saved records; click a record to reopen its
  Q&A thread and continue asking. Records survive browser reloads and restarts.
- **Paper mode** — a separate paper library for English PDFs, with virtual
  folders (create, drag papers in, rename), paragraph-level translation into a
  JSON translation file, manual correction, retranslation, whole-paper
  translation saved as a new Chinese paper, and a bilingual compare view.
  Paper reading reuses the reader's AI explanation and full-book search; the
  compare view has the same right-side AI rail, selection question bar,
  follow-ups, saved annotation history and per-answer collapse as books, and
  works for both the English source and the Chinese translation. Annotation
  history and threads can delete a whole thread or an individual follow-up
  question/answer pair, with an X in the record's top-right corner and a
  second-click confirmation. The paper library supports right-click menus for
  new folders, importing into a folder, and renaming; the new-folder control is
  an icon on the right. Books can be hidden/unhidden or deleted (moved to
  `.epub-reader/trash`) from the book-card context menu. Papers can be deleted
  from their card context menu (two-step confirmation); a source paper also
  removes its Chinese translation paper and moves the PDF/translation file to
  the paper trash. Paper copies live in
  `.epub-reader/papers`, separate from the book shelf. The compare toggle sits
  in the paper reader header and can be hidden again; each
  translation box is resizable from its bottom edge, auto-fits its text on
  first open, remembers its height/collapsed state, and can be collapsed
  individually or all at once. Translation text supports AI explanation.
- **Zoom** — Ctrl/Cmd + mouse wheel changes the reading font size in both books
  and papers; the paper compare view also zooms its source/translation text.
- **AI panels** — explanations are expanded by default and can be collapsed
  individually or with one “Collapse all” action.
- **Find in book** — `Ctrl/Cmd+F` opens a full-book search across every
  chapter, including PDF/HTML/DOCX books. Results show chapter, occurrence and
  a text snippet; clicking one jumps to the chapter and highlights every match.
  The reader toolbar shows the shortcut next to the search button. Simplified
  Chinese queries also match traditional text (`陈文龙` finds `陳文龍`).
- **Keyboard** — `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+E` explains the current selection,
  `Alt+←` / `Alt+→` move between chapters, `Esc` closes search/rail.

## Supported formats

| Format | Support |
|---|---|
| `.epub` | Full spine, chapters, TOC, images, cover |
| `.pdf` | Text-layer extraction, 8 pages per chapter; scanned PDFs need OCR first |
| `.txt` / `.text` | Plain text, automatically chunked |
| `.md` / `.markdown` | Headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes, code blocks |
| `.html` / `.htm` / `.xhtml` | Sanitized HTML body |
| `.fb2` | FictionBook XML |
| `.docx` | Word paragraphs and Heading 1–3 chapters |
| `.mobi` / `.azw3` / `.azw` | Convert to EPUB or PDF first (for example with Calibre) |

PDF extraction uses a vendored PDF.js runtime under `vendor/pdfjs/`; the package
has no npm runtime dependency for it.

## Configuration

Edit the installed row's config in the profile patch (or the plugin's
`cordis.patch.yml` before installing):

```yaml
- id: epub-reader
  name: '@local/dsh-epub-reader'
  config:
    # Where outside books are copied and what the shelf scans by default.
    # Empty = the first registered workspace (D:\BookLib here), then cwd.
    archiveDir: D:\BookLib
    # Extra folders to scan, if any. Absolute paths are allowed.
    libraryDirs:
      - D:\Books
    # Optional; otherwise the Host's default model is used.
    # Example: explainProvider: deepseek-account
    #          explainModel: deepseek-flash
    explainProvider: deepseek-account
    explainModel: deepseek-flash
    # Off by default: the API answers only loopback browser requests.
    allowRemote: false
```

The Host routes are mounted under `/api/epub-reader`. They accept only
same-origin browser requests, expose only `.epub` files found under a configured
shelf root, copy external files into the archive before parsing, and stream
explanations over SSE.

## Notes

- Books are opened read-only; progress is stored in the browser

plugins.description: DSH 插件：只读审计插件 HTTP 路由是否真的做了鉴权栅栏（fenced / open / absent / unknown）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-trust-audit

只读审计：**DSH 端口上插件的 HTTP 路由，是否真的做了鉴权栅栏。**

## 安装

```bash
# 从 GitHub Release 直链安装（不需要 npm 账号，不需要 git）
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add https://github.com/Anguis-L/dsh-plugin-trust-audit/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-trust-audit-0.1.0.tgz
```

装完**重启一次** dsh（bundle 层要重启才组装），然后在会话里直接让 agent 调用 `plugin_trust_audit`。

## 为什么需要它

插件可以在浏览器 HTTP 载体上注册自己的前缀，而路由分发是**最长前缀优先**。一个比内核 `/api` 更长的插件前缀，会**先于**内核自己的准入检查执行 —— 于是"这条路由是否需要凭据"完全取决于插件自己，而社区里的两个样本结论相反：

| 实现 | 无凭据回环请求 |
|---|---|
| `dsh-our-free-model`（用 `connection.requestRejection`） | **401** 已拦 |
| `dsh-bili-scroll` 2.0.4（只有结构化栅栏） | **200** 放行 |

这个差别从外面看不出来 —— 插件目录里没有任何字段告诉你装的是哪一种。本插件把它变成可测量的。

## 判定口径

对每个候选路径发三组**只读 GET** 探测，每组回答不同的问题：

| 探测 | 头 | 回答什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 无凭据 | 无 | 裸奔的调用者能不能拿到数据 |
| 跨端口 Origin | `Origin: http://127.0.0.1:65535` | 本机**别的端口**上的页面能不能驱动它（只比主机名、不比端口时会放行） |
| 跨站 Origin | `Origin: https://example.invalid` | 外部网页能不能驱动它 |

判定：

| 状态码 | 判定 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 401 / 403 | `fenced` | 栅栏生效 |
| 2xx | `open` | **无鉴权可达** |
| 404 | `absent` | 没注册路由，不构成风险 |
| 其它 / 超时 / 连不上 | `unknown` | **不等于安全** |

`unknown` 是三值判定的关键：把"判不了"糊成"安全"，是这里唯一真正危险的结果。

### ⚠️ 关于 `absent` 的一个实测坑

在真实宿主上测过：一条**没被任何插件注册**的路径，比如 `/api/nonexistent-xyz`，返回的是 **401 而不是 404** —— 因为内核自己的 `/api` 前缀先接住了它。

所以：`absent` 在实践中很少出现；**一条你以为"没注册"却返回 401 的路径，大概率是内核答的，不是插件栅栏生效**。

因此判定描述的是**该端口在该路径上的可观测行为**，它**不**把响应归属到某个具体插件。要判断"这是不是插件栅栏"，需要结合该插件源码里是否真的做了 `connection.requestRejection`。

## 它自己不开任何 HTTP 路由

一个审计工具如果自己开了个裸奔的接口，就是它存在的意义本身的笑话。所以本插件**只注册一个 Host 工具，没有 `webServer.register`**。

## 自动发现路由（0.2.0 起）

0.1.x 里探的是两条**硬编码**路径，其中一条（`/api/our-free-model/status`）根本不存在 —— **一半的报告是编的**。

0.2.0 改成从已安装插件的代码里**读出它们真正注册的路由**：

- 匹配 `<任何别名>.register({ kind, path, handler })` —— 不能只匹配 `webServer.register`，因为实际代码普遍先起别名（`const server = scoped.webServer` 再 `server.register(...)`）。实测：严格匹配只找到 1 条，放宽后找到 3 条。
- 遇到 `kind: 'prefix'` 会**连带探测子路径**（`/status`、`/config`）。这一步不是锦上添花：实测 `/api/bili-duty` 返回 **404**，而同一插件的 `/api/bili-duty/status` 返回 **200 无凭据** —— 只探前缀根会把一个敞开的接口报成"无风险"。
- 报告里的 `source` 字段说明路径来源：`discovered` / `explicit` / `fallback`。**`fallback` 表示没读到 profile 目录，那次不算完整审计**，会额外带一条 `caveat`。

实测一次输出（本机装了 2 个插件）：

```
source=discovered  probed=7  summary={"open":2,"fenced":4,"absent":1,"unknown":0}

  absent   404  dsh-bili-scroll      /api/bili-duty
  open     200  dsh-bili-scroll      /api/bili-duty/status
  open     200  dsh-bili-scroll      /api/bili-duty/config
  fenced   401  dsh-our-free-model   /api/our-free-model
  fenced   401  dsh-our-free-model   /api/our-free-model/status
  fenced   401  dsh-our-free-model   /api/our-free-model/config
  fenced   401  dsh-our-free-model   /api/our-free-model/events
```

同一个端口上，两个插件一个 `open` 一个 `fenced` —— **这就是本工具存在的理由**。

## 只读

只发 `GET`，**从不发写请求**，所以审计不会改变它正在检查的状态。

## 用法

```
plugin_trust_audit()                                                  # 自动发现 + 探测
plugin_trust_audit({ origin: 'http://127.0.0.1:61782' })
plugin_trust_audit({ profileDir: 'C:/Users/you/.dsh/profiles/desktop' })  # 指定要扫哪个 profile
plugin_trust_audit({ paths: ['/api/my-plugin/config'] })                  # 只探指定路径
```

只审计回环地址。对**它机**地址发起探测属于未授权扫描，本工具不做。

## 局限

判定基于响应状态码，不构成完整安全审计：它不能证明一条返回 401 的路由内部没有别的洞，也不能发现只在特定方法/参数下才触发的问题。

自动发现是**读代码猜路径**，不是运行时注册表查询（宿主没把这个信息暴露出来）。所以：

- 路径写得很动态的插件（`path: '/api/' + name`）可能扫不到；
- 子路径只探 `/status`、`/config` 两个常见名，其他端点需要显式传 `paths`；
- 扫不到时报告会明确写 `source: fallback` + `caveat`，**不会假装是一次完整审计**。

plugins.description: Official-style model + reasoning-effort control for the DeepSeek Harness composer: Off/Low/High/Max.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-official-reasoning-effort

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-Ayowait%2Fdsh--official--reasoning--effort-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-79e5bd.svg)](LICENSE)

> Reasoning-effort control for gateway / custom providers — using the official
> composer UI, not a re-implementation of it.

![Expanded panel](assets/popover-root.png)

## What it solves

Many gateway APIs (e.g. `deepseek-v4.1-flash` on a relay) expose no `reasoning
effort` knob of their own, yet the request still succeeds upstream. The official
composer only renders the **Effort** row when the model declares reasoning
levels — so gateways without a declaration show no such option at all.

## How it works (official components only)

This plugin does **not** draw its own UI. It has two small halves:

1. **Host half (data fill)**: every model in `llm-pi-ai` that lacks
   `reasoningEfforts` gets `off / low / high / max` added — additively; an existing
   declaration (including `false`) is never overwritten. Once the model carries
   the field, `llm-pi-ai` reports `reasoning: true` with the level list, and the
   **official** `ModelSelect` composer renders its own 模型 / 推理等级 rows with
   the drill-down level picker by itself. Nothing is re-implemented.
2. **Browser half (one hint line)**: the model picker panel is found by its
   official `aria-label`, and when the currently selected provider+model is one
   whose levels were supplied generically, a CSS `::after` pseudo-element adds a
   single small line at the bottom of the official panel:

   > 上游未声明思考强度，此处为通用档位，上游可能忽略或拒绝。
   >
   > Upstream does not declare reasoning effort; these are generic levels and may be ignored or rejected.

   It is hidden for models whose levels are genuinely declared upstream. The
   match is on the **provider + model pair** (`data-provider-id` /
   `data-model-id`), so the same model id served by a different, reasoning-capable
   provider is never flagged.

![Reasoning levels (official drill-down: exactly Off / Low / High / Max)](assets/effort-levels-off-low-high-max.png)

## Levels

- Default four, identical to the official control: `Off` / `Low` / `High` / `Max`.
  These are the ids `off / low / high / max`; `llm-pi-ai` renders each level's
  label by capitalising its id, so the official picker shows exactly
  Off / Low / High / Max with no UI changes.

### Why `reasoning: high` is written too

Declaring `reasoningEfforts` alone yields **five** rows (an extra `Default`).
The official picker builds its list as:

```js
[...(reasoning.defaultEffort === undefined
     ? [{ effort: undefined, label: t('effort.providerDefault') }]  // ← the extra Default
     : []),
 ...reasoning.efforts.map((effort) => ({ ... }))]
```

`defaultEffort` is derived by `llm-pi-ai` from the **provider profile's**
`reasoning` field (`reasoningInfo(model, profile.reasoning)`). A provider that
declares no `reasoning` has no `defaultEffort`, hence `Default` + four levels =
five rows. The official `dsh-llm-deepseek` adapter always sets one (falling back
to `high`), which is why the built-in provider shows four rows.

The plugin therefore writes `reasoning: high` for any provider whose levels it
filled (High is the official "default balance for most tasks"). An explicitly
configured `reasoning` is never overwritten, and providers needing no fill are
left alone.

- A model that natively publishes more (or fewer) levels keeps its own list —
  the official picker renders whatever the model declares;
- On send the level maps to the wire value following the `pi-ai` adapter
  (defaulting to the level name; overridable in config).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add github:Ayowait/dsh-official-reasoning-effort
```

`lib/` is prebuilt and committed, so installing from GitHub needs no local build.
No client bundling step is required either — the browser half is a plain
side-effect module.

## Configuration

Zero-config by default: it discovers every existing `llm-pi-ai` provider and
fills generic levels for models that declare none. Override only for special
gateways / exclusions / per-model handling:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-official-reasoning-effort
      name: dsh-official-reasoning-effort
      config:
        efforts:
          high: reasoning_high
        providers:
          special-gateway:
            efforts:
              max: max_reasoning
            models:
              non-reasoning-model:
                disabled: true
          excluded-provider:
            disabled: true
```

### Fields

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `auto` | Auto-discover all providers (default `true`); when `false`, only providers listed under `providers`. |
| `efforts` | Override the wire-value map for all providers (default `off/low/high/max → same name`). |
| `defaultEffort` | Provider default effort written when filling levels (default `high`, the official default). |
| `syncDefaultEffort` | Set `false` to skip writing the provider default (the official menu then shows an extra `Default` row). |
| `providers.<id>.efforts` | Override wire values for one provider. |
| `providers.<id>.disabled` | Exclude a provider. |
| `providers.<id>.models.<model>.efforts` | Override wire values for one model. |
| `providers.<id>.models.<model>.disabled` | Mark a model as non-reasoning (`reasoningEfforts: false`). |

## Safe defaults

- Existing `reasoningEfforts` (including `false`) is **never** overwritten;
- Re-injection is idempotent: a value equal to the generic set this plugin would
  write is recognised as its own prior write (the hint keeps showing) while a
  genuine upstream declaration is left alone;
- Migration: the `{low, medium, high}` set written by earlier 0.2.x releases is
  recognised and upgraded once to `off / low / high / max`;
- Other fields are untouched; no provider credentials, requests, tools, or
  telemetry are added;
- The host half is dependency-free (no `@deepseek-ai/*` imports) — those
  specifiers are not resolvable from a profile plugin's install directory and
  importing them would take the whole host bundle down;
- The read-only route `GET /dsh-official-reasoning-effort/api/injected` reports the
  `provider\0model` keys that were filled, so the browser can decide whether to
  show the hint.

## Develop / test

```sh
npm test
```

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Independent DeepSeek Harness voice-input bundle: browser recording transcribed by a local SpeechRail service over the OpenAI-compatible file-transcription API (loopback only).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-speechrail-bundle

An independent [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) voice-input
bundle that records in the browser and transcribes through a **local** SpeechRail service, using
the OpenAI-compatible file-transcription API. It does not require the official voice bundle to be
enabled, and it never talks to a remote endpoint: loopback only.

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [Package README](packages/speechrail-input/README.md) · [Design and review record](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-23-speechrail-input-design.md)

**Status: implemented and verified; not installed or enabled in any profile.**

## What it provides

| Face | What it does |
|---|---|
| Host | A SpeechRail service over a Strict Typert Remote surface: loopback-only uploads, credential **by reference**, a single in-flight gate, a non-sensitive pending journal, and stable failure codes. |
| Client | A composer microphone control with waveform, draft-insertion protection, and a settings page; zh/en localisation; a blocked gate can be cleared from either. |
| Agent | One read-only tool, `speechrail_input_status`, so a model can explain *why* voice input is unusable without opening settings. |

## Safety properties

- **Loopback only.** `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1` or `http://[::1]:<port>/v1`; anything else, and
  any URL carrying userinfo, is refused with a stable reason before a request is built.
- **The credential is never stored, logged, or returned.** The plugin resolves a reference through
  DSH credentials or settings and sends it as a bearer header; only the reference name and a
  boolean ever reach a client or the agent tool.
- **No transcript or audio is persisted.** The pending journal holds an operation id, a phase and a
  timestamp — nothing else — so a crash or reload cannot silently lose an upload whose outcome is
  unknown.
- **Nothing is uploaded twice.** The gate admits one operation at a time, and an unknown outcome
  blocks further uploads until it is explicitly acknowledged.
- **Advertised limits only change when the service states them.** A limit an unrecognised,
  unreachable, or limit-less capability response omits keeps the value already in force.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (`engines.dsh`).
- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- A local SpeechRail service exposing `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` and, optionally,
  `GET /v1/speechrail/capabilities`.
- A credential reference usable by the Host, for example `SPEECHRAIL_API_KEY`.

## Install

No npm package is published. Releases carry the packed bundle as a tarball asset; install it through
the Harness plugin manager, which performs package installation and bundle selection (do not
reproduce those steps by hand):

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-speechrail-bundle/releases/latest/download/dsh-speechrail-bundle.tgz
```

A checkout worktree works the same way (`target: <path to packages/speechrail-input>`), and the
local profile here runs this bundle at the latest release.

To upgrade, install the tag-pinned asset rather than the `latest` one: the plugin manager keys a
dependency by its target string, so re-running the command above on an installed bundle reports
`already-installed` instead of fetching the newer bytes.

```
plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: https://github.com/hrygo/dsh-speechrail-bundle/releases/download/v0.1.7/dsh-speechrail-bundle.tgz
```

Then set the endpoint and credential reference on its settings page.

## Known limitations

- Two status reads can be in flight at once (a check and a recording start, for example). The client
  ignores one that lands after a newer read has already been applied, but it cannot order two
  responses by their content: `revision` tracks settings writes, not the gate, so a response the
  service produced from an older snapshot can still be shown until the next read corrects it.
- A capability the service does not state is treated as unsupported rather than assumed. The settings
  page only says "not stated by the service" when a check actually reached the service; a check the
  host refused locally (no credential, unusable endpoint) reads as "not checked yet".
- The request budget is bounded to 1000–180000 ms, by the settings schema and again on the Remote
  path, because the settings store validates shape rather than `min`/`max`.
- Changing a non-volatile setting (endpoint, model, credential reference) restarts the bundle's
  entry, which releases the journal storage unit and immediately opens it again. The release is
  fire-and-forget, and the backend rejects a second handle for a unit that is still open, so the new
  instance can transiently read the journal as unavailable (an unproven gate with a spurious
  acknowledgement prompt). A retry heals it; awaiting the release would remove the window.
- The bundle never reads or stores the credential itself: it resolves the configured reference name
  through the Harness credential store on each request.

## Verify

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm verify     # baseline check -> Typert generation -> both type checks -> bundles -> tests
pnpm test       # host and client unit tests (117; all mock or synthetic audio)
```

`pnpm verify` also re-checks the frozen upstream snapshot against
[upstream/baseline.json](upstream/baseline.json) and the pinned upstream commit. Nothing in this
repository contacts a real service, records audio, or runs inference.

The agent tool's definition is written structurally, so the compiler cannot check it against the
registry; `tools/check-tool-schema.mjs` compares it with `defineTool`'s compiled output and runs the
registry's own `assertSupportedJsonSchema`. Its header documents the temporary install that check
needs.

## Repository layout

- [packages/speechrail-input](packages/speechrail-input/) — the published bundle
  (`@hrygo/dsh-speechrail-bundle`): Host, client and protocol sources, its patch, locales and icon.
- [packages/typert-protocol](packages/typert-protocol/) — a private type shim that lets the Typert
  generator see this bundle's Remote declarations. Never published, never a runtime import.
- [upstream](upstream/) — the frozen, read-only official baseline (5 voice packages, MIT) plus a
  per-file source manifest; it is provenance, not a runtime entry point.
- [tools](tools/) — baseline-integrity and tool-schema checks.
- [docs](docs/) — design, implementation plan, and the record of four independent review rounds.

## Provenance and licence

The bundle is written against the official voice-input subsystem, snapshotted at upstream commit
`687f282e8625c6b8d11ff58211a90524be2e4317` (`dsh-v0.2.1-rc.2`), and adapts parts of the official
recording helper. MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE) and [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md), which retain the upstream
copyright and attribution.
